उ: उ The third short vowel of the Sanskrit alphabet, corresponding to the letter U, and pronounced as that is in the word full.
उ r. 1st cl. (उ) उङ (उवते) To sound, to make a particular sound or noise.
उ ind. An interjection, 1 of assent; 2 calling; 3 of compassion; 4 anger; and 5 of command. 6 An expletive. m. (-उः) 7 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Of BRAHMA.
उकनाह: उकनाह m. (-हः) A horse of a red and yellow, or red and black colour, a bay or chesnut horse.
उकुण: उकुण m. (-णः) A bug. also उत्कुण.
उक्त: उक्त n. (-क्तं) A sentence. nf. (-क्तं-क्ता) A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant, one long or two short syllables in each. mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Spoken, said. E. वच to speak, affix क्त and व changed to उ.
उक्तवत्: उक्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Said, was saying. E. वच to speak, क्तवतु affix of the past part.
उक्तवाक्य: उक्तवाक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) One who has borne testimony or given an opinion. n. (-क्यं) A dictum, a decree. E. उक्त and वाक्य dictum.
उक्ति: उक्ति f. (क्तिः) Speech, speaking. E. वच to speak, and क्तिन् aff.
उक्तोपसंहार: उक्तोपसंहार m. (-रः) Any brief or compendious phrase or description. E. उक्त what is said, उपसंहार compendiousness.
उक्त्वा: उक्त्वा ind. Having spoken or said. E. वच् to speak, क्त्वाच् aff.
उक्थ: उक्थ n. (-क्थं) The second or Sāma Veda. f. (-क्था) A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines of one syllable each, the syllable may be one long or two short in quantity. E. वच to speak, and थक् Uṇādi aff.
उक्ष: उक्ष r. 1st. cl. (उक्षति) 1 To sprinkle or wet. 2 To clean.
उक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Cleansed, washed. 2 Wet, moist. E. उक्ष to wet, affix अप्.
उक्षतर: उक्षतर m. (-रः) A large bull or ox. E. उक्षन् an ox, and तरप् aff.
उक्षन्: उक्षन् m. (-क्षा) An ox or bull. E. उक्ष to sprinkle, and कनिन् Uṇādi aff.
उक्षाल: उक्षाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Swift. 2 Excellent. 3 Terrible. 4 High. 5 Much. m. (-लः) A monkey.
उक्षित: उक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sprinkled. 2 Cleansed, perfumed. E. उक्ष to wet, and क्त aff.
उख: उख r. 1st cl. (ओखति) (इ) उखि (उंखति) 1 To go, to move or approach. 2 To dry, to wither. 3 To adorn. The first retains the diphthong with a prefix ending in अ, as प्र and ओखति make प्रोखति.
उखर्वल: उखर्व्वल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
उखर्व्वल: उखर्व्वल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
उखल: उखल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
उखा: उखा f. (-खा) A pot or saucepan, &c. E. उख to go, क affix, and टाप्, also उघा.
उख्य: उख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Boiled, dressed in a pot, (flesh, &c.) E. उखा a pot, and यत् aff.
उग्र: उग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 Angry, wrathful. 2 Hot, sharp, pungent, acrid. 3 Formidable, terrible. 4 Cruel, fierce, savage. m. (-ग्रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of a mixed tribe, from a Kṣatriya father and Śūdra mother: the employment of this caste, according to MANU, is the killing or catching of animals that live in holes, as a snake-catcher, &c.; according to the Tantras, the Ugra is an encomiast or bard. 3 A tree, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.) 4 A class of asterisms, Maghā, Bharaṇi, Pūrvaphalgunī, Pūrvāṣāḍhā, Pūrvabhadrapada. 5 A name of Malabar. f. (-ग्रा) 1 Orris root. 2 A medicinal plant. 3 An Ugra woman. n. (-ग्रं) Wrath, anger. E. उच to accumulate, रन् Uṇādi affix, च is changed to ग.
उग्रकर्मन्: उग्रकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Fierce, violent, cruel. E. उग्र and कर्म्मन् act.
उग्रकर्म्मन्: उग्रकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Fierce, violent, cruel. E. उग्र and कर्म्मन् act.
उग्रकाण्ड: उग्रकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A sort of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) E. उग्र and काण्ड a stem.
उग्रगन्ध: उग्रगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Strong smelling. m. (-न्धः) 1 A plant, (Michelia champaca.) 2 Garlic. n. (-न्धं) Asafoetida. f. (-न्धा) 1 Common carraway, (Carum carui, &c.) see अजमोदा. 2 Orris root. 3 A medicinal plant. E. उग्र violent, &c. and गन्ध scent.
उग्रगन्धिन्: उग्रगन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Strong smelling. E. उग्रगन्ध and इनि aff.
उग्रचय: उग्रचय m. (-यः) Desire. E. उग्र fierce, चय a heap.
उग्रत्व: उग्रत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Violence, passionateness. 2 Pungency, acrimony. E. उग्र angry, and त्व; also with तल् affix. उग्रता f. (-ता.)
उग्रदण्ड: उग्रदण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Relentless, remorseless. E. उग्र and दण्ड punishment.
उग्रधन्वन्: उग्रधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A name of INDRA. E. उग्र fierce, and धन्वन् a bowyer.
उग्रनासिक: उग्रनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Large-nosed. E. उग्र formidable, and नासिका a nose.
उग्रम्पश्य: उग्रम्पश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 1 Frightful, hideous, fierce looking. 2 Malignant, wicked. E. उग्र fierce, पश्य looking.
उग्रशेखरा: उग्रशेखरा f. (-रा) A name of GAṄGĀ. E. उग्र ŚIVA, and शेखरा a crest.
उग्रसेन: उग्रसेन m. (-नः) 1 The name of a prince, the father of DEVAKĪ and KAṂSA, and king of Mathurā. 2 The name of another prince, the son of PARIKṢIT. E. उग्र fierce, and सेना an army.
उग्रसेनज: उग्रसेनज m. (-जः) A name of KAṂSA, the uncle and enemy of KṚṢṆA. E. उग्रसेन and ज born; also उग्रमेनतनयः, उग्रसेनपुत्रः, उग्रसेनसुतः, &c.
उङ्कुण: उङ्कुण m. (-णः) A bug: see उत्कुण. E. उ fear, and कुण a sound.
उच: उच r. 4th cl. (उच्यति) To be conglomerate, to be gathered or assembled together, to unite or associate with.
उचित: उचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proper, suitable, convenient. 2 Receivable, fit or right to be taken. 3 Known, understood. 4 Intrusted, deposited. 5 Measured, adjusted, accurate. E. वच to speak, and कितच् Uṇādi aff.
उच्च: उच्च mfn. (-च्चः-च्चा-च्चं) High, tall. m. (-च्चः) The apex of the orbit of a planet. E. उत् upwards, चि to gather, and ड aff.
उच्चकैस्: उच्चकैस् ind. Excessively lofty, tall, loud, &c. E. उच्च high, कैस् aff.
उच्चघन: उच्चघन n. (-नं) Laughter in the mind not expressed in the countenance.
उच्चटा: उच्चटा f. (-टा) 1 Pride, arrogance. 2 Habit, usage. 3 A kind of garlic. 4 A species of grass, (a cyperus.) 5 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) 6 A sort of sorrel. E. उत् and चट to injure, अच् and टाप् affs.
उच्चण्ड: उच्चण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 1 Quick, expeditious. 2 Passionate, violent. E. उत् implying excess, चडि to be angry, and अच् aff.
उच्चतम: उच्चतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Highest. E. उच्च and तमप् aff.
उच्चतर: उच्चतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Higher, more lofty. E. उच्च and तरप् aff.
उच्चतरु: उच्चतरु m. (-रुः) 1 The cocoanut tree. 2 Any lofty tree. E. उच्च and तरु a tree.
उच्चता: उच्चता f. (-ता) Height; also n. (-त्वं). E. तल् or त्व added to उच्च.
उच्चताल: उच्चताल n. (-लं) Music and dancing at feasts, drinking parties, &c. E. उच्च high sounding, and ताल tune.
उच्चदेव: उच्चदेव m. (-वः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. उच्च high, above, and देव a deity.
उच्चदेवता: उच्चदेवता f. (-ता) Time personified, Chronos. E. उच्च high, and देवता divinity.
उच्चन्द्र: उच्चन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The end of the night, the last watch of the night. E. उत् priv. and चन्द्र the moon; moonset.
उच्चभाषण: उच्चभाषण n. (-णं) Speaking loud. E. उच्च and भाषण speaking.
उच्चमान: उच्चमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) To be said. E. वच to speak, pass. v. शानच् aff.
उच्चय: उच्चय m. (-यः) 1 The knot of the string or of the cloth which fastens the lower garments round the loins tied in front. 2 The opposite leg of a triangle. E. उत् up, above, चि to gather, अच् aff.
उच्चरण: उच्चरण n. (-णं) 1 Uttering, articulating. 2 Going up or out. E. उत् before चर to go, ल्युट् aff.
उच्चरित: उच्चरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Uttered, articulated. 2 Gone up or out. E. उत् before चर to go, क्त aff.
उच्चल: उच्चल n. (-लं) The mind, the understanding. E. उत् above, and चल what goes.
उच्चलन: उच्चलन n. (-नं) Going off or out. E. उत् before चल to go, ल्युट् aff.
उच्चललाटा: उच्चललाटा f. (-टा) A woman with a high or projecting forehead. E. उच्च high, and ललाट a forehead; also उच्चललाटिका.
उच्चलित: उच्चलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone up or out. 2 Winnowed. E. उत् before चल to go, क्त aff.
उच्चाटन: उच्चाटन n. (-नं) 1 Eradicating as a plant. 2 Ruining, (as an individual.) 3 Causing a person's ruin by magical incantations. E. उच्च up, and अटन going.
उच्चार: उच्चार m. (-रः) 1 Foeces, excrement. 2 Pronunciation, utterance. E. उत्, चर to go, and घञ् aff.
उच्चारण: उच्चारण n. (-णं) Articulating, enunciation. E. उत् before चर to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
उच्चारणज्ञ: उच्चारणज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A linguist, one skilled in languages or sounds. E. उच्चारण and ज्ञ who knows.
उच्चारणस्थान: उच्चारणस्थान n. (-नं) The part of the throat, &c. whence certain sounds, as nasals, gutturals, and the like proceed. E. उच्चारण and स्थान place.
उच्चारणार्थ: उच्चारणार्थ mfn. (-थ-र्था-र्थं) Necessary for pronunciation, a superfluous letter, &c. उच्चारण and अर्थ object.
उच्चारित: उच्चारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pronounced, uttered, articulated. E. उत् before चर to go, causal form, क्त aff.
उच्चार्य: उच्चार्य्य ind. Having spoken or uttered. mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spoken, to be pronounced. E. उद before चर to go, causal form, affix ल्यप् or यत्.
उच्चार्य्य: उच्चार्य्य ind. Having spoken or uttered. mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spoken, to be pronounced. E. उद before चर to go, causal form, affix ल्यप् or यत्.
उच्चार्यमाण: उच्चार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being uttered or pronounced. E. उच्चर, causal form, शानच् aff.
उच्चार्य्यमाण: उच्चार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being uttered or pronounced. E. उच्चर, causal form, शानच् aff.
उच्चावच: उच्चावच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 1 Various, multiform. 2 Uneven, irregular, undulating. 3 High and low. E. उदक् upper, and अवाक् lower, great and small, &c.; the compound is irregular.
उच्चिकीर्षा: उच्चिकीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Desire or wish to collect. E. उद before चि to collect, desiderative form, अ and टाप् affs.
उच्चिङ्गट: उच्चिङ्गट m. (-टः) 1 A sort of cricket. 2 A passionate man. E. उत् like, and चिङ्गट a shrimp.
उच्चूल: उच्चूल m. (-लः) The flag or pennon of a banner. E. उत् above, and चूड to be high; ल is substituted for ड.
उच्चैःश्रवस्: उच्चैःश्रवस् m. (-वाः) The horse of INDRA. E. उच्चैस् high, and श्रवस् an ear, long-eared; it is sometimes written with a final vowel, nom. (-सः.)
उच्चैःस्वर: उच्चैःस्वर m. (-रः) A loud sound or voice. E. उच्चैस् and स्वर sound.
उच्चैर्घुष्ट: उच्चैर्घुष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Making a loud noise, clamour. E. उच्चैस् high, loud, and घुष्ट sound.
उच्चैस्: उच्चैस् ind. High, loud, great, much, &c. E. उत् much, चि to collect, डैसि Uṇādi aff.
उच्चैस्तम: उच्चैस्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Very high, tall or lofty. 2 Very loud. E. उच्चैस् and तमप् aff.
उच्चैस्तमाम्: उच्चैस्तमाम् ind. 1 Loudly, aloud. 2 On high, high. E. आसु added to the last.
उच्चैस्तर: उच्चैस्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Loftier. 2 Louder. E. उच्चैस् and तरप् aff.
उच्छ: उच्छ r. 1st and 6th cls. (इ.) उच्छि (उञ्छति) 1 To glean. 2 To gather little by little. (ई.) उच्छी (उच्छति) or usually with वि prefixed, (व्युच्छति) 1 To end or terminate, to leave off. 2 To finish or conclude. 3 To pass or quit. 4 To bind. With प्र, to wipe off.
उच्छन्न: उच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Destroyed. m. (-न्नः) Peace obtained by ceding valuable lands. E. उत् before षद to go, affix क्त.
उच्छलत्: उच्छलत् mfn. (-लन्-लंती-लत्) Going or moving on or against. E. उद, शल to go, शतृ aff.
उच्छलन: उच्छलन n. (-नं) 1 Going upon. 2 Having over, or above, or against. E. उद before शल, ल्युट् aff.
उच्छादन: उच्छादन n. (-नं) Cleaning with perfumes. E. उत्, छद to cover, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
उच्छालित: उच्छालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Waved, waved above. 2 Gone, went. 3 Shaken. E. उद and शल to go, causal form, क्त aff.
उच्छास्त्रवर्तिन्: उच्छास्त्रवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Transgressing, deviating from the ritual. E. उद् before शास्त्र scripture, वर्त्तिन् who abides.
उच्छास्त्रवर्त्तिन्: उच्छास्त्रवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Transgressing, deviating from the ritual. E. उद् before शास्त्र scripture, वर्त्तिन् who abides.
उच्छिख: उच्छिख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 1 Flaming, blazing up. 2 Radiant. 3 High crested. E. उद् up, शिखा a flame.
उच्छिङ्घन: उच्छिङ्घन n. (-नं) Breathing through the nostrils, snuffing, snoring. E. उत् and शिघि to smell, ल्युट् aff.
उच्छिद्य: उच्छिद्य ind. Having cut off, destroyed, killed, &c. E. उद् before छिद to cut, ल्यप् aff.
उच्छिन्न: उच्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Cut, cut off or cut. 2 Destroyed, killed. E. उद् and छिन्न cut.
उच्छिलीन्ध्र: उच्छिलीन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) A mushroom. E. उत् and शिलीन्ध्र.
उच्छिष्ट: उच्छिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Left, rejected as food; (i. e. spit out of the mouth, or orts, crumbs, fragments, &c.) 2 Left, abandoned. E. उत् up, शिष to leave as a residue, and क्त aff.
उच्छिष्टभोजन: उच्छिष्टभोजन m. (-नः) 1 One who eats another's leavings. 2 The attendant upon an idol, whose food is the leavings of the deities. E. उच्छिष्ट orts, and भोजन food.
उच्छिष्टभोजिन्: उच्छिष्टभोजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Who eats the remains of a meal. E. उच्छिष्ट and भोजिन् who eats.
उच्छिष्टमोदन: उच्छिष्टमोदन n. (-नं) Wax. E. उच्छिष्ट and मोदन pleasing.
उच्छिष्टान्न: उच्छिष्टान्न n. (-न्नं) Leaving, offal. E. उच्छिष्ट and अन्न food.
उच्छीर्षक: उच्छीर्षक n. (-कं) A pillow. E. उत् upon, and शीर्षक the head: on which rests the head.
उच्छुष्क: उच्छुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Dry, dried up, withered. E. उद् before शुष्क dried.
उच्छूडा: उच्छूडा f. (-डा) The head of a banner or part above the flag with erect ornaments. E. उत् up, छूडा crest.
उच्छून: उच्छून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Swollen, turgid. 2 Lofty, high. 3 Fat, bulky. E. उत् up, श्वि to increase, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
उच्छृङ्खल: उच्छृङ्खल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Unrestrained, perverse, self-willed. 2 Irregular, desultory, unmethodical. E. उत् priv. and शृङ्क्षला a chain.
उच्छेद: उच्छेद m. (-दः) 1 Cutting off or out. 2 Destroying, destruction. 3 Cutting short, putting an end to. 4 Excision. E. उद् and छिद cutting.
उच्छेषण: उच्छेषण n. (-णं) 1 Rest, remainder. 2 Leavings. E. उत् and शेषण remaining.
उच्छोषण: उच्छोषण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) What dries up or withers. n. (-णं) Drying up, parching. E. उद् and शोषण drying.
उच्छ्रय: उच्छ्रय m. (-यः) 1 Height, elevation of a tree, mountain, &c. 2 Rising of a planet, &c. 3 Upright side of a triangle. E. उत् up, श्रिञ् to serve, च्यच् aff.
उच्छ्राय: उच्छ्राय m. (-यः) Height, elevation. E. उत् before श्रि to serve, घञ् aff.
उच्छ्रायिन्: उच्छ्रायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) High raised, lofty. E. उच्छ्राय and इनि aff.
उच्छ्रित: उच्छ्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, produced. 2 High, tall. 2 Lifted up, raised. 4 Prosperous, advancing, increasing, rising. 5 Left, abandoned. 6 Increased in size or bulk, grown. E. उत्, श्रिञ् to serve, क्त aff.
उच्छ्रिति: उच्छ्रिति f. (-तिः) 1 Height, elevation. 2 The upright side of a triangle. E. उत् before श्रि to serve, क्तिन् aff.
उच्छ्रेय: उच्छ्रेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) High, lofty. E. उत् before श्रि to serve, यत् affix.
उच्छूसन: उच्छूसन n. (-नं) 1 Breathing. 2 Sighing. E. उत् before श्वस to breathe, affix ल्युट्.
उच्छूसित: उच्छूसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blown, expanded. 2 Breathed, inspired. 3 Sighing. E. उत् much, &c. श्वसित breathed, blown.
उच्छूस: उच्छूस m. (-सः) 1 Breath, breathing, inspiration. 2 A sigh. 3 Consolation, encouragement. 4 Division of a book. E. उत् up, and श्वस to breathe, घञ् aff.
उज्जयनी: उज्जयनी f. (-नी) Ujjayanī or Oujein, a city so called in Mālava, formerly the capital of VIKRAMĀDITYA. It is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus, and the first meridian of their geographers: the modern Oujein is about a mile south of the ancient city. E. उत् much, जयनी victorious or place of victory; from the military character of its people; also अवन्ती and उज्जयिनी.
उज्जयन्त: उज्जयन्त m. (-न्तः) The name of a mountain, part of the chain in the west of India, part of the Vindhya range: see रैवत. E. उत् priv. and जयन्ति a banner, or जयन्त the son of INDRA.
उज्जयिनी: उज्जयिनी f. (-नी) The city Oujein. E. see उज्जयनी.
उज्जासन: उज्जासन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. उत्। जस to kill, and ल्युट् aff.
उज्जिहीर्षा: उज्जिहीर्षा f. (-र्षा.) Wishing to take or seize. E. उत् before हृ to take, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
उज्जृम्भ: उज्जृम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) 1 Blown, expanded. 2 Open, apart. E. उत् up, and जृभि to gape, अप् aff.
उज्जृम्भित: उज्जृम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blown, expanded. 2 Opened, stretched. n. (-तं) Effort, exertion. E. उत्, जृभि to yawn, क्त aff.
उज्ज्वल: उज्ज्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Luminous, splendid, light. 2 Lovely, beautiful. 3 Clean, clear. 4 Blown, expanded. 5 Burning, blazing. m. (लः) Love, passion. n. (-लं) Gold. E. उत् much, ज्वल् to shine, अच् aff.
उज्ज्वलता: उज्ज्वलता f. (-ता) 1 Splendour, radiance. 2 Beauty. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, उज्ज्वलत्वं.
उज्ज्वलन: उज्ज्वलन m. (-नं) Burning or shining. E. उत् before ज्वल to shine, affs. ल्युट्.
उज्ज्वलित: उज्ज्वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lighted, shining, flaming, &c. E. उत् before ज्वल to shine, affix क्त.
उञ्छ: उञ्छ n. (-ञ्छं) Gathering grains. E. उछि to glean, and घञ् aff.
उञ्छन: उञ्छन n. (-नं) Gathering grains of corn in market places, &c. gleaning. E. उछि to glean, ल्युट् aff.
उञ्छवृत्ति: उञ्छवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) A gleaner, one who lives by gleaning. E. उञ्छ and वृत्ति practice.
उञ्छशिल: उञ्छशिल n. (-लं) Gleaning corn or grains. E. उञ्छ gathering grain, and शिल gleaning corn.
उञ्छशील: उञ्छशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) One who lives by leaning, &c. E. उञ्छ and शील who practices.
उञ्झ: उञ्झ r. 6th cl. (उञ्झति) To quit or abandon. This is some. times read उद्झ्. With प्र, to escape or avoid.
उञ्झ m. (-ञ्झः) Abandoning, leaving. E. उञ्झ and क aff.
उञ्झित: उञ्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, abandoned. 2 Left off, discontinued. E. उञ्झ to leave, affix क्त.
उञ्झितृ: उञ्झितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what leaves. E. उञ्झ and तृच् aff.
उट: उट m. (-टः) Leaves, grass, &c. used in making huts, thatches, &c.
उटज: उटज m. (-जः) 1 A hut made of leaves, the residence of hermits or saints. 2 A house in general. E. उट thatch, &c. and ज made.
उठ: उठ r. 1st cl. (ओठति) To strike or knock down; also ऊठ.
उडु: उडु fn. (-डुः-डु) A lunar mansion or constellation in the moon's path. n. (-डु) Water. E. उत् above, डीङ् to go or fly, डु aff.
उडुप: उडुप mn. (-पः-पं) A raft or float. m. (-पः) The moon. E. उडु as above, and प from पा to preserve, affix ड.
उडुपति: उडुपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. उडु and पति lord.
उडुपथ: उडुपथ m. (-थः) The firmament. E. उडु a constellation, and पथ a path.
उडुम्बर: उडुम्बर m. (-रः) 1 Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) 2 The threshold of a house. 3 A eunuch. 4 A species of leprosy with coppery spots. 5 A kind of worm, supposed to be generated in the blood, and to produce leprosy. n. (-रं) 1 Copper. 2 A Karṣa, a measure of two Tolas. E. उडु a constellation in the second case, वृ to screen, and अप् affix; it is also written उडुम्बर and उटुम्बर.
उडुम्बरपर्णी: उडुम्बरपर्णी f. (-र्णी) The name of a plant: see दन्ती. E. उडुम्बर and पर्ण a leaf: whose leaves are of the color of copper.
उडूप: उडूप mn. (-पः-पं) A raft, a float. m. (-पः) The moon: see उडुप.
उड्डयन: उड्डयन n. (-नं) Flying, soaring. E. उत् before डी to fly, affix ल्युट्.
उड्डामर: उड्डामर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Excellent, respectable, of rank or consequence.
उड्डीन: उड्डीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flown up, flying up. n. (-नं) 1 Flying as a bird. 2 Flying up, soaring. E. उद् up, and डी to fly, क्त aff.
उड्डीयमान: उड्डीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flying, soaring, who flies or soars. E. उत् up, डी to fly, शानच् aff.
उड्डीश: उड्डीश m. (-शः) 1 A work so called, containing charms and incantations. 2 A name of ŚIVA. E. उत् up, and डी to fly, Uṇādi affix श.
उण्डेरक: उण्डेरक m. (-कः) A ball of flour, a roll, a loaf.
उण्डेरकस्रज्: उण्डेरकस्रज् f. (-स्रक्) A string of rolls, balls of meal or flour upon a string. E. उण्डेरक and स्रज a chaplet.
उढ्र: उढ्र m. (-ढ्रः) 1 Water. 2 The China rose.
उत्: उत् ind. An interjection of, 1 asking, (how, what?) 2 of deliberation, (either, or;) 3 of extreme doubt, (hey! what!) 4 Up, above. on, upon; see उद्.
उत: उत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sewn, woven. E. ऊय to sew, affix क्त. Ind. A particle of, 1 doubt, (what!) 2 of interrogation, (what, how?) 3 Of connection, (also, and;) 4 of deliberation, (either, or.) 5 It is also an expletive. E. ऊङ to sound, क्त aff.
उतथ्य: उतथ्य m. (-थ्यः) The name of a Muni, son of AṄGIRAS.
उतथ्यानुज: उतथ्यानुज m. (-जः) A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of the planet Jupiter. E. उतथ्य and अनुज younger born; the younger brother of UTATHYA.
उतथ्यानुजन्मन्: उतथ्यानुजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) VṚHASPATI: see the preceding.
उताहो: उताहो ind. A particle implying, 1 deliberation, (either, or;) 2 asking, (how, what?) E. उत् and आहो meaning as before.
उताहोस्वित्: उताहोस्वित् ind. A particle of doubt or deliberation.
उत्क: उत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) 1 Regretting, sad, sorrowful. 2 Absent, thinking of something else. 3 Wishing for, desirous of. m. (-त्कः) Opportunity, occasion. E. उद् up, away, and कन् aff.
उत्कट: उत्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Much, excessive. 2 Drunk, mad, furious. 3 Proud, haughty. 4 Uneven. 5 Difficult. 6 Superior, high. m. (-टः) 1 Intoxication, pride. 2 An elephant in rut. 3 Sara  grass, (Saccharum sara.) n. (-टं) 1 Woody cassia or its bark. 2 Sarsaparilla. E. उत् high, great, and कटच् aff.
उत्कटुकासन: उत्कटुकासन n. (-नं) Sitting on the hams, squatting.
उत्कण्ठा: उत्कण्ठा f. (-ण्ठा) Regretting, missing any thing or person. E. उत् much, कठि to be sad, अङ् and टाप् affs.
उत्कण्ठित: उत्कण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Regretting, wishing or sorrowing for, distressed, sorrowful. f. (-ता) A woman whose husband or lover is absent. E. उद् much, कठि to be sad, affix क्त.
उत्कता: उत्कता f. (-ता) 1 A plant with aromatic seeds, (Pothos officinalis, Rox.) see गजपिप्पली. 2 Regretting, sorrowing for. E. उत्क regretting, and तल् abstract aff.
उत्कन्धर: उत्कन्धरं ind. Bending back the neck. E. उद् up, कन्धर the neck.
उत्कन्धरं: उत्कन्धरं ind. Bending back the neck. E. उद् up, कन्धर the neck.
उत्कर: उत्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 What lifts or raises. 2 What piles or heaps, what makes up. m. (-रः) A heap, a pile, a stack, &c. E. उत् up, and कर what makes, from कृ and ट or अप् aff.
उत्करिका: उत्करिका f. (-का) A sort of sweetmeat made with milk, treacle, and ghee. E. उत्कर and कन् added.
उत्करीय: उत्करीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating or belonging to a heap, &c. E. उत्कर and छ aff.
उत्कर्तन: उत्कर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting over or on. 2 Cutting to pieces. 3 Cutting off. E. उद् कृत to cut, ल्युट् aff.
उत्कर्त्तन: उत्कर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting over or on. 2 Cutting to pieces. 3 Cutting off. E. उद् कृत to cut, ल्युट् aff.
उत्कर्ष: उत्कर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) 1 Superior, eminent. 2 Much, excessive. 3 Attractive, drawing. m. (-र्षः) 1 Excellence, eminence. 2 Excess. 3 Increase. 4 Pulling, pulling up or to. E. उत् much, कृष to mark, घञ् aff.
उत्कल: उत्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A porter, one who travels with a burden or load. m. (-लः) 1 A country in the south of India, part of Orissa. 2 A fowler, a bird-catcher. E. उत् and कल to go, अच् aff.
उत्कलिका: उत्कलिका f. (-का) 1 Regretting, missing any thing or person. 2 A bud, an unblown flower. 3 A wave. 4 Wanton sportfulness, dalliance. E. उत्, कल to go, वुन and टाप् affs.
उत्कलित: उत्कलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Regretting, grieving for. 2 Prosperous, rising, increasing. E. उत् up, and कल to go or count; part. affix क्त.
उत्काका: उत्काका f. (-का) A cow calving every year. E. उत्क regretting, and अक to go, अच् and टाप् affs.
उत्कार: उत्कार m. (-रः) 1 Winnowing corn. 2 Piling it up. E. उत् up, and कॄ to scatter, घञ् aff.
उत्कारिका: उत्कारिका f. (-का) A poultice. E. उत् before कृ to make, causal form, वुन् aff.
उत्कासन: उत्कासन n. (-नं) Hemming, clearing the throat of mucus. E. उत् up, and कासन coughing.
उत्कुञ्चिता: उत्कुञ्चिता f. (-ता) Kalonji, (Nigella Indica, Rox.) E. उत् up, कुञ्च to go crookedly, क्त affix, or with वुन् affix उत्कुञ्चिका.
उत्कीर्तन: उत्कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Praising, celebrating. 2 Crying, proclaiming. E. उत् before कीर्त्त to praise, ल्युट् aff.
उत्कीर्त्तन: उत्कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Praising, celebrating. 2 Crying, proclaiming. E. उत् before कीर्त्त to praise, ल्युट् aff.
उत्कीर्तित: उत्कीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Praised, renowned. 2 Proclaimed, promulgated. E. उत् aloud, कीर्त्त to praise, क्त aff.
उत्कीर्त्तित: उत्कीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Praised, renowned. 2 Proclaimed, promulgated. E. उत् aloud, कीर्त्त to praise, क्त aff.
उत्कुट: उत्कुट n. (-टं) Sleeping with the head erect. E. उत् neg. and कुट to be crooked, क aff.
उत्कुण: उत्कुण m. (-णः) A bug. E. उत् high, loud, and कुण to call, क affix; also उङ्कुण.
उत्कूट: उत्कूट m. (-टः) An umbrella or parasol. E. उत् priv. कूट to heat, क aff.
उत्कूलित: उत्कूलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought to the bank or shore. E. उद्, कूल a bank, nominative verb, affix क्त.
उत्कृति: उत्कृति f. (-तिः) 1 Cutting up. 2 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of twenty-six syllables each. E. उत् and कृति another metre.
उत्कृत्य: उत्कृत्य ind. Having cut out, off, or up. E. उद् before कृत to cut, ल्यप् aff.
उत्कृत्यमान: उत्कृत्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being cut to pieces. E. उत् before कृत to cut, शानच् aff.
उत्कृष्ट: उत्कृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Excellent, eminent. 2 Superior, best. 3 Much, most, excessive. 4 Drawn, attracted. E. उत् before कृष to drag, क्त aff.
उत्कृष्टता: उत्कृष्टता f. (-ता) Excellence, superiority, eminence. E. उत्कृष्ट with तल् added; also with त्व, उत्कृष्टत्वं.
उत्कृष्टभूम: उत्कृष्टभूम m. (-मः) A good soil. E. उत्कृष्ट excellent, and भूमि earth, अण् aff.
उत्कृष्टवेदन: उत्कृष्टवेदन n. (-नं) The best or most respectable form of marriage. E. उत्कृ and वेदन marrying.
उत्कोच: उत्कोच mf. (-चः-चा) A bribe. E. उत्, कुच to be crooked, क aff.
उत्कोचक: उत्कोचक m. (-कः) 1 The receiver of a bribe. 2 A bribe. E. उद्, कुच् to be crooked, वुन् affix or कन् added to the last.
उत्क्रम: उत्क्रम m. (-मः) 1 Going up or out. 2 Progressive increase. 3 Going astray, acting improperly, deviation, transgression. E. उत् before क्रम to go, अच् aff.
उत्क्रमण: उत्क्रमण n. (-णं) 1 Going up or out. 2 Surpassing, exceeding. E. उत् before क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.
उत्क्रान्त: उत्क्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Passed, surpassed, gone over or beyond. 2 Gone forth or out. 3 Trespassing, exceeding. E. उत् before क्रम to go, affix क्त.
उत्क्रान्तिन्: उत्क्रान्तिन् mfn. (-न्ती-न्तिनी-न्ति) Passing, passing away, gone, departed. E. उत्क्रान्त and इनि aff.
उत्क्राम: उत्क्राम m. (-मः) 1 Opposition, contrariety. 2 Going, going above, surpassing. 3 Going from or out. 4 Deviating from propriety, transgressing. E. उत् out, क्रम to go, घञ् aff.
उत्क्रामत्: उत्क्रामत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) 1 Going over or above, surpassing. 2 Going out. E. उत् before क्रम to go, शतृ aff.
उत्क्रुष्ट: उत्क्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Crying, speaking out or aloud, (who or what does so.) n. (-ष्टं) 1 Crying out, calling, exclaiming. 2 Conversation. E. उत्, क्रुश to cry, क्त aff.
उत्क्रोश: उत्क्रोश m. (-शः) 1 An osprey. 2 Clamour, proclamation. E. उन् loud, कुश to cry, affix घञ्.
उत्क्लेद: उत्क्लेद m. (-दः) Nausea, sickness. E. उत् and क्लेद moisture.
उत्क्लेश: उत्क्लेश m. (-शः) Nausea, sickness. E. उत् before क्लेश distress.
उत्क्षिप्त: उत्क्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Thrown upwards, tossed. 2 Thrown out, ejected. 3 Vomited. 4 Rejected, dismissed. m. (-प्तः) Thorn apple, (Datura metel and fastuosa.) E. उत् up, and क्षिप्त thrown; in the last sense it alludes to the intoxicating qualities of the plant.
उत्क्षिप्तिका: उत्क्षिप्तिका f. (-का) An ornament in the shape of a crescent worn in the upper part of the ear. E. उत् up, क्षिप to send, affix क्तिन्; to which कन् and टाप् are then added.
उत्क्षेप: उत्क्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Throwing or tossing up. 2 Throwing away. 3 Sending, dispatching. 4 Bringing up, vomiting. E. उत् before क्षिपि to throw, घञ् aff.
उत्क्षेपक: उत्क्षेपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Throwing, a thrower, what or who elevates or raises. 2 Who sends or orders. m. (-कः) A stealer of clothes, &c. E. उत् before क्षिप to throw, ण्वुस्त aff.
उत्क्षेपण: उत्क्षेपण n. (-णं) 1 A fan. 2 A kind of basket or bowl used for cleaning corn. 3 Throwing upwards, tossing. 4 Sending, sending away. 5 Vomiting. 6 Taking up. 7 A measure of sixteen Paṇas. E. उत् up, क्षिप to throw or send, ल्युट् aff.
उत्खला: उत्खला f. (-ला) A kind of perfume: see मुरा. E. उत्, खल to gather, अच् and टाप् affs.
उत्खात: उत्खात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eradicated, pulled up by the roots. 2 Destroyed, annihilated. E. उत् up, खन to dig, and क्त aff.
उत्त: उत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Wet, moistened. E. उन्द to wet, affix क्त.
उत्तंस: उत्तंस mn. (-सः) 1 An earring. 2 A crest. E. उत् much, and तसि a Sautra root, to ornament, affix अच्.
उत्तप्त: उत्तप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Burnt, seared. 2 Bathed, washed. 3 Anxious, excited. n. (-प्तं) Dried flesh. E. उत् much, or in the last sense priv. and तप्त heated.
उत्तम: उत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Chief, principal, first, best. 2 Greatest, highest. m. (-मः) 1 The third Menu, son of PRIYAVRATA. 2 The best kind of lover or hero. f. (-मा) 1 An excellent woman: one who is handsome, healthy, and affectionate. 2 A plant. (Asclepias rosea.) E. उत् much, तम to desire, affix अच्.
उत्तमपुरुष: उत्तमपुरुष m. (-षः) 1 The first person, (in grammer.) 2 An excellent man. E. उत्तम and पुरुष man.
उत्तमफलिनी: उत्तमफलिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Asclepias rosea, Rox.) see टुन्धिका. E. उत्तम best, फल fruit, इनि affix, and ङीप् fem. do.
उत्तमर्ण: उत्तमर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) A creditor. E. उत्तम chief, and ऋण a debt.
उत्तमर्णिक: उत्तमर्णिक m. (-कः) A creditor. E. उत्तम, ऋण a debt, and ठक् aff.
उत्तमर्णिन्: उत्तमर्णिन् m. (-र्णी) A creditor. E. उत्तम, ऋण a debt, इनि aff.
उत्तमलाभ: उत्तमलाभ m. (-भः) Great profit, a double return. E. उत्तम and लाभ gain.
उत्तमसंग्रह: उत्तमसंग्रह m. (-हः) Intriguing with another man's wife, addressing her privately, casting amorous looks, &c.
उत्तमसाहस: उत्तमसाहस n. (-सं) 1 The highest of the three fixed mulcts or fines; a fine of 1,000 or of 80,000 Paṇas. 2 Capital punishment, branding, banishment, confiscation, mutilation and death. E. उत्तम the best or greatest, साहस infliction.
उत्तमाङ्ग: उत्तमाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The head. E. उत्तम chief, and अङ्ग member.
उत्तमार्द्ध्य: उत्तमार्द्ध्य n. (-र्द्ध्यं) The best half. E. उत्तम, अर्द्ध half, and यत् aff.
उत्तमाह: उत्तमाह m. (-हः) A fine day, a lucky day. E. उत्तम best, अहन a day, ट aff.
उत्तमोपपद: उत्तमोपपद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Best, good. E. उत्तम and उपपद secondary term, to whom or what the best term is applicable.
उत्तमौजस्: उत्तमौजस् m. (-जाः) A proper name, one of the warriors of the Mahābhārata. E. उत्तम and ओजस् strength.
उत्तम्भन: उत्तम्भन n. (-नं) 1 Upholding, supporting, staying. 2 Stopping, arresting. E. उद् before ष्टभि to stop, ल्युट् aff.
उत्तम्भित: उत्तम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Upheld, supported. 2 Stopped, arrested. 3 Erect, (as the hair of the head,) standing on end. E. उत् before ष्टभि to stop, affix क्त.
उत्तर: उत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Superior, high, lofty. 2 Northern. 3 Best, excellent. 4 (In composition) Fit, appertaining to. 5 Subsequent, posterior. n. (-रं) 1 An answer, a reply. 2 (In law) A defence, a rejoinder. 3 A consequence, a result. 4 Remainder, difference, (in arithmetic.) m. (-रः) 1 The son of VIRĀṬA. f. (-रा) 2 The wife of ABHIMANYU, the son of ARJUNA. 3 The north. E. उत् above, and तर from तृ to pass, affix अप्.
उत्तरकाल: उत्तरकाल m. (-लः) Future time. 2 Time reckoned from full moon to full moon. E. उत्तर subsequent, काल time.
उत्तरकुरु: उत्तरकुरु mn. (-रुः-रु) Uttarakuru, the country about the north pole. E. उत्तर northern, and कुरु the northern part of the globe.
उत्तरकोशला: उत्तरकोशला f. (-ला) The city Ayodhyā, the modern Oude. E. उत्तर north, कोशला a district so called.
उत्तरक्रिया: उत्तरक्रिया f. (-या) Obsequial ceremonies. E. उत्तर last, क्रिया rite.
उत्तरङ्ग: उत्तरङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Flooded, inundated, washed under by waves. n. (-ङ्गं) A wooden arch surmounting the door frame. E. उत्तर above, ग what goes, affix खश्; or उत् and तरङ्ग a wave.
उत्तरज: उत्तरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born subsequently or afterwards, posterity. E. उत्तर and ज born.
उत्तरज्या: उत्तरज्या f. (-ज्या) The versed sine of an arc. E. उत्तर and ज्या an arc.
उत्तरण: उत्तरण n. (-णं) 1 Crossing, rivers, &c. 2 Coming forth or out of, (especially water,) landing. E. उत् over, तरण passing.
उत्तरत्: उत्तरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Crossing, going over. 2 Coming out of (water.) E. उत् before तृ to cross, शतृ aff.
उत्तरतस्: उत्तरतस् ind. 1 Northward. 2 Afterwards. 3 Behind. E. उत्तर and अतसुच् aff.
उत्तरत्र: उत्तरत्र ind. 1 After, subsequent. 2 Northward. E. उत्तर and त्रल् aff.
उत्तरदायक: उत्तरदायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Replying, answering. E. उत्तर and दायक a giver.
उत्तरदिश्: उत्तरदिश् f. (-दिक्) The north quarter. E. उत्तर and दिश् region.
उत्तरधेय: उत्तरधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be done subsequently. E. उत्तर afterwards, धि to have, यत् aff.
उत्तरपक्ष: उत्तरपक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A demonstrated truth, a direct conclusion. 2 Course of argument, according to established truths. 3 Second part of an argument, reply, refutation. 4 The minor proposition in a syllogism. E. उत्तर subsequent, and पक्ष subject of an inference; also adding. क, उत्तरपक्षक.
उत्तरपक्षता: उत्तरपक्षता f. (-ता) 1 Conclusion, demonstration. 2 Replication, reply. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, उत्तरपक्षत्व.
उत्तरपद: उत्तरपद n. (-दं) The last member of a compound word. E. उत्तर and पद word.
उत्तरपदिक: उत्तरपदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to the last word or term. E. उत्तरपद and ठक् affix; also with छ added उत्तरपदकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं.)
उत्तरपाद: उत्तरपाद m. (-दः) A division of legal practice, that part which relates to the reply or defence. E. उत्तर a reply, and पाद a quarter; four divisions being admitted in every suit.
उत्तरपुरुष: उत्तरपुरुष m. (-षः) (In grammar,) The third person. E. उत्तर last, and पुरुष man.
उत्तरप्रच्छद: उत्तरप्रच्छद m. (-दः) A coverlid, a quilt. E. उत्तर and प्रच्छद what covers.
उत्तरफाल्गुनी: उत्तरफाल्गुनी f. (-नी) The twelfth lunar mansion containing two stars, figured by a bed. E. उत्तर subsequent, and फाल्गुनी or फल्गुनी an asterism; hence it also occurs उत्तरफल्गुनी.
उत्तरभाद्रपद्: उत्तरभाद्रपद् f. (-द्) The twenty-seventh lunar mansion, figured by a couch, and comprehending two stars, of which one is α Andromedae. E. उत्तर subsequent, and भाद्रपद properly the constellation; also with a final vowel, उत्तरभाद्रपद्रा.
उत्तरमात्र: उत्तरमात्र n. (-त्रं) Any reply, some reply. E. उत्तर and मात्र only.
उत्तररहित: उत्तररहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unable to reply, having no answer. E. उत्तर and रहित devoid of.
उत्तरलक्षण: उत्तरलक्षण n. (-णं) The indication of an actual reply. E. उत्तर and लक्षण mark.
उत्तरवस्ति: उत्तरवस्ति f. (-स्तिः) A small syringe, a urethra injection pipe. E. उत्तर best, वस्ति syringe.
उत्तरवादिन्: उत्तरवादिन् m. (-दी) A defendant, a replicant. उत्तर a reply, and वादिन् who speaks.
उत्तरसंज्ञित: उत्तरसंज्ञित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Designated in the reply, (a witness, &c.) E. उत्तर and संज्ञित named.
उत्तरसाक्षिन्: उत्तरसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) Witness for the defence. E. उत्तर reply, and साक्षिन् a witness.
उत्तरसाधक: उत्तरसाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Befriending, assisting, a help, a friend. 2 Who or what establishes a reply. E. उत्तर and साधक what accomplishes.
उत्तरा: उत्तरा ind. North, northerly, northward. E. उत्तर and आच् aff.
उत्तरात्: उत्तरात् ind. Northward. E. उत्तर and आति aff.
उत्तराधर: उत्तराधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Superior and inferior, higher and lower. E. उत्तर upper, अधर lower.
उत्तराधिकार: उत्तराधिकार m. (-रः) Right to property, &c. in succession to another person, heirship, inheritance. E. उत्तर and अधिकार right.
उत्तराधिकारिन्: उत्तराधिकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) An heir, a claimant, subsequent to the death, &c. of the original owner. E. उत्तराधिकार and इनि aff.
उत्तराधिकारिता: उत्तराधिकारिता f. (-ता) Right of succession. E. तल् added to उत्तराधिकारिन्; also with त्व, उत्तराधिकारित्व.
उत्तरापथ: उत्तरापथ m. (-थः) The north, a northern road or direction. E. उत्तर and पथिन् a road, the final of उत्तर lengthened.
उत्तराभास: उत्तराभास m. (-सः) A false, indirect, or prevaricating reply, (in law.) E. उत्तर a defence, and आभास what resembles: apparently a defence, but not so in fact.
उत्तराभासता: उत्तराभासता f. (-ता) Inadequacy of a reply, the semblance without the reality. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, उत्तराभासत्वं.
उत्तरायण: उत्तरायण n. (-णं) The period of the sun's progress to the north of the equator, the summer solstice. E. उत्तर the north, and अयन going, progress.
उत्तराशा: उत्तराशा f. (-शा) The north. E. उत्तर and आशा region.
उत्तराशाढा: उत्तराशाढा f. (-ढा) One of the lunar mansions, see उत्तराषाढा.
उत्तराशापति: उत्तराशापति m. (-तिः) A name of KUVERA. E. उत्तर, आशा a quarter, and पति a master; regent of the north.
उत्तराषाढा: उत्तराषाढा f. (-ढा) The twenty-first of the lunar mansions, figured by an elephant's tooth or a bed, and containing two stars, one of which is β in Sagittarius. E. उत्तर subsequent, and आषाढा the constellation; to distinguish it from asterism twentieth: see पूर्व्वाषाढा and आषाढा.
उत्तरासङ्ग: उत्तरासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An upper and outer garment. E. उत्तर upper, आङ् prefixed to षञ्ज to surround, and घञ् aff.
उत्तराहि: उत्तराहि ind. Northerly, from the north, implying distance. E. उत्तर and आहिच् aff.
उत्तरीय: उत्तरीय n. (-यं) An upper or outer garment. E. उत्तर upper, and छ aff.
उत्तरेण: उत्तरेण ind. Northward, posterior, subsequent. E. उत्तर with एनप् aff.
उत्तरेद्युस्: उत्तरेद्युस् ind. A subsequent day, a day following to-morrow. E. उत्तर subsequent, and एद्यस् aff.
उत्तरोत्तर: उत्तरोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) More and more, further and further. &c. n. (-रं) 1 A rejoinder, a reply to an answer. 2 Excess, exceeding quantity or degree. 3 Succession, gradation, descending. E. उत्तर repeated.
उत्तान: उत्तान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Shallow. 2 Sleeping supinely or with the face upwards. 3 Upright. 4 Concave. E. उत् upwards, तन to stretch, and घञ् aff.
उत्तानक: उत्तानक m. (-कः) A species of grass, (a cyperus:) see उच्चटा. E. उत् much, तन to spread, वुज् aff.
उत्तानपाद: उत्तानपाद m. (-दः) 1 A prince, son of SVAYAMBHU the Menu. 2 One of the stars of the little bear, (β Ursi minoris.)
उत्तानपादज: उत्तानपादज m. (-जः) A name of DHRUVA. E. उत्तानपाद, ज born: the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA.
उत्तानशय: उत्तानशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) One who sleeps with the face upwards. mf. (-यः-या) An infant. E. उत्तान and शय who sleeps.
उत्ताप: उत्ताप m. (-पः) 1 Great heat. 2 Affliction, distress. 3 Anxiety, excitement. 4 Effort, energy. E. उत् before तप to be hot, घञ् aff.
उत्तापित: उत्तापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heated, made hot. 2 Pained, distressed. 3 Roused, excited. E. उत् before तप to be hot, causal form, क्त aff.
उत्तार: उत्तार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Excellent, pre-eminent. m. (-रः) 1 Vomiting. 2 Passing away, instability. 3 Ejecting, getting rid. of. E. उत् above, and तार who passes, from तृ and घञ् aff.
उत्तारिन्: उत्तारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Unsteady, changing, shaking. 2 Sick. E. उत्, तृ to go, णिनि affix; or उत्तार and इनि aff.
उत्तार्य: उत्तार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be ejected, to be thrown up by vomiting. E. उत्, तृ to pass, ण्यत् aff.
उत्तार्य्य: उत्तार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be ejected, to be thrown up by vomiting. E. उत्, तृ to pass, ण्यत् aff.
उत्ताल: उत्ताल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Best, excellent. 2 Arduous, difficult. 3 Formidable. 4 Swift, speedy. 5 Lofty, tall. m. (-लः) An ape. E. उत् before तल् to fix, affix घञ्.
उत्तिष्ठामान: उत्तिष्ठामान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Getting up, rising. 2 Increasing, augmenting. E. उत् before स्था to stay शानच् aff.
उत्तीरम्: उत्तीरम् ind. On the bank, ashore. E. उत् and तीर a bank.
उत्तीर्ण: उत्तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Crossed, traversed. 2 Loosed, liberated. 3 Thrown off. E. उत् over, तीर्ण crossed.
उत्तुङ्ग: उत्तुङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) High, lofty, tall. E. उत् very, and तुङ्ग high.
उत्तुङ्गता: उत्तुङ्गता f. (-ता) Height, elevation. E. तल् added to the last, or with त्व, उत्तुङ्गत्वं.
उत्तुण्डित: उत्तुण्डित n. (-तं) The head of a thorn, &c. which has entered the skin. E. उत् before तुडि to hurt, क्त aff.
उत्तुष: उत्तुष m. (-षः) Fried grain. E. उत् priv. and तुष husk.
उत्तेजन: उत्तेजन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Sending, dispatching. 2 urging, driving. 3 Whetting, sharpening, polishing. 4 Exciting, animating. 5 An inspiring or exciting speech. E. उत् and तेजन giving light or energy.
उत्तेजित: उत्तेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, dispatched. 2 Animated, excited. 3 Whetted, sharpened, polished. m. (-तः) Moving in the longe, sidling, one of a horse's five paces. E. उत्, निज to sharpen, and क्त aff.
उत्तेरित: उत्तेरित n. (-तं) A horse's walk, one of his five paces in Hindu jockeyship. E. उत्, तृ to pass, क्त irr. aff.
उत्तोलन: उत्तोलन n. (-नं) Lifting up, raising, elevating. E. उत् and तोलन weighing.
उत्तोलित: उत्तोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Raised, lifted up. E. उत् before तुल to be equal, causal form, क्त aff.
उत्त्यक्त: उत्त्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Abandoned, left. 2 Thrown, tossed. 3 Free from passion or affection. E. उत् and उत्त्यक्त abandoned.
उत्त्याग: उत्त्याग m. (-गः) 1 Abandonment, quitting. 2 Throwing, throwing, up. 3 Secession from worldly feelings. E. उत् and त्याग leaving.
उत्त्रास: उत्त्रास m. (-सः) Fear, terror. E. उत् much, and त्रास fear.
उत्थ: उत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) Standing or being up. E. उत् and स्था to stay, क aff.
उत्थान: उत्थान n. (-नं) 1 Effort, exertion. 2 Manhood, manly exertion. 3 An army. 4 War, battle. 5 A book. 6 Joy, pleasure. 7 Rising, getting up. 8 A court yard. 9 A shed where sacrifices are made. 10 A term, a limit. 11 Evacuating by stool, &c. 12 Business of a family or realm, as the care of subjects or dependants. 13 Reflexion. 14 Proximate cause of disease. E. उत् above, स्था to stand, and ल्युट् affix, स is dropped.
उत्थानैकादशी: उत्थानैकादशी f. (-शी) The eleventh lunation of the light half of Kārttika or Agrahāyaṇa, when VIṢṆU rises from his sleep. E. उत्थान rising, एकादशी eleventh.
उत्थापक: उत्थापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Lifting, causing to get up, who or what raises, &c. 2 Exciting, animating. E. उत् before स्था to stay, causal form, वुन् aff.
उत्थापन: उत्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Raising, elevating. 2 Causing to rise or get up. 3 Exciting, instigating. 4 (In arithmetic) Substitution of a value. E. उत् and स्था causal form, affix ल्युट्.
उत्थापित: उत्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, lifted up, elevated. 2 Made to get up, aroused from a seat, a bed, &c. 3 Instigated. E. उत् and स्था causal form, क्त aff.
उत्थाप्य: उत्थाप्य ind. 1 Having raised or caused to rise. 2 Having roused or instigated. E. उत् before स्था to stay, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
उत्थाय: उत्थाय ind. 1 Having risen (from a seat, &c.) 2 Having risen (in rank, &c.) E. उत् before स्था to stand, affix ल्यप्.
उत्थित: उत्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Endeavouring, striving. 3 Happened, occurring. 4 Increasing, advancing, rising. 5 High, risen or rising as from a seat, &c. E. उत् up, स्था to stay, and क्त aff.
उत्थिताङ्गुलि: उत्थिताङ्गुलि m. (-लिः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. E. उत्थित increased, and अङ्गुलि a finger.
उत्थिति: उत्थिति f. (-तिः) Elevation, rising up. E. उत् before स्था to stay, क्तिन् aff.
उत्पत: उत्पत m. (-तः) 1 A bird. 2 Going upwards, or up. E. उत् up, and पत who goes, from पत to go, and अच् aff.
उत्पतन: उत्पतन n. (-नं) 1 Birth, production. 2 Going up, rising, ascending. E. उत्, पत to go, and ल्युट् aff.
उत्पतितृ: उत्पतितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Jumping up, rising, going upwards. E. उत्पत to rise, and तृच् aff.
उत्पतित: उत्पतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Risen, ascended. E. उत् up, पत to go, क्त aff.
उत्पतिष्णु: उत्पतिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Rising, jumping up. E. उत्पत and इष्णुच् aff.
उत्पत्ति: उत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Birth, production. 2 Producing as an effect or result, giving rise to or generating as a consequence. 3 Production in general. E. उत् up, पत to go, and क्तिन् aff.
उत्पत्तिप्रयोग: उत्पत्तिप्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Purport, meaning. 2 Production by the joint operation of cause and effect. E. उत्पत्ति and प्रयोग act.
उत्पत्तिव्यञ्जक: उत्पत्तिव्यञ्जक m. (-कः) A type of birth, (as investiture.) E. उत्पत्ति and व्यञ्जक figurative indication.
उत्पथ: उत्पथ m. (-थः) Error, bad way, evil. E. उत् from, पथ for पषिन a path.
उत्पथम्: उत्पथम् ind. Astray, on the wrong road. E. उत् from, पथिन a path, अ aff.
उत्पन्न: उत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Known, ascertained. 3 Risen, gone up. 4 Acquired, gained. 5 Effected, accomplished. 6 Occurred, happened. E. उत्, पद to go, क्त aff.
उत्पन्नतन्तु: उत्पन्नतन्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) Having progeny. E. उत्पन्न and तन्तु line; descendants.
उत्पल: उत्पल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Thin. n. (-लं) 1 A blue lotus, (Nymphaea caerulea.) 2 A plant, (a Costus:) see कुष्ठ. 3 A water lily in general. 4 A flower in general. f. (-ली) A kind of cake made with unwinnowed corn. E. उत् up, पल to go or grow, अच् affix, and fem. टाप् or ङीष्.
उत्पलगन्धिक: उत्पलगन्धिक n. (-कं) A species of sandal of the colour of brass, and very fragrant. E. उत्पल the lotus, गन्ध a smell, कन् affix of similitude.
उत्पलचक्षुस्: उत्पलचक्षुस् mfn. (-क्षूः-क्षूः-क्षूः) Lotus-eyed, fine-eyed. E. उत्पल and चक्षुस् the eye.
उत्पलपत्र: उत्पलपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The leaf of the lotus. 2 The impression of a female nail. 3 The Tilaka or mark on the forehead, made with sandal, &c. by the Hindus. 4 A broad bladed knife or lancet. E. उत्पल a lotus, and पत्र a leaf; similarly shaped, &c. also कन् added उत्पलपत्रक.
उत्पलशारिवा: उत्पलशारिवा f. (-वा) A plant, (Echites frutescens.) E. उत्पल a flower, शारिवा irregular deriv. of शृ to harm: whose flower injures or destroys, (disease.)
उत्पलाभ: उत्पलाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Lotus-like, resembling a lotus. E. उत्पल and आङ् before भा to shine, ड aff.
उत्पलिनी: उत्पलिनी f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. उत्पल a lotus, इनि affix, and ङीप् fem. do.
उत्पवन: उत्पवन n. (-नं) 1 Straining liquids before using for domestic or religious purposes. 2 Sprinkling ghee or other fluids on the sacrificial fire, with two blades of Kusa grass, the ends of which are held in either hand, and the centre dipped into the liquid, which is then dropped upon the fire. E. उत् above, &c. पुङ् to purify, affix ल्युट्.
उत्पश्य: उत्पश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Looking up or upwards. E. उत् up, and ग्रश्य looking, irr. formative, from दृश to see.
उत्पाट: उत्पाट m. (-टः) 1 Pulling up by the roots. 2 Destroying. E. उत् up, पट to go, causal form, घञ् aff.
उत्पाटन: उत्पाटन n. (-नं) 1 Eradicating, pulling up by the roots. 2 Destroying. E. उत् before पट to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
उत्पाटित: उत्पाटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eradicated, pulled up by the roots. E. उत् up, or out, पट to go, in the causal form, and क्त aff.
उत्पाटिन्: उत्पाटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) Eradicating, extirpating. E. उत्पाट and इनि aff.
उत्पात: उत्पात m. (-तः) 1 A portent, some natural prodigy or phoenomenon. 2 Any public calamity, as an eclipse, a meteor, an earthquake, &c. E. उत् accidentally, पत to happen, and घञ् aff.
उत्पातवात: उत्पातवात m. (-तः) A whirlwind, a hurricane. E. उत्पात a portent, and वात wind.
उत्पादक: उत्पादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A producer, a generator. 2 What gives origin or production to, causative. m. (-कः) A fabulous animal with eight legs: written also उत्यातकः. n. (-कं) Origin, cause. f. (-दिका) 1 A white ant, (termes.) 2 A potherb, (Hilancha repens.) 3 Also, Basella, (rubra or lucida.) E. उत् much, पद a foot, or पद to go, in the causal, and वुन् aff.
उत्पादन: उत्पादन n. (-नं) Producing, generating, begetting. E. उत् before पद to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
उत्पादशयन: उत्पादशयन mfn. (-नः) The Francoline partridge. E. उत् upon, पाद a foot, शयन sleeping.
उत्पादित: उत्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Produced, effected. 2 Generated, begotten. E. उत् before पद to go, causal form क्त aff.
उत्पाद्य: उत्पाद्य ind. 1 Having begotten. 2 Having produced, having inspired. E. उत् before पद to go, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
उत्पाली: उत्पाली f. (-ली) Health. E. उत् before, पल to preserve, अञ् and ङीष् affs.
उत्पाव: उत्पाव m. (-वः) Purifying ghee, &c. see उत्पवन. E. उत् before पू to make pure, घञ् aff.
उत्पिञ्जर: उत्पिञ्जर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Uncaged, unconfined. E. उत् out of, पिञ्चर a cage; also उत्पिञ्जल, ल being substituted for र.
उत्पिञ्जल: उत्पिञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Confounded, confused. 2 Uncaged. E. see the last.
उत्पित्सु: उत्पित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Desirous of going, going, proceeding. E. उत् before पत to go, desiderative form, उ aff.
उत्पिष्ट: उत्पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ground, rubbed. n. (-ष्टं) A disease, a grating of the bones of the joints upon each other. E. उत and पिष्ट ground.
उत्पीड: उत्पीड m. (-डः) Froth. E. उत् on, पीड to go, क aff.
उत्प्रासन: उत्प्रासन n. (-नं) 1 Ridicule, derision. 2 Hurling, throwing afar. E. उत् and प्र before अस to throw, affix ल्युट्
उत्प्रेक्षा: उत्प्रेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Indifference, carelessness. 2 Ironical comparison. 3 Comparison in general, poetical or rhetorical. E. उत् and प्र prefixed to ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् affs.
उत्प्लवन: उत्प्लवन n. (-नं) Taking up oil or ghee when it has been defiled in any way, by dipping a blade of Kusa grass into it, and dropping it from them upon the fire. 2 Jumping, springing upon. E. उत् over, प्लवन jumping, &c.
उत्प्लवा: उत्प्लवा f. (-वा) A boat. E. उत् over, प्लु to go, अच् and टाप् aff.
उत्प्लुत: उत्प्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Jumped upon, approached suddenly. E. उत् before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
उत्प्लुव्य: उत्प्लुव्य ind. Having sprung or jumped upon. E. उत् before प्लु to go, ल्यप् aff.
उत्फल: उत्फल n. (-लं) Excellent fruit. E. उत् and फल fruit.
उत्फाल: उत्फाल m. (-लः) A jump, a leap. E. उत् and स्फुल to move, affix घञ् the vowel and final changed.
उत्फुल्ल: उत्फुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 1 Blown, as a flower. 2 Swollen, encreased in bulk. 3 Sleeping supinely. E. उत् and फुल्ल blown.
उत्स: उत्स m. (-त्सः) A fountain, a spring. E. उन्द to wet, and स Uṇādi aff.
उत्सङ्ग: उत्सङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The haunch or part above the hip. 2 The acclivity or slope of a hill. 3 Association, union. 4 Embrace. 5 The bottom or deep part of an ulcer. E. उत्, षञ्ज to embrace, affix घञ्.
उत्सङ्गित: उत्सङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Associated, combined, joined. E. उत् षञ्ज before to be joined with, क्त aff.
उत्सङ्गिन्: उत्सङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) Associating or combining with, an associate, a partner. m. (-ङ्गी) An ulcer, a deep sore. f. (-ङ्गिनी) Pimples on the inner edge of the eyelids. E. उत्युङ्ग and इनि aff.
उत्सन्न: उत्सन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Destroyed. overturned. 2 Decayed, in ruins. 3 Risen, increased. E. उत् before षद to go, affix क्त.
उत्सर्ग: उत्सर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Abandoning, quitting. 2 Resigning, retiring from. 3 Giving, donation. 4 Any precept or rule. 5 Presentation of any thing promised to a god or Brahman, with suitable ceremonies. 6 A particular ceremony preparatory to a course of the Vedas. 7 Dejection, excretion, voiding by stool, &c. E. उत् before सृज to quit, to leave, घञ् aff.
उत्सर्जन: उत्सर्जन n. (-नं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Abandoning, leaving, &c. E. उत् before सृज to leave, and ल्युट् affix: see the preceding.
उत्सर्पिणी: उत्सर्पिणी f. (-णी) A Jaina division of time, a long period described as 10 crores of crores of oceans of years; this period alternates with one of similar duration: see अवसर्पिणी. E. उत् much, सृप to go, णिनि and ङीष् affs.
उत्सर्प: उत्सर्प्प m. (-र्प्पः) 1 Going or gliding upwards. 2 Swelling, heaving. E. उत् before सृप to go, घञ् aff.
उत्सर्प्प: उत्सर्प्प m. (-र्प्पः) 1 Going or gliding upwards. 2 Swelling, heaving. E. उत् before सृप to go, घञ् aff.
उत्सर्पण: उत्सर्प्पण n. (-णं) 1 Gliding upward. 2 Swelling, heaving. E. उत् before सृप to go gently, ल्युट् aff.
उत्सर्प्पण: उत्सर्प्पण n. (-णं) 1 Gliding upward. 2 Swelling, heaving. E. उत् before सृप to go gently, ल्युट् aff.
उत्सर्पित: उत्सर्प्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heaving, heaved, undulating. 2 Gliding or going upwards. E. उत् before सृप to go, क्त aff.
उत्सर्प्पित: उत्सर्प्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heaving, heaved, undulating. 2 Gliding or going upwards. E. उत् before सृप to go, क्त aff.
उत्सर्पिन्: उत्सर्प्पिन् mfn. (-र्प्पी-र्प्पिणी-र्प्पि) 1 What glides upwards, 2 Rising gently, heaving, &c. E. उत्सर्प्प and इनि aff.
उत्सर्प्पिन्: उत्सर्प्पिन् mfn. (-र्प्पी-र्प्पिणी-र्प्पि) 1 What glides upwards, 2 Rising gently, heaving, &c. E. उत्सर्प्प and इनि aff.
उत्सर्या: उत्सर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A cow fit to take the bull. E. उत्, सृ to go, and ण्यत् aff.
उत्सर्य्या: उत्सर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A cow fit to take the bull. E. उत्, सृ to go, and ण्यत् aff.
उत्सव: उत्सव m. (-वः) 1 A festival, a jubilee. 2 Height, elevation. 3 Impatience. 4 Wish. 5 Passion, wrath. E. उत्, षू to bear, to bring forth, affix अच्; happiness, &c. is produced by it.
उत्सादन: उत्सादन n. (-नं) 1 Going up, ascending, rising. 2 Raising, elevating. 3 Destroying, overturning. 4 Cleaning the person with perfumes. 5 Rubbing or chafing the limbs. 6 Ploughing a field twice or thoroughly. 7 Healing a sore, causing it to fill up. E. उत् much, षद to destroy, in the causal form, affix ल्युट्.
उत्सादनीय: उत्सादनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be gone up or ascended. 2 To be effected. 3 To be destroyed. n. (-यं) Any application to a sore producing granulations. E. उत् before षद to go, causal form, affix अनीयर्; also उत्सादितव्य and उत्साद्य.
उत्सादित: उत्सादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Risen, ascended. 2 Raised, elevated. 3 Destroyed. 4 Cleansed, purified with oil, perfumes, &c. E. as above, affix क्त.
उत्सारक: उत्सारक m. (-कः) 1 A doorkeeper, a porter. 2 A guard, a guardian. E. उत्, सृ to go, in the causal, and वुन् aff.
उत्सारण: उत्सारण n. (-णं) 1 Removing, keeping at a distance. 2 Moving, causing to move. E. उत्, सृ to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
उत्साह: उत्साह m. (-हः) 1 Effort, perseverance, strenuous and continued exertion. 2 A thread. 3 Happiness. 4 Firmness, fortitude. E. उत् much, सह to bear, to be able, affix घञ्.
उत्साहवत्: उत्साहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Active, energetic, persevering. E. उत्साह and वतुप् aff.
उत्साहवर्द्धन: उत्साहवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Heroism. E. उत्साह exertion, and वर्द्धन increasing, from वृध and ल्युट् aff.
उत्साहसम्पन्न: उत्साहसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Active, persevering. E. उत्साह and सम्पन्न effected.
उत्साहिन्: उत्साहिन् mf. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Active, persevering. E. उत्साह and इनि aff.
उत्सिक्त: उत्सिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Haughty, proud, rude. 2 Elevated, raised. 3 Enlarged, increased. 4 Sprinkled. 5 Disordered, disturbed (in mind, &c.) m. (-क्तः) A king's wrestler. E. उत्, षिच to sprinkle, and क्त aff.
उत्सिच्यमान: उत्सिच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Augmenting, growing. 2 Sprinkling. E. उत्, षिच to sprinkle, शानच् aff.
उत्सुक: उत्सुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Zealously active, making exertions for a gratifying object. 2 Regretting, missing, sorrowing for. 3 Fond of, attached to. E. उत् much, सु to produce, क्विप् and कन् affs.
उत्सुकता: उत्सुकता f. (-ता) 1 Sorrow, regret. 2 Attachment, affection. E. उत्सुक and तल् affix; also with त्व, affix उत्सुकत्वं.
उत्सूत्र: उत्सूत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) 1 Loose, detached, unstrung. 2 Irregular, out of rule. E. उत् before सूत्र a thread, &c.
उत्सूर: उत्सूर m. (-रः) Evening, twilight. E. उत् priv. सूर the sun; sunset.
उत्सृज्य: उत्सृज्य ind. Having quitted. E. उत् before सृज to leave, ल्यप् aff.
उत्सृष्ट: उत्सृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Left, abandoned. 2 Given, presented. 3 Cast into or upon. E. उत् and सृज to leave, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
उत्सृष्टपशु: उत्सृष्टपशु m. (-शुः) A bull set at liberty upon particular occasions, as a marriage, &c. and allowed to go about at will. E. उत्सृष्ट loosed, and पशु an animal.
उत्सेक: उत्सेक m. (-कः) 1 Increase, enlargement. 2 Pride, haughtiness. 3 Casting water, &c. on any thing, sprinkling. 4 Flying out or up, foaming or spouting over, showering. E. उत् on, षिच् to sprinkle, घञ् aff.
उत्सेचन: उत्सेचन n. (-नं) 1 Showering or spouting upwards. 2 Boiling or foaming over. E. उत् and सेचन sprinkling.
उत्सेध: उत्सेध m. (-धः) 1 Height, elevation. 2 The body. 3 Fatness, obesity. 4 Intumescence. 5 Thickness. n. (-धं) Killing, slaughter. E. उत् up, षिध to go, affix घञ्.
उत्स्मय: उत्स्मय m. (-यः) A smile. E. उत् and स्मय a smile.
उद्: उद् or उत् ind. A particle and prefix to words implying, 1 Superiority in degree; (over, above.) 2 In place, (Over, above, on, upon.) 3 Pride: 4 Publicity: 5 Power: 6 Separation, disjunction, (off, from, out of:) 7 Emancipation: 8 Binding. 9 Helplessness, weakness.
उद: उद n. (-दं) Water. E. उन्द to wet, deriv. irr.: see उदक.
उदक्: उदक् ind. Northern, upper, subsequent: see उदच.
उदक: उदक n. (-कं) Water. E. उन्द to wet, deriv. irr.; this is sometimes considered as two words, उद and क, each having the same meaning.
उदकक्रिया: उदकक्रिया f. (-या) Presentation of water to ancestors as far as the fourteenth degree. E. उदक and क्रिया rite; so उदकर्म्म, &c.
उदकद: उदकद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) A giver of water, yielding water, offering water to the manes, &c. m. (-दः) An heir, a near kinsman. E. उदक and द who gives; also उदकदातृ and उदकदायिन्.
उदकदान: उदकदान n. (-नं) Gift of water, especially to the manes, as a religious or obsequial rite. E. उदक and दान giving.
उदकदायिन्: उदकदायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Giving water. m. (-यी) An heir or kinsman, one who presents libations of water. E. उदक and दायिन् who gives.
उदकपूर्वकम्: उदकपूर्व्वकम् ind. Pouring water on the hand as preparatory to or confirmatory of a gift or promise. E. उदक and पूर्व्वक prior.
उदकपूर्व्वकम्: उदकपूर्व्वकम् ind. Pouring water on the hand as preparatory to or confirmatory of a gift or promise. E. उदक and पूर्व्वक prior.
उदकप्रतीकाश: उदकप्रतीकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Watery, fluid like water. E. उदक and प्रतीकाश what resembles.
उदकमेह: उदकमेह m. (-हः) A variety of Diabetes, passing watery urine. E. उदक and मेह urining.
उदकशाक: उदकशाक n. (-कं) Any aquatic herb. E. उदक and शाक a potherb.
उदकस्पर्श: उदकस्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः) 1 Touching different parts of the body with water. 2 Touching water in confirmation of a promise, &c. E. उदक and स्पर्श touch.
उदकाधार: उदकाधार m. (-रः) A reservoir, a cistern, a well, &c. E. उदक and आधार receptacle.
उदकार्थिन्: उदकार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Thirsty, desirous of water. E. उदक and अर्थिन् who seeks.
उदकीर्य: उदकीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A plant, (Galedupa arborea, &c.) see करञ्जक. E. उद water, and कॄ to scatter, अच् aff.
उदकीर्य्य: उदकीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A plant, (Galedupa arborea, &c.) see करञ्जक. E. उद water, and कॄ to scatter, अच् aff.
उदकुम्भ: उदकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A water jar. E. उद and कुम्भ a jar; also उदककुम्भ.
उदकोदञ्जन: उदकोदञ्जन m. (-नः) A water jar. E. उकक and उदञ्चन what goes up.
उदकोदर: उदकोदर n. (-रं) Dropsy. E. उदक् and उदर the belly.
उदक्त: उदक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Gone up, risen, ascended. E. उद before अञ्च to go, क्त aff.
उदक्या: उदक्या f. (-क्या) A woman in her courses. E. उदक water, and यत् affix of fitness: requiring water for purification.
उदगद्रि: उदगद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The Himālaya mountains on the north of Hindustan. E. उदक north, and अद्रि a mountain.
उदगयन: उदगयन n. (-नं) The sun's progress north of the equator: see उत्तरायण. E. उदक् north, and अयन going.
उदग्भूम: उदग्भूम m. (-मः) Good soil. E. उदक् north, भूमि earth, अण् aff.
उदग्भूमि: उदग्भूमि m. (मिः) Fertile soil: see the preceding.
उदग्र: उदग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 High, tall. 2 Large, vast. 3 Projecting. 4 Pointing upwards. 5 Fierce, intense. E. उत् up, and अग्र end, point.
उदग्रदत्: उदग्रदत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Large toothed. m. (-दन्) An elephant with a large tusk. E. उदग्र large, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
उदङ्मुख: उदङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खा-खं) Facing the north. E. उदच् and मुख face.
उदच्: उदच् or उदञ्च् mfn. (उदङ् उदीची उदक्) 1 North, northern. 2 Upper, upwards. 3 Subsequent, posterior. f. (-दीची) The north. E. उद् up, अञ्च to go, affix क्विप्; the neuter is used as a particle: see उदक्; the noun is irregular.
उदज: उदज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatic, watery, produced in or by water. m. (-जः) Driving cattle. E. उद water, and ज born, or उद् up, and अज to go, affix अप्.
उदञ्चन: उदञ्चन n. (-नं) 1 A lid or cover. 2 Directing or throwing upwards. 3 Rising, ascending. E. उद above, अञ्च to go, and ल्युट् aff.
उदञ्चित: उदञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thrown up, tossed. 2 Worshipped. E. उद् up, अञ्च to go or worship, affix क्त.
उदण्डपाल: उदण्डपाल m. (-लः) 1 A kind of fish. 2 A sort of snake. E. उद् much, अण्ड an egg, and पाल what nourishes; laying many eggs at once.
उदधि: उदधि m. (-धिः) 1 The ocean. 2 A water jar. 2 A cloud. E. उद् water, and धि having, from धा, with कि aff.
उदधिक्रम्: उदधिक्रम् m. (-क्राः) A voyager, a mariner. E. उदधि, क्रम to go, विट् aff.
उदधिमल: उदधिमल m. (-लः) Cuttle fish bone. E. उदधि and मल soil.
उदधिमेखला: उदधिमेखला f. (-ला) The earth. E. उदधि and मेखला a girdle.
उदधिसुता: उदधिसुता f. (-ता) 1 LAKṢMĪ. 2 Dvārakā, the capital of KṚṢṆA. E. उदधि the ocean, and सुता daughter.
उदन्त: उदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A pure and virtuous man. 2 Tidings, intelligence. 3 One who gets a livelihood by a trade, &c. E. उद् disjunctive, and अन्त end, term.
उदन्तक: उदन्तक m. (-कः) News, tidings, intelligence. E. कन् added to the preceding.
उदन्तिका: उदन्तिका f. (-का) Satisfaction, satiety. E. उद् complete, अन्त end, कन् aff.
उदन्या: उदन्या f. (-न्या) Thirst. E. उदक् water, क्यच् affix, the final क is changed to न.
उदन्वत्: उदन्वत् m. (-न्वान्) The ocean. E. उद् water, and मतुप् possessive aff.
उदपात्र: उदपात्र n. (-त्रं) A water cup, a ewer. E. उद् and पात्र a vessel.
उदपान: उदपान mn. (-नः-नं) 1 A well. E. उद् water, पा to drink, and ल्युट् affix; the place where water is drunk.
उदपेष: उदपेष n. (-षं) A paste, any thing ground with water. E. उद and पेष grinding.
उदभार: उदभार m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 A water carrier. E. उद and भार a load.
उदमन्थ: उदमन्थ m. (-न्थः) Barley water. E. उद and मन्थ scum; also, उदकमन्थ.
उदमेघ: उदमेघ m. (-घः) A watery cloud. E. उद and मेघ a cloud.
उदय: उदय m. (-यः) 1 The rising of the sun and planets in general. 2 The eastern mountain, behind which the sun is supposed to rise. 3 Rising, ascending. 4 Light, splendor. 5 Prosperity, good fortune. 6 Creation, the rising of the world. 7 (In law) Income. E. उद् up, इण to go, and अच् aff.
उदयन: उदयन n. (-नं) Rising, ascending. m. (-नः) 1 A name of AGASTYA: see अगस्त्य. 2 The name of a sovereign, king of Kauśāmbī, and hero of the Vāsavadattā, a dramatic poem; also, of part of the Vṛhat Kathā. E. उद् above, इण to go, and ल्युट् aff.
उदयपर्वत: उदयपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The eastern mountain behind which the sun rises. E. उदप and पर्ब्वत a mountain; also similar compounds, as उदयगिरिः, उदयशैलः, उदयाचलः, उदयाद्रिः, &c.
उदयपर्व्वत: उदयपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The eastern mountain behind which the sun rises. E. उदप and पर्ब्वत a mountain; also similar compounds, as उदयगिरिः, उदयशैलः, उदयाचलः, उदयाद्रिः, &c.
उदयिन्: उदयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Rising, ascending. 2 Prosperous, flourishing. E. उदय and इनि aff.
उदर: उदर n. (-रं) 1 The belly. 2 War. 3 Any morbid abdominal affection, as liver, spleen, &c. f. (-री) Enlargement of the abdomen from dropsy or flatulency. E. उद् up, ऋ to go, अप् affix; what goes up or swells with food, slaughter, &c. or उद् prefixed to दृ to burst, and अच् or अल् Uṇādi aff.
उदरक: उदरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Rubbing the belly, &c. 2 Abdominal. E. उदर and कन् aff.
उदरग्रन्थि: उदरग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) The spleen, (the disease; a chronic affection of this organ not uncommon in India.) E. उदर abdomen, and ग्रन्थि a knot.
उदरत्राण: उदरत्राण n. (-णं) 1 A cuirass, armour covering the front. 2 A girth, a belly band. E. उदर the belly, and त्राण what preserves: see उदरस्त्राण.
उदरथि: उदरथि m. (-थिः) 1 The ocean. 2 The sun. E. उद् freely, ऋ to go, and अथिर् Uṇādi aff.
उदरपिशाच: उदरपिशाच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) A glutton, voracious, one who devours every thing, flesh, fish, &c. E. उदर and पिशाच a demon, who is a devil for his belly.
उदरम्भरि: उदरम्भरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Selfishly voracious, gluttonous. E. उदर, भृ to nourish, इन् affix, and मुम् is inserted.
उदरशय: उदरशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sleeping on the face or belly. E. उदर and शय who sleeps.
उदरामय: उदरामय m. (-यः) Dysentery, diarrhoea. E. उदर the belly, and आमय sickness.
उदरावर्त: उदरावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The navel. E. उदर and आवर्त्त whirl.
उदरावर्त्त: उदरावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The navel. E. उदर and आवर्त्त whirl.
उदरावेष्ट: उदरावेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Tape worm. E. उदर and आवेष्ट what surrounds.
उदरिन्: उदरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Fat, corpulent. 2 Abdominal. f. (-णी) A pregnant woman. E. उदर the belly, इनि possessive aff.
उदरिल: उदरिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fat, corpulent. E. उदर to belly, and इलच् aff.
उदर्क: उदर्क m. (-कः) 1 Future or remote consequence. 2 Future time. 3 A plant, (Vangueria spinosa:) see मदन. E. उद् much, ऋच् to praise, affix घञ्.
उदर्चिस्: उदर्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि) Luminous and ascending. m. (-र्च्चिः) 1 A name of VAHNI or fire. 2 ŚIVA. 3 KANDARPA. E. उद upwards, and अर्च्चिस् flame.
उदर्च्चिस्: उदर्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि) Luminous and ascending. m. (-र्च्चिः) 1 A name of VAHNI or fire. 2 ŚIVA. 3 KANDARPA. E. उद upwards, and अर्च्चिस् flame.
उदर्द: उदर्द m. (-र्दः) Erysipelas. E. उद् up, अर्द to go, अच् aff.
उदर्द्ध: उदर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) Scarlet fever. E. उद and ऋध to increase, अच् aff.
उदलावणिक: उदलावणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Salted, prepared with brine. E. उद water, लवण salt, and ठक् aff.
उदवज्र: उदवज्र m. (-ज्रः) A thunderbolt of water, a water spout. E. उद and वज्र a thunderbolt.
उदवसित: उदवसित n. (-तं) A house. E. उद water, and वसित covered, defended, deriv. irr.
उदवास: उदवास n. (-सं) 1 A house in the margin of a stream or pond. 2 A marine grotto, &c. E. उद् and वास a bode.
उदवाहन: उदवाहन m. (-नः) 1 A cloud. 2 Any water vessel. E. उद and वाहन vehicle.
उदविन्दु: उदविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A drop of water. E. उद and विन्दु a drop.
उदश्वित्: उदश्वित् n. (-श्वित्) Buttermilk, with an equal proportion of water. E. उद water, श्वि to increase, affixes क्विप् and तुक्.
उदस्त: उदस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Cast, thrown. 2 Expelled, cast out. 3 Cast up. 4 Humbled, shamed. 5 Scattered. 6 Removed. E. उद् before अस to throw, क्त aff.
उदस्थाली: उदस्थाली f. (-ली) A caldron, a kettle. E. उद and स्थाली a pot.
उदस्य: उदस्य ind. 1 Having taken pains, made an effort, &c. 2 Having thrown, having cast up or tossed. 3 Having scattered. 4 Having expelled. E. उद् before अस to be or throw, ल्यप् aff.
उदहार: उदहार m. (-रः) 1 A water carrier. 2 A cloud. E. उद् and हार who takes.
उदाज: उदाज m. (-जः) Commanding, directing bodies of men. E. उद before अज to go, घञ् aff.
उदात्त: उदात्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Generous, gentle and bountiful. 2 Giving, a donor. 3 Great, illustrious. 4 Dear, beloved. 5 Accented. m. (-त्तः) 1 The acute accent, a high or sharp tone. 2 Gift, donation. 3 A musical instrument, a large drum. 4 An ornament, (in rhetoric.) E. उद high, up, and आत्त pronounced, sounded; or from दा, to give or have, with आङ् prefixed, affix क्तः see अनुदात्त.
उदान: उदान m. (-नः) 1 One of the five vital airs, that which rises up the throat and passes into the head. 2 The navel. 3 A snake. 4 An eye-lash. E. उद् above, आङ् prefixed to अण् to breathe, to be, affix घञ्.
उदार: उदार mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Generous, liberal, munificent. 2 Great. 3 Unperplexed. 4 Gentle. 5 Upright, honest, sincere. 6 Eloquent. 7 Proper, right. E. उद् well, आङ् prefixed to ऋ to go, and अप् affixed.
उदारचेतस्: उदारचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) High-minded, magnanimous. E. उदार and चेतस् the mind.
उदारधी: उदारधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Wise, sagacious, noble-minded. E. उदार and धी Understanding.
उदावत्सर: उदावत्सर m. (-रः) A year, one of the five sorts of years astrologically considered. E. उद् and आङ् before वत्सर a year.
उदावर्त: उदावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A disease of the bowels, iliac passion. f. (-ता) Difficult menstruation. E. उद् upper, आवर्त्त abode.
उदावर्त्त: उदावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A disease of the bowels, iliac passion. f. (-ता) Difficult menstruation. E. उद् upper, आवर्त्त abode.
उदास: उदास m. (-सः) 1 Throwing or directing upwards. 2 Elevation, being above or over. 3 A stoic, a philosopher. 4 Stoicism. mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Indifferent, unconcerned, apathetic. E. उद् and आस who casts.
उदासितृ: उदासितृ mfn. (-ता-त्रै-तृ) Indifferent, disregarding, void of concern or affection. E. उद् before आस to cast, तृच् aff.
उदासिन्: उदासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Indifferent, disregarding, m. (-सी) A stoic, a philosopher, one who has no passion nor affection for any thing: in popular acceptation, a religious mendicant in general, or one of a particular order. E. उदास and इमि aff.
उदासीन: उदासीन mfn. (नः-ना-नं) 1 Indifferent, free from affection. (In law) One not involved in the dispute. m. (-नः) A stranger, a neutral, a common acquaintance, a person neither a friend nor a foe. E. उद् above, आसीन seated.
उदास्थित: उदास्थित m. (-तः) 1 A spy, an emissary. 2 A doorkeeper. 3 A superintendent. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Set over. E. उद् over, आङ् before स्था to stay, affix क्त.
उदाहरण: उदाहरण n. (-णं) 1 An example or illustration, an apposite argument, one of five modes of logical reasoning. 2 Declaring, saying. E. उद् over, आङ् before हृ to convey, and ल्युट् affix, or with घञ् affix उदाहार.
उदाहृत: उदाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Called, named, entitled. 2 Said. 3 Illustrated. E. उद् and आङ् before हृ to take, affix क्त.
उदित: उदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, spoken. 2 Bound, tied. 3 Risen, ascended. 4 Grown, augmented. 5 Born, produced. 6 Incurred, experienced. 7 High, tall, lofty. E. वद to speak, and क्त affix; or उद् up, and इत gone, past part. of इण to go.
उदितोदित: उदितोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well acquainted with the Śāstras. E. उदित said, (by law and religion,) and उदित risen, &c. eminent.
उदीक्षण: उदीक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Seeing, beholding. 2 Looking up. E. उद् and ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
उदीक्ष्य: उदीक्ष्य ind. Having seen. E. उद् and ईक्ष to see, ल्यप् aff.
उदीचि: उदीचि f. (-ची) The north: see उदच.
उदीचीन: उदीचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Northern. E. उदच north, खः aff.
उदीच्य: उदीच्य m. (-च्यः) The country to the north and west of the river Sarasvatī, the northern region. n. (-च्यं) A perfume: see वाला. E. उदीची the north, and यत् aff.
उदीरण: उदीरण n. (-णं) Speaking, saying. E. उद् up, out, ईर to go, and ल्युट् aff.
उदीरित: उदीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, uttered. E. उद् and ईर to go, affix क्त.
उदीर्ण: उदीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Generous, great, excellent. 2 Intense. E. उद् above, ऋ to go, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
उदीर्णवेग: उदीर्णवेग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Impetuous (as a torrent), violent. E. उदीर्ण and वेग speed.
उदीर्य: उदीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spoken. E. उद before ईर to go, यत् aff.
उदीर्य्य: उदीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spoken. E. उद before ईर to go, यत् aff.
उदीर्यमाण: उदीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Speaking. 2 Spoken. E. उद् before ईर to go, शानच् aff.
उदीर्य्यमाण: उदीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Speaking. 2 Spoken. E. उद् before ईर to go, शानच् aff.
उदुम्बर: उदुम्बर m. (-रः) 1 The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata.) 2 A kind of leprosy. 3 A threshold. 4 A eunuch. n. (-रं) Copper; see उडुम्बर, it is also written ऊडुम्बर.
उदुम्बरपर्णी: उदुम्बरपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant: see दन्तिका; also उडुम्बरपर्णी and ऊडुम्बरपर्णी.
उदूखल: उदूखल n. (-लं) A gum-resin, Bdellium. mn. (-लः-लं) 1 A wooden mortar used for freeing rice from the husk, by pounding it with a pestle. 2 Any mortar. E. उदू for उद् up, and खल what goes, affix अच्; also उडूखल and उलूखल.
उदूढ: उदूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Married. 2 Coarse, gross, heavy. 3 Material, substantial. 4 Much, exceeding. E. उद् up, वह to bear, and क्त affix, deriv. irr.
उदेजय: उदेजय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Shaking, making tremble. E. उद before एज to tremble, श aff.
उद्ग: उद्ग r. 6th cl. (उद्गति) To cast off or quit.
उद्गत: उद्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Risen, ascended. 2 Vomited, cast up. 3 Departed, gone. 4 Proceeded forth or from. E. उद् up, and गत gone.
उद्गता: उद्गता f. (-ता) A stanza of four lines, with ten syllables in the three first, and thirteen in the last.
उद्गतासु: उद्गतासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Deceased, dead. E. उद्गत gone, असु breath.
उद्गति: उद्गति f. (-तिः) 1 Going up, rising, ascending. 2 Bringing up, vomiting. E. उद् and गति going.
उद्गम: उद्गम m. (-मः) 1 Going up, rising, ascending. 2 Bringing up, vomiting; also उद्गमनं. E. उद् up, गम or गमन going.
उद्गमनीय: उद्गमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be gone up, or ascended. n. (-यं) A pair of bleached clothes. E. उद् up, गम to go, and अनीयर् aff.
उद्गाढ: उद्गाढ n. adv. (-ढं) or adj. mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Much, excessive. E. उद् excess, and गाढ much.
उद्गातृ: उद्गातृ m. (-ता) A reciter of the prayers, &c. of the Sāma Veda. E. उद् up, and गातृ who sings, (the prayers being chaunted,) from गै to sing, and तृच् aff.
उद्गाथा: उद्गाथा f. (-था) A variety of the Arya measure, the same as the Gīti, a stanza of four lines containing alternately 12 and 18 instants.
उद्गार: उद्गार m. (-रः) 1 Vomiting. 2 Ejecting any thing from the mouth. 3 Sound. 4 Speaking in the throat. E. उद् up, गॄ to vomit, &c. घञ् aff.
उद्गिरण: उद्गिरण n. (-णं) 1 Vomiting. 2 Ejecting any thing, as saliva, &c. from the mouth. E. उद् before गॄ to vomit, ल्युट् affix; also उद्गारणं.
उद्गीति: उद्गीति f. (-तिः) A variety of the Arya metre, a verse of four lines containing 12, 15--12, and 14 feet.
उद्गीथ: उद्गीथ m. (-थः) 1 A portion of the Sāma Veda. 2 Designation of the triliteral name of God. 3 Chaunting the Sāma Veda. E. उद् up, aloud, गै to sing, and थक् Uṇādi aff.
उद्गुर्ण: उद्गुर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Raised, lifted, held up. 2 Erected. 3 Excited. E. उद् up, गुर to make effort, irr. participle past.
उद्ग्रह: उद्ग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Taking up. 2 An object that may be accomplished by religious or other acts. E. उद् before ग्रह to take, अच् aff.
उद्ग्रहण: उद्ग्रहण n. (-णं) Taking up, lifting up. E. उद and ग्रहण taking.
उद्ग्राह: उद्ग्राह m. (-हः) 1 Taking up. 2 Replying in argument. E. उद् up, ग्रह to take, and घञ् aff.
उद्ग्राहित: उद्ग्राहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Excellent, exalted. 2 Bound, tied. 3 Seized. 4 Deposited, delivered. 5 Taken or lifted up. 5 Recalled, remembered. E. उद् up, and ग्राहित taken.
उद्घ: उद्घ m. (-द्घः) Excellence, happiness. E. उद much, घण to shine, affix ड or उद before हन to strike, अप् aff. and the final rejected.
उद्घन: उद्घन m. (-नः) A carpenter's work-bench, a plank on which he works. E. उद् above, हन to injure, अप् affix, ह changed to घ.
उद्घट्टन: उद्घट्टन n. (-नं) Opening, opening up as a lid. E. उद् up, and घट्टन fastening.
उद्घट्टित: उद्घट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Opened, unlocked. E. उद up, and घट्टित fastened.
उद्घर्षण: उद्घर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Rubbing, rubbing up. 2 Rubbing the skin with hard substances, as vitrified brick, &c. E. उद् and घर्षण friction.
उद्घस: उद्घस n. (-सं) Flesh. E. उद, घस substituted, for अद to eat, affix अप्; what is eaten.
उद्घाट: उद्घाट m. (-टः) A watch or guard house. E. उद up, घट to endeavour, &c. घञ् aff.
उद्घाटक: उद्घाटक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A key. 2 A bucket, &c. see the next. 3 An opener, the instrument or agent of opening any thing.
उद्घाटन: उद्घाटन n. (-नं) 1 The rope and bucket of a well, a leather bucket used for drawing water. 2 Opening, unlocking. 3 An opener, the instrument or means of opening, a key, &c. 4 Hosting, raising, lifting up. E. उद up, घट to strive, affix ल्युट्; also with वुञ् affix उद्घाटक.
उद्घाटित: उद्घाटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done with effort, exerted. 2 Opened. 3 Raised, hoisted or lifted up. E. उद much, घट to exert, affix क्त.
उद्घाटितज्ञ: उद्घाटितज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Wise, intelligent. E. उद् much, घट to endeavour, affix क्त, and ज्ञ who knows.
उद्घाटिताङ्ग: उद्घाटिताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Intelligent. 2 Naked. E. उद्घाटित and अङ्ग the body.
उद्घात: उद्घात m. (-तः) 1 A beginning, a thing begun. 2 A weapon. 3 A club, a mallet. 4 Striking, wounding, inflicting a hurt. 5 A wound, a blow. 6 The division of a book, a chapter, a section. 7 Breathing through the nostrils as a religious exercise. 8 Slipping, tripping. 9 High, tall. E. उद before हन to kill or destroy, and घञ् affix, त is substituted for न.
उद्ज: उद्ज r. 6th cl. (उज्जति) To be straight: see उज्ज.
उद्घुष्ट: उद्घुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sounded out. E. उद before घुष् to sound, affix क्त.
उद्दंश: उद्दंश m. (-शः) A bug. E. उद् much, and दंश who bites, from दशि and अच् aff.
उद्दण्ड: उद्दण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Raised on a staff or pole. E. उद and दण्ड a stick.
उद्दण्डपाल: उद्दण्डपाल m. (-लः) 1 A sort of snake. 2 A kind of fish. 3 A punisher, whether king or magistrate. E. उद् above, दण्डपाल a punisher.
उद्दन्तुर: उद्दन्तुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 High, tall. 2 Terrific, formidable. 3 Large toothed. E. उद high, long, and दन्तुर large toothed.
उद्दान: उद्दान n. (-णं) 1 Binding, confinement. 2 Taming, subduing. 3 A fire place. 4 Submarine fire. 5 The middle, the waist. 6 The entrance of the sun into a sign of the zodiac. E. उद reverse, and दा to give, affix ल्युट्.
उद्दान्त: उद्दान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Energetic. 2 Humble. 3 Elevated. 4 Vomited by an elephant. E. उद and दान्त tamed.
उद्दाम: उद्दाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Set free, unbound. 2 Unconstrained, self-willed. 2 Large, great. 4 Proud, haughty. m. (-मः) A name of VARUṆA. E. उद priv. दम to tame, and घञ् aff.
उद्दाल: उद्दाल m. (-लः) 1 A plant, (Cordia myxa or latifolia.) 2 A kind of grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.) E. उद high, large दल to pierce, affix घञ्; also उद्दालक, क being added.
उद्दित: उद्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, tied. E. उद up, दो to cut, and क्त affix; also उदित.
उद्दिन: उद्दिन n. (-नं) 1 Mid-day. 2 Every day. E. उद् and दिन day.
उद्दिश्य: उद्दिश्य ind. 1 Having shewn or explained. 2 Stipulating for, demanding. E. उद्, दिश to show, य aff.
उद्दिष्ट: उद्दिष्ट mf. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Mentioned, particularised, described. 2 Promised. E. उद् before दिश to show, affix क्त.
उद्दीप: उद्दीप n. (-पं) A gummy and resinous substance, Bdellium. m. (पः) 1 Inflaming, lighting. 2 An inflamer. 3 Animating, or who or what animates. E. उद्, दीप to shine, क aff.
उद्दीपक: उद्दीपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Exciting, inflaming, rendering more intense. 2 Lighting, setting alight. E. उद् and दीपक what lights.
उद्दीपन: उद्दीपन n. (-नं) 1 Exciting, inflaming a passion. 2 Illuminating. 3 Burning of a body, &c. 4 Any aggravating thing or circumstance, calculated to give poignancy to feeling or passion. E. उद् much, दीप to inflame, ल्युट् aff.
उद्दीपमान: उद्दीपमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lighting up, brightening, becoming light. E. उद before दीप and शानच् aff.
उद्दीप्त: उद्दीप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Lighted, set on fire or alight. 2 Inflamed, aggravated, as passion. E. उद् and दीप्त lighted.
उद्दीप्र: उद्दीप्र n. (-प्रं) Bdellium. E. उद् before दीप to shine, रक aff.
उद्देश: उद्देश m. (-शः) 1 Illustration, explanation, exemplification. 2 Search, enquiry. 3 Stipulation, bargain. 4 An object, a motive. mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Relative to. E. उद् and देश showing.
उद्देशक: उद्देशक mf. (-कः-का-कं) What explains or shows, illustrative, explanatory. m. (-कः) 1 An illustration, an example. 2 An illustrator. 3 A guide. E. उद् before दिश to show, वुन् aff.
उद्देश्य: उद्देश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) To be illustrated or explained. E. उद्, दिश to show, ण्यत् aff.
उद्देहिका: उद्देहिका f. (-का) The white ant, termes; also उत्यादिका.
उद्द्योत: उद्द्योत m. (-तः) Light, lustre. E. उद्, द्युत to shine, aff.
उद्द्राव: उद्द्राव m. (-वः) 1 Flight, retreat. 2 Going upwards. E. उद् up, द्रु to run, and घञ् aff.
उद्द्रुत: उद्द्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-त) 1 Fled, retreated, run away. 2 Ascended, gone up or upwards. E. उद् and द्रुत gone.
उद्धत: उद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rude, ill behaved. 2 Haughty, vain, puffed up. 3 Raised, elevated. 4 Excited, intense. m. (-तः) A king's wrestler. E. उद् above, हन to hurt or injure, affix क्त; ह becomes घ.
उद्धतमनस्क: उद्धतमनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Haughty, proud, high minded. E. उद्धत raised, मनस्क minded.
उद्धतमनस्कत्व: उद्धतमनस्कत्व n. (-त्वं) Pride, arrogance. E. उद्धत, मनस्क having a mind, and त्व abstract aff.
उद्धति: उद्धति f. (-तिः) 1 Pride, haughtiness. 2 Elevation. E. उद् before हन to strike, affix क्तिन्.
उद्धम: उद्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Who or what blows. m. (मः) 1 Breathing hard, panting. 2 Blowing, sounding. E. उद् before ध्मा to blow, affix श.
उद्धय: उद्धय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who or what drinks. E. उद् before धे to drink, श aff.
उद्धर्तृ: उद्धर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) 1 Who raises or lifts up. 2 A sharer, a coheir. 3 Who recovers property. E. उद् before हृ to take, तृन् aff.
उद्धर्त्तृ: उद्धर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) 1 Who raises or lifts up. 2 A sharer, a coheir. 3 Who recovers property. E. उद् before हृ to take, तृन् aff.
उद्धरण: उद्धरण n. (-णं) 1 Raising or lifting any thing. 2 Eradicating a tree, &c. 3 Exterminating, destroying. 4 Taking a part or share. 5 Vomiting, bringing up. 6 Final emancipation. E. उद् up, हृ to take, and ल्युट् aff.
उद्धरणीय: उद्धरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be raised up. 2 To be given up. E. उद् before हरणीय to be taken.
उद्धर्ष: उद्धर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 A festival, especially religious. 2 Great joy. E. उद् much, हर्ष happiness.
उद्धर्षण: उद्धर्षण n. (-णं) Erection of the hair of the body. E. उद् much, हृष to be happy, and ल्युट् affix; occasioned by great pleasure.
