उद्धव: उद्धव m. (-वः) 1 A festival, a holiday. 2 Sacrificial fire. 3 The name of a person, the friend and councillor of KṚṢṆA. E. उद् reverse, धु to feel pain, घञ् aff.
उद्धान: उद्धान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Gone up, ascended. 2 Vomited. n. (-नं) A furnace or fire place. E. उद, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.
उद्धान्त: उद्धान्त mfn. (-त्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Vomited. m. (-न्तः) An elephant out of rut. E. उद् up, and ध्मा to breathe or blow, affix क्त.
उद्धार: उद्धार m. (-रः) Raising, elevating, lifting up. 2 Debt, especially a debt not bearing interest. 3 A portion, a share. 4 A deduction, a part to be set aside. 5 Recovering property. 6 Extracting, quoting. n. (-रं) A fire place. f. (-रा) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum): see गुडूची. E. उद् up, धृ to have, घञ् aff.
उद्धारक: उद्धारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what raises or lifts. E. उद् before हृ to take, वुञ् aff.
उद्धारण: उद्धारण n. (-णं) 1 Raising, elevating. 2 Sharing, dividing. E. उद् before धृ to have, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
उद्धारविभाग: उद्धारविभाग m. (-गः) Partition, division of shares. E. उद्धार and विभाग dividing.
उद्धुर: उद्धुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Heavy. 2 Thick, gross. 3 Firm. E. उद् and धुर a burden.
उद्धूत: उद्धूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken off, fallen from or off. 2 Tossed up, scattered above. E. उद् and धूत trembling.
उद्धूषण: उद्धूषण n. (-णं) Horripilation. E. उद् up, धूष to shine, ल्युट् aff.
उद्धृत: उद्धृत mfn. (तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, drawn up, as water from a well, &c. 2 Pulled up or out, eradicated or broken off. 3 Lifted up. 4 Raised, elevated. 5 Thrown up or upwards. 6 Vomited. 7 Separated, set apart. 8 Divided, partitioned. 9 Recovered. 10 Uncovered. 11 Dispersed, scattered. 12 Extracted, selected, taken from or out of. 13 Holding, containing. E. उद् up, धृ to take, and क्त. aff.
उद्धृतोद्धार: उद्धृतोद्धार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 One who has received his share. 2 That from which a share has been deducted. E. उद्धृत and उद्धार a share.
उद्ध्य: उद्ध्य m. (-द्ध्यः) A river. E. उञ्झ to go, क्यप् affix, deriv. irr.
उद्ध्यान: उद्ध्यान n. (-नं) A furnace or fire place. E. उद्, ध्मा to blow, and ल्युट् aff.
उद्बन्धन: उद्बन्धन n. (-नं) Tying up, hanging. E. उद् and वन्धन tying.
उद्बाहु: उद्बाहु mfn. (-हुः-ह्वी-हु) 1 Having the arms lifted up. 2 Having the trunk upraised (as an elephant.) E. उद् and वाहु the arm.
उद्बुद्ध: उद्बुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Blown, budded. 2 Reminded, made to think of or recalled. 3 Awaked. E. उद् forth, up, and वुद्ध known.
उद्बुद्धसंस्कार: उद्बुद्धसंस्कार m. (-रः) Association of ideas recalling any thing to remembrance. E. उद्वद्ध and संस्कार faculty.
उद्बोध: उद्बोध m. (-धः) 1 Incipient knowledge. 2 Awaking. 3 Reminding. E. उद् and बोध knowledge.
उद्बोधक: उद्बोधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Discovering, exhibiting. 2 What reminds, or calls to remembrance. E. उद and बोधक making known.
उद्बोधन: उद्बोधन n. (-नं) 1 Recalling, reminding. 2 Awaking, arousing. E. उद् before बुध to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
उद्भट: उद्भट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Excellent. 2 Exalted, magnanimous. m. (-टः) 1 A tortoise. 2 The sun. E. उद् lofty, भट to desire, and अच् affix; high-minded.
उद्भव: उद्भव m. (-वः) Birth, production. E. उद् forth, भू to be or become, अच् aff.
उद्भवकर: उद्भवकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Productive. E. उद्भव, and कर what makes.
उद्भाव: उद्भाव m. (-वः) 1 Production, generation. 2 Magnanimity. E. उद् भाव causing to be, &c.
उद्भावन: उद्भावन n. (-नं) 1 Inattention, neglect, disregard. 2 Saying, speaking. E. उद् away or up, भावन observing.
उद्भावित: उद्भावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Neglected, disregarded. 2 Said, declared. E. उद् and भावित made known.
उद्भास: उद्भास m. (-सः) Radiance, splendor. E. उद् and भास shining.
उद्भासयन्: उद्भासयन् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Lighting up, irradiating. E. उद् before भास to shine, शतृ aff.
उद्भासित: उद्भासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Lighted up, illuminated, splendid. 2 Ornamented, graced, beautified. E. उद् before भास to shine, क्त aff.
उद्भिज्ज: उद्भिज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Sprouting, germinating, (as a vegetable.) E. उद्भिद a vegetable, and ज produced; also उद्भिज one ज being dropped; also उद्भिद.
उद्भिद्: उद्भिद् mfn. (-द्भिद् or -द्भित्) Sprouting, germinating. E. उद् up, भिद to break or burst, affix क्विप्, or with क affix उद्भिद (-दः-दा-दं.) n. (-दं) Culinary salt. E. उद् forth, भिद to break, and क affix; breaking from the soil.
उद्भिद: उद्भिद n. (-दं) Sprouting, &c. see the last.
उद्भिन्न: उद्भिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Opened, burst. 2 Budded. E. उद् up, and भिन्न broken.
उद्भूत: उद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Lofty, literally or figuratively. 3 Visible, perceptible, present. E. उद् before भू to be, affix क्त.
उद्भूतरूप: उद्भूतरूप n. (-पं) Visible shape or form. E. उद्भूत and रूप form.
उद्भ्रम: उद्भ्रम n. (-मं) 1 Regret. 2 Whirling, flourishing. E. उद् much, भ्रम to wander, धञ् aff.
उद्भ्रान्त: उद्भ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Agitated, bewildered, distressed. 3 Whirled, flourished, waved (as a sword). E. उद् and भ्रान्त revolved.
उद्य: उद्य m. (-द्यः) A river. E. उद् water, and य what goes, from या to go, and ड aff.
उद्यत: उद्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, held up. 2 Active, persevering, labouring diligently and incessantly. 3 Trained, exercised, disciplined. m. (-तः) A section, a chapter, the division of a book. E. उद् before यम to cease, affix क्त.
उद्यम: उद्यम m. (-मः) 1 Strenuous and continued effort, exertion, perseverance. 2 Taking or lifting up. E. उद् reverse, यम to cease, affix घञ्.
उद्यमिन्: उद्यमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Persevering, active, making effort. E. उद्यम and इनि aff.
उद्यम्य: उद्यम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Requiring exertion. ind. Having lifted or taken up. 2 Having made exertion. E. उद् before यम to cease, यत् and ल्यप् affs.
उद्यान: उद्यान n. (-नं) 1 A garden. 2 A royal garden, a park. 3 Going forth, exit. 4 Purpose, motive. E. उद् up, या to go, affix ल्युट्.
उद्यानपाल: उद्यानपाल m. (-लः) A gardener. 2 The master or owner of a garden. E. उद्यान and पाल who takes care of.
उद्याव: उद्याव m. (-वः) Mixing, joining. E. उद् before यु to mix, affix घञ्.
उद्युक्त: उद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Zealously active, labouring for some desired end. E. उद्, युज to join, क्त affix; also उद्यत.
उद्योग: उद्योग m. (-गः) Exertion, perseverance, strenuous and continued endeavour. E. उद्, युज to join, घञ् aff.
उद्योगिन्: उद्योगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Active, laborious, persevering, one who makes effort. E. उद्योग and इनि aff.
उद्र: उद्र (-द्रः) An otter. E. उन्दी to wet, and रक Uṇādi aff.
उद्रङ्ग: उद्रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An imaginary city, one floating in the air. E. उद् above, and द्रङ्ग a town, one द rejected; also read उद्रङ्क, see हरिश्वन्द्रपूर.
उद्रथ: उद्रथ m. (-थः) 1 The pin of the axle of a carriage. 3 A cook. E. उद् up, and रथ a carriage.
उद्राव: उद्राव m. (-बः) A loud noise. E. उद् before रु to cry, affix घञ्.
उद्रिक्त: उद्रिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Distinct, evident. 2 Increased, augmented. E. उद्, रिच् to flow, affix क्त.
उद्रुज: उद्रुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Destroying, breaking down. E. उद् on, रुज to injure, क aff.
उद्रेक: उद्रेक m. (-कः) 1 Commencement. 2 Increase. 3 Excess. E. उद्, रिच to flow, घञ् aff.
उद्वत्सर: उद्वत्सर m. (-रः) A year. E. उद्, वत्सर a year.
उद्वमन: उद्वमन n. (-नं) Vomiting, bringing up. E. उद् and वमन vomiting.
उद्वर्त: उद्वर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Abundant, plentiful. 2 Left over. m. (-र्त्तः) A remainder, a surplus. E. उद् much, वृत to be, क्त aff.
उद्वर्त्त: उद्वर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Abundant, plentiful. 2 Left over. m. (-र्त्तः) A remainder, a surplus. E. उद् much, वृत to be, क्त aff.
उद्वर्तक: उद्वर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Rubbing and cleaning the body, (who or what does so.) 2 Causing increase. m. (-कः) (In algebra,) An assumed quantity. E. उद् over, वृत to be, ण्वुल् aff.
उद्वर्त्तक: उद्वर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Rubbing and cleaning the body, (who or what does so.) 2 Causing increase. m. (-कः) (In algebra,) An assumed quantity. E. उद् over, वृत to be, ण्वुल् aff.
उद्वर्तन: उद्वर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Going up, rising, ascending. 2 Grinding, pounding. 3 Rubbing or kneading the body. 4 Rubbing and cleaning it with fragrant unguents. 5 Unguents used for that purpose, or to relieve pains in the limbs, &c. 6 Rising, (figuratively) prosperity, elevation. 7 Misbehaving. 8 Springing up of plants or grain, &c. 9 Drawing out metal, laminating, wire drawing, &c. E. उद् up, and वर्त्तन abiding, &c.
उद्वर्त्तन: उद्वर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Going up, rising, ascending. 2 Grinding, pounding. 3 Rubbing or kneading the body. 4 Rubbing and cleaning it with fragrant unguents. 5 Unguents used for that purpose, or to relieve pains in the limbs, &c. 6 Rising, (figuratively) prosperity, elevation. 7 Misbehaving. 8 Springing up of plants or grain, &c. 9 Drawing out metal, laminating, wire drawing, &c. E. उद् up, and वर्त्तन abiding, &c.
उद्वर्तित: उद्वर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perfumed, scented. 2 Risen, elevated. 3 Sprung up. 4 Drawn out. E. उत् before वृत to be, क्त aff.
उद्वर्त्तित: उद्वर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perfumed, scented. 2 Risen, elevated. 3 Sprung up. 4 Drawn out. E. उत् before वृत to be, क्त aff.
उद्वर्द्धन: उद्वर्द्धन n. (-नं) A sly or suppressed laugh. E. उद् priv. वृद्ध to increase, and ल्युट् aff.
उद्वर्हित: उद्वर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, drawn or lifted up. 2 Eradicated. E. उद् up, and वर्हित injured; also उद्वाहित, from वाह to endeavour.
उद्वह: उद्वह mf. (-हः-हा) A son or a daughter. m. (-हः) 1 The vital air that conveys nourishment, &c. upwards. 2 A chief, a leader, the head of a family or force. mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Who or what takes up or away. 2 Best, most eminent. E. उद् further, वह what bears; carrying on one's name, &c.
उद्वहत्: उद्वहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 1 Upholding, supporting, bearing, containing. 2 Having, possessing, assuming. E. उद् before वह to bear, शतृ aff.
उद्वान: उद्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Vomited. E. उद् up, वम to vomit, क्त affix: see उद्वान्त and उद्वान.
उद्वान्त: उद्वान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Vomited. m. (-न्तः) An elephant out of rut. E. उद्, वम to vomit, affix क्त, deriv. irr. see उद्वान्त.
उद्वाप: उद्वाप m. (-पः) (In logic,) non-existence of a subsequent consequent on the absence of an antecedent. E. उद् before वप to sow, affix घञ्.
उद्वास: उद्वास m. (-सः) 1 Abandoning, letting loose or free. 2 Exile. 3 Killing. E. उद् away, वस to abide, causal form, घञ् aff.
उद्वासन: उद्वासन n. (-नं) 1 Quitting, abandoning. 2 Expelling, banishing. 3 Killing, slaughter. E. उत् forth, out, वस to abide, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
उद्वाह: उद्वाह m. (-हः) Marriage. E. उत् up, वह to bear, घञ् aff.
उद्वाहकर्मन्: उद्वाहकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मं) The marriage ceremony. E. उद्वाह and कर्म्मन् act.
उद्वाहकर्म्मन्: उद्वाहकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मं) The marriage ceremony. E. उद्वाह and कर्म्मन् act.
उद्वाहन: उद्वाहन n. (-नं) 1 Marriage. 2 Ploughing a field twice. 3 Anxiety, anxious regret. f. (-नी) The small shell used as a coin, a Cowri. E. उत् up, वाह to endeavour, ल्युट् affix, and ङीष् fem. do.
उद्वाहिक: उद्वाहिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Relating to marriage, matrimonial. E. उद्वाह marriage, and ठक् aff.
उद्वाहित: उद्वाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, lifted or pulled up, &c. 2 Eradicated. E. उत् before वह to bear, causal form, affix क्त.
उद्वाहिन्: उद्वाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 What raises or draws up. 2 Who or what marries, relating to marriage. f. (-नी) A rope. E. उत्, वाह to endeavour, णिनि and ङीष् affixes, or उद्वाह and इनि aff.
उद्विग्न: उद्विग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Sorrowful, anxious, grieving for an absent lover, &c. E. उत्, विज to shake, क्त aff.
उद्विग्नमनस्: उद्विग्नमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Sorrowful, depressed in spirits, anxious, distressed. E. उद्विग्न and मनस् the mind.
उद्वीक्षण: उद्वीक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Looking up or upwards. 2 Seeing, looking at. E. उद् and वि before ईक्ष to see, affix ल्युट्.
उद्वृत्त: उद्वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Raised, elevated. 2 Exalted, prosperous. 3 Unrestrained, ill behaved. 4 Vomited. 5 Left, as a remainder. E. उत् above, and वृत्त placed.
उद्वेग: उद्वेग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 One going swiftly, a runner, a courier, &c. 2 Steady, composed, tranquil. m. (-गः) 1 Regret. 2 Fear. 3 Anxiety, agitation. 4 Distress occasioned by separation from a beloved object. 5 Admiration, astonishment. 6 Ascending, mounting, going up or upwards. 7 An ascetic whose arms, by long habit, continue always raised above his head. n. (-गं) The fruit of the Areca Catechu, the betel nut. E. उत् up, विज to fear, to shake, &c. घञ् aff.
उद्वेगिन्: उद्वेगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Suffering distress, anxious, unhappy. E. उद्वेग and इनि aff.
उद्वेजक: उद्वेजक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Distressing, annoying, what causes pain or sorrow. E. उत् before विज to fear, causal form, वुन् aff.
उद्वेजन: उद्वेजन n. (-नं) 1 Anxiety, distress, regret, sorrowing for one absent. 2 Corporal infliction, mutilation, torture. E. उत् before विज to shake, affix ल्युट्.
उद्वेजनकर: उद्वेजनकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Inflicting pain, punishing, torturing. 2 Painful. E. उद्वेजन and कर what makes.
उद्वेजित: उद्वेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Garieved, pained, afflicted. E. उत् before विज to fear, causal. क्त aff.
उद्वेष्ट: उद्वेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) What surrounds, &c. m. (-ष्टः) 1 Investing a town, besieging or surrounding it. 2 Capturing, taking. 3 Surounding, enclosing. E. उत् before वेष्ट to surround, अच् aff.
उद्वेष्टन: उद्वेष्टन n. (-नं) 1 Surrounding. 2 An enclosure. 3 Pain in the buttocks. E. उद् before वेष्ट to surround, ल्युट् aff.
उद्वेष्टित: उद्वेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, invested, enclosed. E. उत् before वेष्ट to surround, क्त aff.
उधस: उधस n. (-सं) An udder: see ऊधस.
उध्य: उध्य m. (-ध्यः) Name of a river.
उध्रस्: उध्रस् r. 9th cl. (उध्रस्नाति) r. 10th cl. (उध्रामयति) 1 To glean or gather by little at a time. 2 To throw or cast upwards. The initial उ is considered by some as an indicatory letter, the root being then ध्रस; q. v.
उन्द: उन्द r. 7th cl. (ई,) उन्दी (उनत्ति) 1 To wet or moisten. 2 To be or become wet.
उन्दुर: उन्दुर m. (-रः) A rat: see the next.
उन्दुरु: उन्दुरु m. (-रुः) A rat. E. उन्दी to wet, and उरु affix; it is also written उन्दरु, उन्दर, as above, and उन्दुरु, &c.
उन्न: उन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Wet, moist. 2 Kind, humane. E. उन्द to be moist, क्त aff.
उन्नत: उन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 High, tall. 2 Raised, held or lifted up. 3 Plump, full. 4 Great, eminent. E. उत् high, नत bent.
उन्नतनाभि: उन्नतनाभि mfn. (-भिः-भिः-भि) Corpulent. E. उन्नत high, and नाभि the navel.
उन्नतशिरस्: उन्नतशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Holding up the head, carrying the head high. E. उन्नत and शिरस् the head.
उन्नतानत: उन्नतानत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uneven, undulating, wavy. E. उन्नत high, and आनत low.
उन्नति: उन्नति f. (-तिः) 1 Increase, advancement, prosperity. 2 Rising, ascending. 3 The wife of GARUḌA. E. उत् up, नम to bend, क्तिन् aff.
उन्नतीश: उन्नतीश m. (-शः) A name of GARUḌA. E. उन्नति and ईष husband: the husband of UNNATI.
उन्नद्ध: उन्नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Swelled, increased. 2 Tied upon or over. 3 Unbound. E. उद् before नह to bind, क्त aff.
उन्नमन: उन्नमन n. (-नं) Raising, lifting up. E. उत् before नम to bow, ल्युट् aff.
उन्नमित: उन्नमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, elevated, lifted or pulled up. 2 Heightened, increased. E. उत् before नम to bow, क्त affix, with इट् augment.
उन्नमय्य: उन्नमय्य ind. Having raised. E. उत् before नम to bow, ल्यप् aff.
उन्नम्र: उन्नम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Lofty, high, elevated. E. उत् before नम to bow, रक aff.
उन्नय: उन्नय m. (-यं) 1 Raising, elevating, hoisting. 2 Analogy, resemblance. E. उत् up, नी to obtain, and अच् aff.
उन्नयन: उन्नयन n. (-नं) 1 Deliberation, discussion, logic, reasoning. 2 Inference. 3 Raising, elevating, lifting up. E. उत् up, नी to obtain, affix ल्युट्.
उन्नस: उन्नस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Having a prominent nose. E. उद् up, नस for नासिका the nose.
उन्नाम: उन्नाम m. (-मः) Raising, lifting up. E. उद् and नम to bow, घञ् aff.
उन्नाय: उन्नाय m. (-यः) Raising. E. see उन्नय, affix घञ्.
उन्नायक: उन्नायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What raises. 2 What leads to an inference or conclusion. E. उद् before नी to get, causal form, वुन् aff.
उन्नाह: उन्नाह n. (-हं) Sour gruel made from the fermentation of rice. E. उद् and नह to bind, affix घञ्.
उन्निद्र: उन्निद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Awake. 2 Blown, expanded as a flower. E. उद् priv. and निद्रा sleep.
उन्मत्त: उन्मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Insane, frantic, mad. 2 Drunk, intoxicated. m. (-त्तः) 1 The thorn apple, (Datura metel and fastuosa.) 2 A plant, (Pterospermum acerifolium.) E. उत् much, मत्त drunk or mad: applied to the plants, it alludes to their deleterious properties.
उन्मत्तता: उन्मत्तता f. (-त्ता) Insanity, intoxication. E. तल् added to the last; also उन्मत्तत्वं.
उन्मद: उन्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Mad, furious, extravagant, intoxicated. m. (-दः) Insanity, either morbid or as the effect or temporary excitement, intoxication, ecstasy. E. उत् very, मद to be mad, अच् aff.
उन्मदिष्णु: उन्मदिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Mad, insane, crazed. 2 Intoxicated. 3 In rut, (as an elephant.) E. उन्मद to be mad, इष्णुच् attributive. aff.
उन्मनस्: उन्मनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Regretting, missing, sorrowing for a lost or departed friend, &c. E. उत् up, upset, disturbed, and मनस् the mind.
उन्मन्थ: उन्मन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Agitation. E. उत् before, मथि to kill, affix घञ्.
उन्मन्थक: उन्मन्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What moves or stirs. 2 Throbbing, beating. m. (-कः) Inflammation of the outer ear. E. उद् before मथि to hurt, वुन् aff.
उन्मन्थन: उन्मन्थन n. (-नं) 1 Shaking, agitating. 2 Hurting, killing. 3 Probing, stirring a weapon, &c. lodged in the body. E. उद् before मथि to hurt, ल्युट् aff.
उन्मन्थित: उन्मन्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Moved, agitated, distressed. E. उद् and मन्थित agitated.
उन्माथ: उन्माथ m. (-थः) 1 A snare or trap. 2 Killing, slaughter. 2 A killer, a slaughterer. 4 Pride, disdain. E. उत्, मथ to agitate, and घञ् aff.
उन्माद: उन्माद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Mad, insane, extravagant. m. (-दः) 1 Madness, extravagance. 2 (In medicine,) Mania. E. उद् much, मद to be mad, affix घञ्.
उन्मादन: उन्मादन m. (-नः) 1 Maddening, exciting, intoxicating. 2 One of five arrows borne by KĀMADEVA, the Hindu CUPID. E. उत् before मद to be mad or intoxicated, causal form, ल्यट् aff.
उन्मादवत्: उन्मादवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Mad, insane, wild, extravagant. E. उन्माद madness, &c. and मतुप् poss. aff.
उन्मादिन्: उन्मादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Mad, intoxicated. E. उन्माद and इनि aff.
उन्मान: उन्मान m. (-नः) A measure of size or quantity. E. उद् and मा to measure, ल्युट् aff.
उन्मार्ग: उन्मार्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A wrong road. 2 Improper conduct, an evil course, error. E. उद् and मार्ग way.
उन्मार्गगत: उन्मार्गगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Erred, erring, going wrong. E. उन्मार्ग and गत gone.
उन्मार्गगमन: उन्मार्गगमन n. (-नं) 1 Going a wrong road. 2 Following evil courses. E. उन्मार्ग and गमन going.
उन्मार्गगामिन्: उन्मार्गगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Going wrong, erring, following evil courses. 2 Taking a wrong road. E. उन्मार्ग and गामिन् who goes.
उन्मित: उन्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Meted, measured. E. उद् before मा to measure, क्त aff.
उन्मिषत्: उन्मिषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Opening the eye, drawing up the eyelid, looking at, seeing. E. उद् before मिष to scatter, शतृ aff.
उन्मिषित: उन्मिषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opened, (as the eye.) 2 Blown as a flower. E. उद् up, मिष to scatter, affix क्त.
उन्मीलन: उन्मीलन n. (-नं) 1 Winking, twinkling of the eye. 2 Blowing, expanding. E. उद् and मील to twinkle, affix ल्युट्.
उन्मीलित: उन्मीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opened, (as the eyes.) 2 Blown as a flower. E. उद्, मील to wink, affix क्त.
उन्मुख: उन्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Looking upwards. E. उद् up, मुख the face.
उन्मुद्र: उन्मुद्र mfn. (द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Blown as a flower. 2 Unsealed, opened. E. उद् up, open, and मुद्रा a seal.
उन्मूलित: उन्मूलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eradicated, pulled up by the roots. E. उद् up, मूल nominal verb, to take root, क्त aff.
उन्मृष्ट: उन्मृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Worn off, blotted out. E. उद् out, मृष्ट rubbed.
उन्मेदा: उन्मेदा f. (-दा) Corpulency, fatness. E. उद् much, मिद to anoint, अच् and टाप् affs.
उन्मेष: उन्मेष m. (-षः) 1 Winking, twinkling of the eyelids, the upward motion. 2 Opening the eye, looking at. E. उद् up, मिष to scatter, affix घञ्.
उप: उप ind. A particle and prefix to verbs and other words implying, 1 Excess, (over, above, &c.;) 2 Vicinity or assemblage, (near, by the side of, with, together with;) 3 Inferiority, (lesser, secondary, &c.;) 4 Likeness, resemblance; 5 Disease, extinction; 6 Ornament; 7 Command; 8 Reproof; 9 Astonishing; 10 Giving; 11 Killing; 12 Diffusion; 13 Wish, desire; 14 Effort, exertion, &c. as उपर्कत्तुं, to assist; उपगन्तुं to approach; उपदेष्टं to advise; उपलब्धुं to revile; उपस्थातुं to worship; also उपपुराणं. an inferior or minor Purāṇa, उपकुम्भं near the water pot, उपगङ्गं upon the Ganges, उपकान्तं near or with a lover, उपाग्नि in the vicinity of fire.
उपकण्ठ: उपकण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं) Near, proximate. n. (-ण्ठं) 1 Space near a village or its boundary. 2 One of a horse's paces, his walk. ind. (-ण्ठं) Upon the neck, near the throat. E. उप near, कण्ठ the neck.
उपकरण: उपकरण n. (-णं) 1 Apparatus, paraphernalia, as the vessels and offerings at a sacrifice. 2 Implements, machines. 3 The insignia of royalty. 4 Sauces, condiments. 5 Helping, assisting. 6 Object of art or science, fabricating, composing, &c. 7 Means of subsistence, any thing supporting life. E. उप implying command or help, कृ to make, ल्युट् aff.
उपकर्णम्: उपकर्णम् ind. Close to the ear, into the ear, (whispered, &c.) E. उप near, कर्ण् the ear.
उपकर्तृ: उपकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Assisting, befriending, one who helps or befriends. E. उप before कृ to do, affix तृन्.
उपकर्त्तृ: उपकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Assisting, befriending, one who helps or befriends. E. उप before कृ to do, affix तृन्.
उपकल्पन: उपकल्पन n. (-नं) 1 Preparing articles of food, medicine, &c. 2 Fabricating, making. 3 Substituting. E. उप and कल्पन making.
उपकल्पित: उपकल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Prepared, made. 2 Secondary, substituted. E. उप and कल्पित prepared.
उपकार: उपकार m. (-रः) 1 Favour, protection, help, assistance. 2 Use, advantage. 3 A flower, &c. full blown. 4 Garlands suspended, at gateways, as an embellishment on festivals. E. उप near or over, कृ to make, घञ् aff.
उपकारक: उपकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A friend, a protector, one who befriends. E. उप and कृ to do, ण्वुल aff.
उपकारकत्व: उपकारकत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Protection, assistance. E. उपकारक and त्व aff.
उपकारपर: उपकारपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Beneficent, diligent in doing good. E. उपकार and पर diligent.
उपकारिका: उपकारिका f. (-का) 1 A protectress, a governess. 2 A palace, a caravansera. 3 A kind of cake. E. उपकारी as below, &c. कन् affix, and the fem. form, or the fem. of उपकारक.
उपकारिता: उपकारिता f. (-ता) Aid, succour, protection. E. तल् added to उपकारिन्; also with त्व, उपकारित्व.
उपकारिन्: उपकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Helping, assisting, a benefactor. 2 Subsidiary, subservient. E. उपकार and इनि aff.
उपकारी: उपकारी f. (-री) A palace, a caravansera. E. उपकार aid, asylum, affixes अण and ङीप्.
उपकार्य: उपकार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Deserving assistance or favour. f. (-र्य्या) 1 A king's house, a palace, a caravansera. 2 A tent. E. उपकार aid, &c. and ण्यत् aff.
उपकार्य्य: उपकार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Deserving assistance or favour. f. (-र्य्या) 1 A king's house, a palace, a caravansera. 2 A tent. E. उपकार aid, &c. and ण्यत् aff.
उपकुञ्चि: उपकुञ्चि f. (-ञ्चिः) A plant, (Nigella Indica.) E. उप very, कुञ्च to be small, and कि aff.
उपकुञ्चिका: उपकुञ्चिका f. (-का) 1 Small cardamoms: see एला. 2 A sort of fennel flower, (Nigella Indica, Rox.) E. वुन् affixed to the last.
उपकुम्भ: उपकुम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Solitary, lonely, retired. n. or ind. (-म्भं) Near the water jar. E. उप and कुम्भ a jar.
उपकुल्या: उपकुल्या f. (-ल्या) 1 A canal, a trench, a ditch. 2 Long pepper, (Piper longum.) E. उप near, कुल to accumulate, and क्यप् affix, fem. टाप्.
उपकुश: उपकुश m. (-शः) Gum-boil. E. उप before कुश to enclose, क aff.
उपकूपजलाशय: उपकूपजलाशय m. (-यः) A trough near a well for watering cattle. E. उप near, कूप a well, and जलाशय a place for water.
उपकृत: उपकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Benefited, assisted. 2 Done kindly or beneficently, rendered as assistance. n. (-तं) A favour, a benefit. E. उप before कृ to do, क्त aff.
उपकृति: उपकृति f. (-तिः) Aid, assistance, kindness. E. उप and कृ to do, क्तिन् aff.
उपक्रन्तृ: उपक्रन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Beginning, one who begins. E. उप before क्रम to go, तृच् aff.
उपक्रम: उपक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Deliberate commencement or undertaking; providing means, and anticipating consequences. 2 A beginning in general. 3 A particular ceremony preparatory to reading the Vedas. 4 A stratagem. 5 A means, an expedient. 6 Trying the fidelity, &c. of a counsellor or friend. 7 Valor. 8 Practice of medicine, physicking. 9 Flight, retreat. 10 Approach. E. उप over, &c. क्रम to go, affix घञ्.
उपक्रमणीय: उपक्रमणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Necessary, to be commenced or undertaken. 2 To be gone to or near. E. उप before क्रम to go, अनीयर् aff.
उपक्रमितृ: उपक्रमितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) One who begins, &c. see उपक्रम. E. उप before क्रम to go, तृच् affix, with इट augment; also उपक्रत्तृ.
उपक्रोश: उपक्रोश m. (-शः) Censure, reproach. E. उप reproach, inferiority, क्रुश to cry, to sound, affix घञ्.
उपक्रोष्टृ: उपक्रोष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) 1 An ass. 2 A reviler, a reprover. E. उप implying censure, क्रुश to cry, तृन् aff.
उपकॢप्त: उपकॢप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Consecrated, dedicated, prepared or set apart for use. E. उप and कॢप्त made.
उपक्वण: उपक्वण m. (-णः) The sound of a lute. E. उप well, क्वण to sound, affix अपे or with घञ् affix उपक्वाण.
उपक्षय: उपक्षय m. (-यः) Loss. E. उप before क्षि to lose, affix अच्,
उपक्षेप: उपक्षेप m. (-पः) Poetical or figurative style or composition. E. उप and क्षिप to throw, affix घञ्.
उपगण: उपगण m. (-णः) A small number, less than a troop or number. E. उप and गण a troop.
उपगत: उपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed. 2 Near, approached, gone to. 2 Feeling, suffering, entertaining. 3 Becoming, being, become 5 Having, obtained. E. उप with, गत gone, part. past of गम to go.
उपगतवत: उपगतवत mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Going to, gone to. 2 Feeling, suffering, (as sorrow, &c.) 3 Promising. 4 Possessing. E. उप before गम to go, क्तवतु aff.
उपगन्ध: उपगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Perfume. E. उप and गन्ध smell.
उपगम: उपगम m. (-मः) 1 Agreement, promise. 2 Approach, approximation. 3 Suffering, feeling. 4 Acquaintance, society, intercourse. 5 Getting, having, obtaining. E. उप near, गम to go, and अच् aff.
उपगिरि: उपगिरि ind. Near a mountain; also with टच् added उपगिरम्.
उपगीत: उपगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Celebrated, proclaimed, sung, (by bards, &c.) E. उप and गीत sung.
उपगीति: उपगीति f. (-तिः) A variety of the Arya metre, a stanza of four lines, containing 12--15 and 12--15 syllabic instants.
उपगीय: उपगीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be sung. ind. Having sung. E. उप before गै to sing, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
उपगूढ: उपगूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Hidden, concealed. 2 Lulled, suppressed. E. उप before गुह to hide, affix क्त.
उपगूहन: उपगूहन n. (-नं) 1 An embrace, embracing. 2 Astonishment, surprise. E. उप near, गुह to hide, affix ल्युट्.
उपग्रह: उपग्रह m. (-हः) 1 A prisoner, a man or animal in confinement. 2 Favour, encouragement. 3 Assistance. 4 Peace purchased by the cession of every thing. 5 Seizure. 6 The presiding spirit or cause directing a planet's motion. 7 A minor planet or any heavenly body of a secondary kind, as a comet, a meteor, a falling star, &c. 8 A heap of kusa grass. E. उप near, ग्रह to take, अप् affix or ग्रह a planet, &c.
उपग्रहण: उपग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Taking, seizing. 2 Holy study, reading the Vedas after initiation. E. उप much, ग्रह to take, affix ल्युट्.
उपग्राह्य: उपग्राह्य m. (-ह्यः) A present, an offering to a king or great man, a Nezer. E. उप much, &c. ग्रह to take, affix ण्यत्.
उपघात: उपघात m. (-तः) 1 Disease, sickness. 2 Touch, contact, especially with an intent to injure. 3 Personal violence, assault. E. उप much, हन to injure, घञ् aff.
उपघ्न: उपघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 1 Contiguous support. 2 Support, stay, protection. 3 What rests upon or is supported by. E. उप near, हन to destroy, and अप् aff.
उपचक्र: उपचक्र m. (-क्रः) A variety of the ruddy goose. E. उप minor, and चक्र the Cakra.
उपचतुर: उपचतुर m. plu. (-राः) Almost four. E. उप and चतुर four.
उपचय: उपचय m. (-यः) 1 Quantity, heap. 2 Elevation. 3 Prosperity. 4 Excess. 5 The third, sixth, tenth, and eleventh degrees from the first of a zodiacal sign. E. उप above, चि to collect, अच् aff.
उपचरित: उपचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Served, adored. E. उप near or with, चर to go, affix क्त.
उपचर्य: उपचर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be served or waited on. f. (-र्य्या) 1 Service, attendance. 2 Practice of medicine, physicking. E. उप implying help, चर to go, क्यप् and टाप् affs.
उपचर्य्य: उपचर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be served or waited on. f. (-र्य्या) 1 Service, attendance. 2 Practice of medicine, physicking. E. उप implying help, चर to go, क्यप् and टाप् affs.
उपचाय्य: उपचाय्य m. (-य्यः) A place for holding sacrificial fire, a hearth, an altar. E. उप, चिञ् to collect, ण्यत् affix, deriv. irr.
उपचार: उपचार m. (-रः) 1 Service, attendance. 2 Physicking, the practice of medicine. 3 Practice, profession, usage. 4 A present, a bribe. 5 Presenting delicacies or necessaries, water, betel.  &c. 6 Tending the sick, nursing. 7 Solicitation, request. 8 Incomplete, act, one in progress. 9 A form of speech, a phrase that leaves something to be inferred, ellipsis, &c. E. उप well. much, &c. चर to go, घञ् aff.
उपचारकरण: उपचारकरण n. (-णं) Offering presents, especially of perfumes. flowers, &c. attention, service. E. उपचार and करण making; also उपचारकर्म्मन्, उपचारक्रिया, &c.
उपचारपर: उपचारपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Waiting upon, serving diligently. E. उपचार service, and पर diligent.
उपचार्य: उपचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) Practice of medicine. E. उप, चर in the causal form, and ण्यत् affix, deriv. irr.
उपचार्य्य: उपचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) Practice of medicine. E. उप, चर in the causal form, and ण्यत् affix, deriv. irr.
उपचित: उपचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Collected, assembled. 2 Heaped. 3 Thriving, increasing. 4 Burnt. 5 Plaistered, smeared. E. उप much, and चित collected, from चिञ् to gather, affix क्त.
उपचित्रा: उपचित्रा f. (-त्रा) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata, Rox.) see मूषिकपर्णी E. उप much, चित्र variegated.
उपचूलन: उपचूलन n. (-नं) Heathing, burning. E. उप much, चूर to burn, affix ल्युट्, र changed to ल.
उपचेय: उपचेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be collected or heaped up. E. उप before चि to gather, ण्यत् aff.
उपच्छन्न: उपछन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Secret, concealed. E. उप and छद to cover, क्त aff.
उपछन्न: उपछन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Secret, concealed. E. उप and छद to cover, क्त aff.
उपजात: उपजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Produced, engendered, aroused. E. उप and जात born.
उपजाति: उपजाति f. (-तिः) A metre or stanza of four lines, with eleven syllables in each.
उपजाप: उपजाप m. (-पः) 1 Disunion, separation. 2 Treason, treachery. E. उप separation, जप to meditate, ण aff.
उपजापक: उपजापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A mischief-maker, one who foments quarrels. 2 A traitor, treacherous. E. उप before जप to meditate, ण्वुल् aff.
उपजिह्वा: उपजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) 1 A kind of insect. 2 The uvula or soft palate. 3 Enlargement of the tongue. E. उप privation or similitude, and जिह्वा the tongue.
उपजिह्विका: उपजिह्विका f. (-का) 1 A species of insect. 2 The soft palate: see the preceding.
उपजीवक: उपजीवक n. (-कं) 1 Act, object. 2 Means of subsistence. E. उप before जीव to live, वुन् aff.
उपजीविका: उपजीविका f. (-का) Subsistence, livelihood. E. उप and जीविका the same.
उपजीवन: उपजीवन n. (-नं) Subsistence, means of living. E. उप and जीवन living.
उपजीविन्: उपजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Dependant, living by or on. E. उप and जीविन् who lives.
उपजीव्य: उपजीव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Affording a livelihood. n. (-व्यं) Cause. E. उप before जीव to live, य aff.
उपजोषम्: उपजोषम् ind. An expression indicative of joy. E. उप much, जुष to be kind, and अम् affix; also उपयोषम्.
उपज्ञा: उपज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Untaught knowledge. E. उप near, with ज्ञा knowledge, from ज्ञा to know, अङ्, and टाप् affs.
उपढौकन: उपढौकन n. (-नं) A respectful offering or present, a Nezer. E. उप and ढौकन seeking.
उपतप्त: उपतप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Heated, parched. 2 Distressed, pained. E. उप and तप्त heated.
उपतप्तृ: उपतप्तृ m. (-प्ता) 1 Morbid heat. 2 Any cause of heat, burning or inflammation. E. उप excess, तप to heat, तृच् aff.
उपताप: उपताप m. (-पः) 1 Disease. 2 Haste, hurry. 3 Heat, heatedness. 4 Pain. 5 Misfortune. E. उप much, तप to heat, घञ् aff.
उपतापिन्: उपतापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) 1 Inflaming, exciting. 2 Heating. 3 Suffering heat or pain. 4 Sick. E. उपताप and इनि affix, or उप before तप with णिनि aff.
उपत्यका: उपत्यका f. (-का) Land near the foot of a hill or mountain. E. उप near, त्यकन् aff.
उपदंश: उपदंश n. (-शः) 1 A relish, or something to promote drinking. 2 The venereal disease, chancre. 3 Biting, stinging. 4 A tree, the scraped root of which is used for horse-radish, (Morunga hyperanthera). E. उप much, &c. दंश biting.
उपदर्शक: उपदर्शक m. (-कः) 1 A doorkeeper. 2 A guide. E. उप and दर्शक who shews.
उपदर्शित: उपदर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perceived, distinguished. E. उप before दर्शित seen.
उपदा: उपदा f. (-दा) A present, an offering to a king or great man, &c. a Nezer. E. उप, दा a gift, from दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.
उपदानक: उपदानक n. (-कं) A present, &c. see the preceding. E. उप implying help, &c. दान a gift, and क affix: a gift which is for the purpose of procuring favour or protection.
उपदिश्य: उपदिश्य ind. Having advised or instructed. E. उप before दिश to shew, ल्यप् aff.
उपदिष्ट: उपदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Instructed, advised. 2 Initiated. 3 Specified, particularised. 4 Assigned as a plea or reason. n. (-ष्टं) Council, advice. E. उप before दिश to shew, क्त aff.
उपदेवता: उपदेवता f. (-ता) A minor divinity, as a Yakṣa, Gandharba, Apsaras, &c. E. उप and देवता a divinity.
उपदेश: उपदेश m. (-शः) Advice, information, instruction. 3 Plea, pretext. 4 Specification. 5 Initiation, communication of the initiatory Mantra or formula. 6 (In grammar,) An elementary term. E. उप before दिश to shew, affix घञ्.
उपदेशक: उपदेशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Giving instruction, instructing, instructive. m. (-कः) An instructor, a guide, specially a spiritual guide. E. उप before दिश to shew, ण्वुल् aff.
उपदेशन: उपदेशन n. (-नं) Advising, instructing. E. उप before दिश to shew, affix ल्युट्.
उपदेशिन्: उपदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Advising, an adviser. E. उपदेश advice, and इनि aff.
उपदेष्टव्य: उपदेष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be advised, (fit, proper, &c.) E. उप before दिश to shew, तव्य affix; also उपदेश्य, उपदेशनीय.
उपदेष्टृ: उपदेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) One who points out, who orders or advises. m. (-ष्टा) A Guru, a spiritual guide. E. उप prefixed to दिश to shew, affix तृच्.
उपदेह: उपदेह m. (-हः) 1 Liniment, ointment. 2 A minor or secondary body. E. उप and दिह plaster, or देह the body.
उपदेहिका: उपदेहिका f. (-का) A kind of insect. E. उप with, &c. देह the body, affixes कन् and टाप्; also उत्पादिका.
उपद्रव: उपद्रव m. (-वः) 1 Tyranny, oppression. 2 National distress, whether the act of the seasons or the king, famine, exaction, &c. 3 National commotion, rebellion. 4 Violence. 5 A supervenient  disease, one brought one whilst a person labours under another. E. उप, द्रु to go, अच् aff.
उपद्रविन्: उपद्रविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 Tyrannical. 2 Violent, factious. m. (-वी) 1 A tyrant, an oppressor. 2 A rebel. E. उपद्रव and इनि aff.
उपद्रष्टृ: उपद्रष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Supervisor, inspector, overseeing, overlooking. E. उप before दृश to see, तृच् affix, the vowel changed to र.
उपद्रुत: उपद्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tyrannized over, oppressed, visited by calamities, &c. E. उप before द्रु to go, क्त aff.
उपधर्म: उपधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 A heretic, a schismatic. 2 A minor or inferior duty. E. उप and धर्म्म duty.
उपधर्म्म: उपधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 A heretic, a schismatic. 2 A minor or inferior duty. E. उप and धर्म्म duty.
उपधा: उपधा f. (-धा) 1 A false pretence. 2 Trial or test of honesty, &c. of four kinds, of loyalty, disinterestedness, continence, and courage. 3 A penultimate letter. E. उप, धा having, from घा, to have, with अङ् and टाप् affs.
उपधातु: उपधातु m. (-तुः) 1 An inferior mineral, a semi-metal: seven are specified; pyrites, sulphate of copper, talc, antimony, red orpiment, yellow orpiment, and calx of brass. 2 Secondary secretion, as the milk, menses, adeps, sweat, teeth, hair, and lymph. E. उप minor, and धातु mineral, &c.
उपधान: उपधान n. (-नं) 1 A pillow. 2 Kindness, affection. 3 Poison. 4 Religious observance or obligation. 5 Excellence, excellent quality. 6 Resting or placing upon. E. उप, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.
उपधानीय: उपधानीय n. (-यं) A pillow. E. उपधान a pillow, and छ aff.
उपधाय: उपधाय ind. Having placed or rested upon. E. उप before धा to hold, ल्युप् aff.
उपधाशुचि: उपधाशुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) Approved, tried, of approved loyalty, &c. E. उपधा and शुचि pure.
उपधि: उपधि m. (-धिः) 1 Fraud, circumvention. 2 The wheel of a carriage. 3 Fear, terror. E. उप, धा to have, and कि aff.
उपधिक: उपधिक m. (-कः) 1 A cheat, a knave, especially one who extorts money by threats. 2 Fraud. E. उपधि and कृ to make, ड aff. or कन् pleonasm.
उपधूपित: उपधूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Being at the point of death. 2 Suffering extreme pain. E. उप near or much, धूपित pained.
उपधृति: उपधृति f. (-तिः) A ray of light. E. उप much, धृ to have, क्तिन् affix.
उपनत: उपनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Approached, approximate, near, (either in time or place.) E. उप near, नम to bow, affix क्तः.
उपनय: उपनय m. (-यः) The initiation of the three first classes; investiture with a peculiar thread or cord worn over the left shoulder, and under the right: the cord of the Brahman is of cotton, Munja, or Kusa grass; of the Kṣatriya, of Śaṇa or flax; and of the Vaiśya, of wool: the youths should be invested, respectively, from eight to sixteen, from eleven to twenty-two, and from twelve to twenty-four years of age. n. (-नं) 1 Attaining, gaining. 2 Bringing to. E. उप over, णीञ् to obtain, अच् affix; also with घञ् affix उपनाय, and with ल्युट् affix उपनयन.
उपनयन: उपनयन n. (-नं) See the preceding. E. as before affix ल्युट्; also with अण् added उपनायन.
उपनाह: उपनाह m. (-हः) 1 A plaster, an unguent applied to a wound or sore. 2 The tie of a lute, the lower part of the tail piece where the wires are fixed. 3 Inflammation of the ciliary glands, stye. E. उप, नह to bind, घञ् aff.
उपनाहन: उपनाहन n. (-नं) Unction, anointing, plastering. E. उप before नह to tie, ल्युट् aff.
उपनिक्षेप: उपनिक्षेप m. (-पः) A deposit, sealed or in a cover, so that the contents are unknown. E. उप and निक्षेप the same.
उपनिधान: उपनिधान n. (-नं) A deposit: see the next. E. उप and नि before धा to have, ल्युट् aff.
उपनिधि: उपनिधि m. (-धिः) A deposit, a pledge, property put into the care of a creditor, friend, &c. E. उप and नि before धा to have, कि affix; in law this word ordinarily implies more especially a sealed or enclosed deposit, but according to some, it is any article entrusted to a friend which he may use whilst in his keeping.
उपनिषद्: उपनिषद् f. (-षत् or -षत्) 1 A portion of the religious writings of the Hindus; the theological part, and the Vedānta or argumentative part of the Vedas, either detached from or comprised in the principal work. 2 Virtue, moral merit. 3 Truth as the principle of divine being. 4 A neighbouring mansion. 5 A lonely place. E. उप and नि prefixed to षद to go, affix क्विप्; in which abide the essential parts of religion, &c.
उपनिष्कर: उपनिष्कर n. (-रं) 1 A street. 2 A principal or royal road. E. उप and नि before कृ to make, affix अप्, and स inserted.
उपनिष्क्रमण: उपनिष्क्रमण n. (-णं) 1 A main or royal road. 2 An instituted observance or Saṃskāra, taking a child in the fourth month of its age into the open air. 3 Going forth. E. उप and नि before क्रम to go, affix ल्युट्, and स inserted.
उपनिहित: उपनिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deposited with, entrusted to. 2 Placed near to. 3 Offered, presented. E. उप and नि before धा to have, क्ति aff.
उपनीत: उपनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Brought near to, approximated. 2 Obtained, attained. 3 Citing, adducing. 4 Presented. 5 Known. m. (-तः) The youth invested with the characteristic string: see उपनय. E. उप before नी to obtain, affix क्त.
उपनीय: उपनीय ind. 1 Having brought. 2 Having invested. E. उप before नी to bring, ल्यप् aff.
उपनुन्न: उपनुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Sent or dispatched. 2 Wafted, driven, (by the wind.) E. उप before नुद to send, क्त aff.
उपन्यस्त: उपन्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Pledged, deposited. 2 Given, communicated. 3 Brought forward, (as an example, &c.) adduced. 4 Placed near to, or in, or upon. E. उप and नि before अस to throw, affix क्त.
उपन्यास: उपन्यास m. (-सः) 1 A pledge, a pawn, a hostage. 2 An exordium or introduction. 3 A precept, a law. 4 Giving, imparting. 5 Juxtaposition. 6 A suggestion, a hint. E. उप and नि prefixed to अस, to throw or send, affix घञ्.
उपन्यास्य: उपन्यास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be pleaded. E. उप and न्यास्य to be adduced.
उपपति: उपपति m. (-तिः) A paramour, a gallant. E. उप in place of, पति a husband.
उपपत्ति: उपपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Birth, production. 2 Association, connexion. 3 Fitness, propriety. 4 Cessation, end. 5 Possessing, having. 6 Ascertained or demonstrated conclusion. 7 Cause, reason. 8 Effecting, doing. 9 Religious abstraction. 10 (In arithmetic or geometry,) Proof, demonstration. E. उप before पद to go, क्तिन् aff.
उपपत्तिमत्: उपपत्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Right, fit, reasonable, proper. 2 United, associated. E. उपपत्ति and मतुप् poss. aff.
उपपद: उपपद n. (-दं) 1 Small, diminutive. 2 The subsidiary term in a compound word. 3 The first member of a compound word. 4 An aptote, a word sometimes used as an adverb and sometimes as an inflected noun. 5 A secondary noun in a sentence in conjunction or apposition. E. उप before पद a foot, or an inflected word.
उपपन्न: उपपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Manifested. 2 Fit, suited to the occasion, adequate. 3 Done, shewn, proved, effected. 4 Endowed with, possessed of. 5 Produced from or by. 6 Physicked, cured. E. उप before पद to go, क्त aff.
उपपातक: उपपातक n. (-कं) A great crime, as killing a cow, selling a daughter, atheism, &c; it is considered as criminality in the second or third degree, and is of various kinds: see महापातक. E. उप much, and पातक a crime.
उपपातकिन्: उपपातकिन् m. (-की) A sinner in any but the first degree. E. उपपातक and इनि aff.
उपपादन: उपपादन n. (-नं) 1 Effecting, doing. 2 Giving, delivering, presenting. 3 Proving or establishing by argument. E. उप before पद to go, causal. form, ल्युट् aff.
उपपादित: उपपादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done, effected. 2 Given, delivered, presented. 3 Proved, accomplished. E. उप before पद to go, causal form, क्त aff.
उपपादुक: उपपादुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Shod. m. (-कः) 1 A superhuman being, a god, a demon, &c. 2 Hell. E. उप before पद to go, उकञ् aff.
उपपाप: उपपाप m. (-पः) A heinous crime, as killing a cow, &c. E. उप excess, and पाप sin.
उपपालित: उपपालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected, nurtured. E. उप and पालित protected.
उपपीडन: उपपीडन n. (-नं) 1 Pain, agony, torture. 2 Inflicting pain. 3 Devastating, laying waste. E. उप before पीड to give pain, ल्युट् aff.
उपपीडित: उपपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tortured, pained, distressed. 2 Devastated. E. उप before पीड to give pain, क्त aff.
उपपुर: उपपुर n. (-रं) a suburb. E. उप near, पुर a city.
उपपुराण: उपपुराण n. (-णं) A Purāṇa, one not included in the eighteen principal: a similar number is reckoned, or 1 Ādi. 2 Nṛsiṃha. 3 Vāyu. 4 Śivadharma. 5 Durvasa. 6 Nārada. 7 Nandikeśvara. 8 Uśanas. 9 Kapila. 10 Varuṇa. 11 Sāmba. 12 Kālikā. 13 Maheśvara. 14 Padma. 15 Deva. 16 Parāśara. 17 Mārīca. 18 Bhāskara. E. उप minor, पुराण a Purāṇa.
उपपुष्पिका: उपपुष्पिका f. (-का) Yawing, gaping. E. उप much, पुष्प to flower, to open as a flower, वुन् aff.
उपप्रदान: उपप्रदान n. (-नं) A bribe. E. उप for assistance, प्रदा to give, affix ल्युट्.
उपप्लव: उपप्लव m. (-वः) 1 Rāhu, the ascending node. 2 A portent or natural phaenomenon so considered. 3 An affray or assault, a conflict without weapons. 4 Eclipse. 5 Misfortune. E. उप over &c. प्न to go, अप aff.
उपप्लुत: उपप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Distressed, pained. 2 Harassed (by Rāhu, &c.) eclipsed. 3 Assailed, beset. 4 Marked by prodigies. 5 Wet, moistened. f. (-ता) Morbid sensibility of the uterus. E. उप before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
उपभुक्त: उपभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Used, enjoyed, possessed. E. उप before भुज to enjoy, क्त aff.
उपभुञ्जान: उपभुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Using, enjoying. E. उप before भुज to enjoy, शानच् aff.
उपभृत्: उपभृत् f. (-भृत्) A cup of a round shape, made of the wood of the banian tree, and used in sacrifices. E. उप, भृ to fill, क्विप् and तुक् affs.
उपभोग: उपभोग m. (-गः) 1 Pleasure, satisfaction. 2 Enjoyment, use. 3 Cohabitation. 4 Use, usufruct. E. उप excess, भुज् to eat, &c. affix घञ्.
उपभोग्य: उपभोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) To be used, to be enjoyed. E. उप before भुज् to enjoy, य affix; also उपभोजनीय and उपभोक्तव्य.
उपमर्द: उपमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Reproach, abuse. 2 Refuting a charge. E. उप, मृद to tread down, अच् aff.
उपमर्द्द: उपमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Reproach, abuse. 2 Refuting a charge. E. उप, मृद to tread down, अच् aff.
उपमर्दक: उपमर्दक m. (-कः) The refuting of a charge. E. कन् added to the last.
उपम: उपम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Like, (but used only in composition.) f. (-मा) 1 Resemblance, a resemblance as a picture, an image, &c. 2 A simile. E. उप like, मा to measure, affixes, अङ् and टाप्; also with ल्युट् affix, उपमान.
उपमातृ: उपमातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) An image maker, a portrait painter. E. उप before मा to measure, तृच् affix. f. (-त्री) 1 A wet nurse. 2 A near female relative. E. उप like, मातृ a mother.
उपमित: उपमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compared. E. उप and मा to measure, क्त.
उपमिति: उपमिति f. (-तिः) 1 Resemblance, comparison, a likeness, a picture, image, &c. 2 Analogy. 3 Knowledge of things derived from analogy or resemblances. E. उप like, मा to measure, क्तिन् aff.
उपमेत: उपमेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compared with. m. (-तः) The Śāl, a timber tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. उपम like, इत gone: high as a mountain, &c.
उपमेय: उपमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be compared with or to. n. (-यं) The subject of a comparison, as the face is of the moon. E. उप before मा to measure, य aff.
उपमेयोपमा: उपमेयोपमा f. (-मा) The resemblance of any object to that compared with it, as of the moon to a beautiful face. E. उपमेय and उपमा likeness.
उपयन्तृ: उपयन्तृ m. (-न्ता) A husband, a master. E. उप, यम to cease, तृच् aff.
उपयन्त्र: उपयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) 1 A small instrument or implement. 2 An application of a similar nature, as actual cautery, escharotics, &c. E. उप and यन्त्र instrument.
उपयम: उपयम m. (-मः) Marriage. E. उप and यम to stop, affix अप्.
उपयाचक: उपयाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A present solicitor, one who asks or begs. E. उप before याच to beg, वुन् aff.
उपयाचित: उपयाचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Requested, solicited. 2 Offered, especially to the deities to render them propitious. E. उप much, याच to ask or beg, affix क्त, or with कन् added उपयाचितक.
उपयाम: उपयाम m. (-मः) Marriage. E. उप, यम to refrain, affix घञ.
उपयुक्त: उपयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Proper, right. 2 Adapted to, suitable, appropriate, useful. 3 Touched by. 4 Taken. 5 Eaten. E. उप before युज to join, affix क्त.
उपयुञ्जान: उपयुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Taking, appropriating, attaching. E. उप before युजि to join, शानच् aff.
उपयोग: उपयोग m. (-गः) 1 Good conduct, observing established practices. 2 Any act tending to effect a desired object. 3 Fitness, suitableness. 4 Service, utility. 5 Use, application. 6 Contact, proximity. 7 Administration of medicines. 3 Preparation of them. E. उप before युज to join, घञ् aff.
उपयोगिता: उपयोगिता f. (-ता) 1 Fitness, suitableness. 2 Usefulness. 2 Occasion, need. 4 Favour, propitiousness. E. उपयोगिन् and तल् affix, or with त्व, उपयोगित्वं.
उपयोगिन्: उपयोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Appropriate, suitable. 2 Conducive or contributing to, serviceable, useful. 3 Favourable, propitious. 4 Touching, in contact with. E. उपयोग and इनि aff.
उपयोषम्: उपयोषम् ind. A word expressing great pleasure: see उपजोषम्.
उपरक्त: उपरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Afflicted with pain or calamity. m. (-क्तः) 1 Eclipsed, (the sun or moon.) 2 Rāhu, (the ascending node.) E. उप implying distress, रञ्ज to colour, and क्त aff.
उपरक्षण: उपरक्षण n. (-णं) A guard, an outpost. E. उप, रक्ष to defend or protect, affix ल्युट्.
उपरचित: उपरचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made, prepared. E. उप and रचित made.
उपरत: उपरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stopped, ceased. 2 Dead. E. उप before रम to please, क्त aff.
उपरतस्पृह: उपरतस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Void of desire. E. उपरत and स्पृह desire.
उपरति: उपरति f. (-तिः) 1 Stopping, ceasing. 2 Refraining from sensual enjoyment. 3 Abstaining from prescribed acts. 4 Great or exquisite pleasure. 5 Death. E. उप reverse or excess, रम to please, क्तिन् affix; also with घञ् affix उपरम or उपराम.
उपरमण: उपरमण n. (-णं) Abstaining from ceremonial acts or from the pleasures of sense, &c. 2 Ceasing, discontinuance. E. उप before रम to please, affix ल्युट्.
उपरस: उपरस m. (-सः) 1 A secondary mineral, as red chalk. bitumen, &c. 2 A secondary passion. 3 A subordinate flavour. E. उप minor, रस flavour, &c.
उपराग: उपराग m. (-गः) 1 An eclipse of the sun or moon. 2 Rāhu or the ascending node. 3 Calamity, affliction. 4 Misbehaviour, ill conduct. 5 Reproach, abuse. E. उप, रञ्ज to colour, घञ् aff.
उपराम: उपराम m. (-मः) Stopping, ceasing: see उपरति. E. उप, रम to please, घञ् aff.
उपरि: उपरि ind. On, upon, above. E. उप and रि aff.
उपरिगत: उपरिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone up, ascended. E. उपरि and गत gone.
उपरिचित: उपरिचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Piled over or above. E. उपरि and चित collected.
उपरिज: उपरिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) High, elevated, produced above. E. उपरि and ज born.
उपरिष्टात्: उपरिष्टात् ind. Up, above. E. उप and रिष्टातिल् aff.
उपरुद्ध: उपरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Obstructed, impeded. 2 Covered, spread. 3 Favoured, protected. E. उप and रुद्ध checked.
उपरोध: उपरोध m. (-धः) 1 Impediment, opposition, check, refusal. 2 Favour, protection. 3 Surrounding, blockading. 4 Binding, tying. 5 Taking hold of. E. उप before रुध to hinder, affix घञ्.
उपरोधक: उपरोधक n. (-कं) An inner room, a private apartment. E. उप near, रुध to enclose, वुन् aff.
उपर्य्युपरि: उपर्य्युपरि ind. 1 Over, upon, above, what is above. 2 Near, neighbouring. E. उपरि repeated.
उपल: उपल m. (-लः) A rock or stone, a precious stone or jewel. f. (-ला) Refined or candied sugar. E. उप near, ला to give or take; affix ड.
उपलक्ष्य: उपलक्ष्य mfn. (क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Inferable. m. (-क्ष्यः) 1 A prop, a stay, a support, an asylum. 2 An inference. E. उप near, लक्ष्य to be marked or sought.
उपलक्षण: उपलक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Designating or implying any analogous object where only one is specified, using a term in a generic sense. 2 Metaphorical or elliptical expression. E. उप comprehensive, लक्षण a mark or designation.
उपलक्षित: उपलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Comprehended, included, implied, understood. E. उप before, लक्ष to designate, क्त aff.
उपलब्ध: उपलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Obtained, received. 2 Understood, known. 3 Perceived. E. उप before लभ to get, क्त aff.
उपलब्धार्था: उपलब्धार्था f. (-र्था.) A tale, a true or probable story. E. उपलब्ध understood, अर्थ meaning.
उपलब्धि: उपलब्धि f. (-ब्धिः) 1 Mind, understanding. 2 Knowledge, especially religious. 3 Gain, acquisition. 4 Perceptibility, appearance. E. उप, लभ to obtain, क्तिन् aff.
उपलम्भ: उपलम्भ m. (-म्भः) Apprehension, conception, comprehension otherwise than from memory. E. उप near, लभि to obtain, घञ् aff.
उपलभ्य: उपलभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) 1 To be obtained. 2 To be understood. ind. Having observed. E. उप before लभ to get, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
उपलम्भ्य: उपलम्भ्य mfn. (-म्भ्यः-म्भ्या-म्भ्यं) Commendable, praiseworthy, respectable. E. उप before लभ to get, ण्यत् affix, and म augment.
उपलिङ्ग: उपलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A portent, a natural phaenomenon considered as announcing evil. E. उप over, लिगि to go, affix घञ्.
उपलिप्त: उपलिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Smeared, plastered. E. उप and लिप्त smeared.
उपलिप्सित: उपलिप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wishing to take or seize. E. उप before लभ to gain, desider. form, क्त aff.
उपलेप: उपलेप m. (-पः) Plastering, smearing, anointing. E. उप, लिप to smear, affix घञ्.
उपलेपन: उपलेपन n. (-नं) Smearing, plastering with cow dung, &c. E. उप, लिप to smear, ल्युट् aff.
उपवन: उपवन n. (-नं) A garden, a grove. E. उप like, and वन a wood.
उपवर्णन: उपवर्णन n. (-नं) Minute description. E. उप and वर्णन describing.
उपवर्तन: उपवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 A country inhabited or not. 2 An uninhabited country. 3 A division, a district or Pergana. 4 A kingdom. E. उप, वृत to abide, ल्युट् aff.
उपवर्त्तन: उपवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 A country inhabited or not. 2 An uninhabited country. 3 A division, a district or Pergana. 4 A kingdom. E. उप, वृत to abide, ल्युट् aff.
उपवर्ष: उपवर्ष m. (-र्षः) The name of a saint.
उपवर्ह: उपवर्ह m. (-र्हः) A pillow. E. उप over, वर्ह to excel, &c. घञ् aff.
उपवसथ: उपवसथ m. (-थः) A village. E. उप, वस to abide, थक् Uṇādi aff.
उपवस्त: उपवस्त n. (-स्तं) A fast, fasting. E. उप, वस to abide, क्त affix; or with घञ् affix उपवास.
उपवास: उपवास n. (-सः) 1 A fast, fasting: when observed as a religious act, it comprises abstinence from all sensual gratification, from perfumes, flowers, unguents, ornaments, betel, music and dancing, &c. 2 A fire altar. E. उप before वस to abide, घञ् aff.
उपवासिन्: उपवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Fasting, one who observes a fast. E. उपवास and इनि aff.
उपवाहन: उपवाहन n. (-नं) Carrying, bringing back. E. उप and वाहन bearing.
उपवाह्य: उपवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) 1 A king's elephant. 2 Any royal vehicle. E. उप above, वह to bear, ण्यत् aff.
उपविद्या: उपविद्या f. (-द्या) Profane science, inferior sort of knowledge. E. उप and विद्या knowledge.
उपविष: उपविष n. (-षं) 1 Factitious poison. 2 A narcotic, any deleterious drug, as opium, Datura, &c. E. उप like, विष poison. f. (-षा) A plant, Atis. E. उप reverse, and विष poison: an antidote.
उपविष्ट: उपविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Seated, sitting. 2 Arrived, entered. E. उप upon, विष्ट placed, entered.
उपवीत: उपवीत n. (-तं) The thread or cord worn by the three first classes of Hindus, over the left shoulder and under the right. E. उप much, वी to shine, affix क्त; see उपनय.
उपवीतिन्: उपवीतिन् m. (-ती) The Brahman who wears the string in the usual manner, or on the left shoulder and under the right arm. E. उपवीत and इनि aff.
उपवृंहित: उपवृंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Collected from, possessed of. E. उप and वृंहित collected.
उपवेद: उपवेद m. (-दः) A minor Veda, or which four are reckoned, treating of the military art, medicine, music, and mechanics. E. उप and वेद a Veda.
उपवेश: उपवेश m. (-शः) 1 Sitting, resting. 2 A seat. 3 Voiding by stool. E. उप before विश to enter, affix घञ्.
उपवेशन: उपवेशन n. (-नं) 1 Sitting, resting. 2 Voiding by stool. E. उप before विश to enter, active or causal form, ल्युट् aff.
उपवेश्य: उपवेश्य ind. Having seated or caused to sit. E. उप before विश to enter, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
उपव्याघ्र: उपव्याघ्र m. (-घ्रः) The hunting leopard. E. उप and व्याघ्र a tiger.
उपशम: उपशम m. (-मः) 1 Tranquillity, calmness, patience. 2 Intermission, cessation, relaxation. E. उप much, शम to be tranquil, अप् aff.
उपशय: उपशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Productive of happiness or rest. m. (-यः) 1 Ascertainment of disease or diagnosis by the effect of certain articles of food or medicine. 2 Allaying disease by diet, regimen, &c. E. उप before शी to sleep, अञ् aff.
उपशल्य: उपशल्य n. (-ल्यं) A space near a village. E. उप near, शल to go, यत् aff.
उपशान्त: उपशान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Calm, tranquil. 2 Appeased, pacified. 3 Diminished, intermitted. E. उप before शम to be tranquil, क्त aff.
उपशान्ति: उपशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Tranquillity, calm. 2 Appeasing, allaying. 3 Cessation, intermission, remission. E. उप before शम to be quiet, क्तिन् aff.
उपशान्तिन्: उपशान्तिन् mfn. (-न्ती-न्तिनी-न्ति) Tranquil, calm, appeased, tame. (-न्ती) A tame elephant. E. उपशान्त and इनि aff.
उपशाय: उपशाय m. (-यः) Watching and sleeping alternately. E. उप alternately, -शी to sleep, घञ् aff.
उपशायिता: उपशायिता f. (-ता) 1 Tranquillizing, calming. 2 Secondary means of cure, as diet, &c. E. उपशायिन् and तल् affix; also with त्व, उपशायित्वं.
उपशायिन्: उपशायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Allaying, tranquillizing, what calms, &c. 2 (In medicine,) Composing, narcotic. E. उप before शी to sleep, causal form, णिनि aff.
उपशोभित: उपशोभित mfn. (तः-ता-तं) Adorned. E. उप and शोभित beautified.
उपश्रुत: उपश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Promised, agreed. E. उप with श्रु to hear, affix क्त.
उपश्रुति: उपश्रुति f. (-तिः) 1 Promise, assent. 2 Judicial astrology, aspect of the stars, fortune-telling. E. उप above, श्रु to hear, क्तिन् aff.
उपसंक्षेप: उपसंक्षेप m. (-पः) An abstract or compendium. E. उप and संक्षेप abridgement.
उपसंख्यान: उपसंख्यान n. (-नं) (In grammar,) A substitute in form or sense, a consignificant term or affix. E. उप near, संख्या to number, ल्युट् aff.
उपसंग्रह: उपसंग्रह m. (-हः) Obeisance, civil address, respectful salutation of a person by name. 2 Taking, holding. E. उप near, सम् with, ग्रह to take, affix घञ्, or with ल्युट् affix उपसंग्रहण.
उपसंग्राह्य: उपसंग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 Respectable, venerable. 2 To be saluted reverentially. E. उप and सं before ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.
उपसंगृह्य: उपसंगृह्य ind. Having taken, holding. E. उप and सं before ग्रह to take, ल्यप् aff.
उपसंव्यान: उपसंव्यान n. (-नं) A lower garment. E. उप and सं before व्येञ् to cover, ल्युट् affix; what covers the body.
उपसंहरण: उपसंहरण n. (-णं) 1 Refusing, withholding. 2 Excluding. 3 Taking away. 4 Attacking, invading. E. उप and सम् before हरण taking.
उपसंहरत्: उपसंहरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Taking away. 2 Refusing, excepting. 3 Going against, invading. E. उप and सं before हृ to take, शतृ aff.
उपसंहार: उपसंहार m. (-रः) 1 Witholding, refusing. 2 Taking away. 3 Excepting, excluding. 4 Destruction, death, end. 5 Collection, assemblage. 6 A compendium. 7 Brevity, conciseness. 8 Attacking, invasion. 9 (In logic,) Refutation. E. उप and सम् before हृ to take, घञ् aff.
उपसंहृत: उपसंहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Withheld, denied, refused. 2 Excepted. 3 Compressed, comprehended, excluded. E. उप and सम् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
उपसंहृति: उपसंहृति f. (-तिः) 1 A compound expressive of various meanings. 2 Comprehension. 3 Seizing, taking. E. उप and सम् before हृ to take, क्तिन् aff.
उपसत्ति: उपसत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Meeting, union. 2 Service. 3 Gift, donation. E. उप with, षद to go, &c. क्तिन् aff.
उपसद: उपसद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who goes near to. m. (-दः) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Approach. E. उप and षद to go, affix अच्.
उपसदन: उपसदन n. (-नं) A neighbouring abode, a neighbourhood. E. उप near, and सदन a dwelling.
उपसन्ध्यम्: उपसन्ध्यम् ind. Near evening. E. उप near, सन्ध्या evening.
उपसन्न: उपसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Approached, approximate. E. उप over, षद to go, affix क्त.
उपसन्नता: उपसन्नता f. (-ता) Proximity, approach. E. उपसन्न and तल् affix; also उपसन्नत्वं with त्व aff.
उपसमाधान: उपसमाधान n. (-नं) Placing, putting in or on. E. उप and सम् with आङ् before धा to have, ल्युट् aff.
उपसम्पन्न: उपसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Dressed, cooked. 2 Immolated, sacrificed, (as a victim, &c.) 3 Dead, deceased. 4 Gained, obtained. 5 Enough, sufficient. 6 Perfected, finished. E. उप and सम् prefixed to पद to go, affix क्त.
उपसर: उपसर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 The first pregnancy or impregnation of a cow, &c. 2 Who or what approaches. E. उप, सृ to go, and अप् aff.
उपसर्ग: उपसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A portent, a natural phaenomenon supposed to announce future evil, an eclipse, &c. 2 A particle prefixed to roots, &c. a preposition. 3 A disease, possession by an evil spirit. 4 Change occasioned by any disease. 5 A disease brought on whilst a person labours under another. 6 Indication or symptom of death. E. उप near or with, सृज to go, घञ् aff.
उपसर्जन: उपसर्जन n. (-नं) 1 A representative, a substitute, any person or thing subordinate or subsidiary. 2 Portent, eclipse. 3 Approaching. E. उप inferior, सृज to go, ल्युट् affix. In the first. sense, though used as an attributive, it is always neuter.
उपसर्पण: उपसर्पण n. (-णं) Approaching, advancing to. E. उप near, सृप to to, ल्युट् aff.
उपसर्या: उपसर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A cow, (fit for the bull.) E. उप, सृ to go, यत् affix, deriv. irr.
उपसर्य्या: उपसर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A cow, (fit for the bull.) E. उप, सृ to go, यत् affix, deriv. irr.
उपसार्य: उपसार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be approached or gone to. E. उप, सृ to go, ण्यत् aff.
उपसार्य्य: उपसार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be approached or gone to. E. उप, सृ to go, ण्यत् aff.
उपसुन्द: उपसुन्द m. (-न्दः) The name of a demon. E. उप, and सुन्द another demon.
उपसूर्यक: उपसूर्य्यक n. (-कं) The disk of the sun or moon. E. उप near, or with, सूर्य्य the sun, कन् affix of identity.
उपसूर्य्यक: उपसूर्य्यक n. (-कं) The disk of the sun or moon. E. उप near, or with, सूर्य्य the sun, कन् affix of identity.
उपसृत्य: उपसृत्य ind. Having approached. E. उप before सृ to go, ल्यप् aff.
उपसृष्ट: उपसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Attended by or accompanied with, jointed. attached, connected, to or with. 2 Eclipsed, (as the sun or moon.) 3 Seized by, possessed by, (evil demons, &c.) n. (-ष्टं) Coition, copulation. E. उप, सृज to create, &c. affix क्त.
उपसेवन: उपसेवन n. (-नं) 1 Service. 2 Addiction to. E. उप and सेव to serve, ल्युट् aff.
उपस्कर: उपस्कर m. (-रः) 1 A condiment, a spice or seasoning, mustard, pepper, &c. 2 An article of household use, as a broom, a basket, &c. 3 Blame, censure. E. उप complete, and कर what makes, स inserted.
उपस्कृत: उपस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blamed, censured. E. उप and कृत made, स inserted.
उपस्तम्भ: उपस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) Support of life, as food, sleep, and government of the passions. E. उप and स्तभि to stop, घञ् aff.
उपस्त्री: उपस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A concubine. E. उप and स्त्री a female, a wife.
उपस्थ: उपस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Near, proximate. m. (-स्थः) 1 The male or female organs of generation. 2 The haunch or hip. 3 The anus. E. उप near, and स्थ what is or stays, ड affix after स्था.
उपस्थनिग्रह: उपस्थनिग्रह m. (-हः) Continence. E. उपस्थ an organ of generation, and निग्रह restraining.
उपस्थातृ: उपस्थातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) A servant. E. उप, स्था to remain, तृच् aff.
उपस्थान: उपस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Proximity, nearness. 2 Obtaining, getting. 3 An assembly. E. उप near, स्था to stay, ल्युट् aff.
उपस्थानीय: उपस्थानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be stayed with or near. 2 What ought to be near or with. E. उप, स्था to stay, अनीयर् aff.
उपस्थापक: उपस्थापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Placing or bringing near to. 2 Explaining, teaching, a teacher. 3 Causing to obtain. E. उप before स्था to be, causal form, वुन् aff.
उपस्थापन: उपस्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Placing near. 2 Attendance, service. E. उप and स्थापन placing.
उपस्थापयितव्य: उपस्थापयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be placed near. E. उप before स्था to stay, causal form, तव्य affix; also उपस्थापनीय.
उपस्थापित: उपस्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed near to. 2 Attended. E. उप before स्था to stay, causal form, क्त aff.
उपस्थाय: उपस्थाय ind. 1 Having approached. 2 Having brought near to or assembled. E. उप near, and स्था to stay, ल्यप् aff.
उपस्थायिन्: उपस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Standing near, being present. E. उप before स्था to stay, णिनि affix, युक् augment.
उपस्थित: उपस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Approached, arrived. 2 Staying by or near to. 3 Caused, occasioned. 4 Got, received. 5 Felt. 6 Clean, cleansed. 7 Done, accomplished. 8 Known. E. उप, स्था to stay, affix क्त.
उपस्थिति: उपस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Proximity. 2 Obtaining, getting. 3 Effecting, accomplishing. 4 Arrival. 5 Knowledge. E. उप before स्था to be, affix क्तिन्.
उपस्पर्श: उपस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) 1 Touching, contact. 2 Bathing, ablution. 3 Rincing the mouth, sipping water and ejecting it. E. उप like, स्पर्श touch, from स्पृश to touch, and अच् affix; or with ल्युट् affix, उपस्पर्शन.
उपस्पृष्ट: उपस्पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Touched. 2 Sipped. E. उप and स्पृष्ट touched.
उपस्वत्व: उपस्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Revenue, profit, what is derived from land or other capital. E. उप and खत्व ownership.
उपहत: उपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Destroyed. 2 Injured, impaired, evilly affected by. 3 Struck by lightning, &c. 4 Pained, hurt. 5 Impure. 6 Infected, polluted, vitiated. E. उप and हत struck.
उपहतदृश्: उपहतदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Dazzled, blinded. E. उपहत struck, दृश the eye.
उपहतात्मन्: उपहतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्मं) Agitated, affected as by passion, &c. E. उपहत and आत्मन् the soul.
उपहरण: उपहरण n. (-णं) 1 Offering gifts to superiors. 2 Presenting victims. 3 Distributing or serving out food. 4 Taking, seizing. E. उप and हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
उपहर्तव्य: उपहर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be offered as a victim. 2 To be presented. E. उप before हृ to take, तव्य affix; also उपहरणीय.
उपहर्त्तव्य: उपहर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be offered as a victim. 2 To be presented. E. उप before हृ to take, तव्य affix; also उपहरणीय.
उपहर्तृ: उपहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Offering victims, serving out food, &c. E. उप before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
उपहर्त्तृ: उपहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Offering victims, serving out food, &c. E. उप before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
उपहव: उपहव m. (-वः) 1 Calling to. 2 Summoning, invoking. E. उप before हृ to call, अप् aff.
उपहसित: उपहसित n. (-तं) Laughter, laughing. E. उप up, हसित laughing.
उपहार: उपहार m. (-रः) 1 A complimentary gift, a present to a superior, &c. 2 A victim, an offering to a deity. 3 Tribute, indemnification, presents as the price of peace. 4 Food distributed to guests, &c. E. उप, हृ to convey, घञ् aff.
उपहारिन्: उपहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Giving, presenting. 2 Sacrificing E. उपहार and इनि aff.
उपहालक: उपहालक m. (-कः) The name of a country, part of the peninsula: see कुन्तल. E. उप, हाल a king so named, affix कः, the country over which HĀLA reigned.
उपहास: उपहास m. (-सः) Ridicule, laughing at any one. E. उप and हस to laugh, affix घञ्.
उपहास्य: उपहास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Ridiculous, laughable. E. उप and हास्य to be laughed at.
उपहित: उपहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed, deposited, placed in or upon. 2 Laid aside. 3 Joined. 4 Mixed. E. उप before हा to quit, क्त aff.
उपहूय: उपहूय ind. Having called or addressed. E. उप near, ह्वे to call, ल्यप् aff.
उपहृत: उपहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken, collected, gathered. 2 Offered, presented. 3 Immolated, offered as a victim. 4 Served out as food. E. उप before हृ to take, क्त aff.
उपह्वर: उपह्वर n. (-रं) 1 Solitary, private. 2 Near. m. (-रः) A car, a carriage. E. उप, ह्वृ to bend, अप् aff.
उपांशु: उपांशु m. (-शुः) Muttering prayers, reciting them in a low voice so as not to be overheard. ind. 1 Solitary, private. 2 Secretly, in a whisper. E. उप, अंशु a ray.
उपाकरण: उपाकरण n. (-णं) 1 Performance of a preparatory rite before reading the Vedas. 2 Immolation, sacrifice of an animal duly consecrated. E. उप and आङ् prefixed to कृ to do, affix, ल्युट्.
उपाकर्मन्: उपाकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Preparation. 1 A ceremony performed before reading the Vedas. 2 Beginning to read the Vedas. E. see the preceding, the affix being मनिन्.
उपाकर्म्मन्: उपाकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Preparation. 1 A ceremony performed before reading the Vedas. 2 Beginning to read the Vedas. E. see the preceding, the affix being मनिन्.
उपाकृत: उपाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Attended with evil omens, disastrous, calamitous. m. (-तः) 1 A victim slain or to be slain. 2 A portent, a phaenomenon announcing calamity. E. उप and आङ् before कृत made.
उपाख्यान: उपाख्यान n. (-नं) 1 A tale, a narrative. 2 Telling, narration. E. उप and आख्यान a tale.
उपागत: उपागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Suffering, feeling. 2 Promised. 3 Approached, arrived. 4 Occurred, happened. E. उप and आङ् before गम to go, affix क्त.
उपागम: उपागम m. (-मः) 1 Promise, agreement. 2 Approach. 3 Occurrence, arrival. 4 Feeling, suffering. E. उप near, आङ् before गम to come, अच् aff.
उपाग्रहण: उपाग्रहण m. (-णं) Reading the Vedas after initiation. E. उप and आङ् before ग्रह to take, ल्युट् affix: see उपाकरण.
उपाङ्ग: उपाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The sectarial mark made with Sandal, &c. on the forehead. 2 Any minor limb or member. 3 Secondary portion of science. E. उप and अङ्ग the body.
उपाञ्जन: उपाञ्जन n. (-नं) Plastering the ground with cow dung, &c. E. उप and अञ्जन anointing.
उपात्त: उपात्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Taken, received, gained, got. m. (-त्तः) An elephant out of rut. E. उप near, आत्त taken, seized.
उपात्तरंहस्: उपात्तरंहस् mfn. (-हाः-हाः-हः) Quick, fleet. E. उपात्त acquired, रंहस् speed.
उपात्तशास्त्र: उपात्तशास्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Armed, taking up arms. E. उपात्त and शास्त्र a weapon.
उपात्यय: उपात्यय m. (-यः) 1 Neglect or disobedience of ordinances or customs. 2 Disorder or disorderly behaviour. E. उप and अति prefixed to इण to go, अच् aff.
उपादान: उपादान n. (-नं) 1 Taking away, abduction, taking. 2 Abstraction, restraining the organs of sense and perception. 3 Cause, motive. 4 Immediate or proximate cause. 5 The formal or distinct form, the material cause. 6 A double meaning, an expression conveying a sense besides that which appears intended. 7 Saying, speaking. E. उप near, आदा to take, ल्युट् aff.
उपादानकारण: उपादानकारण n. (-णं) A proximate cause. E. उपादान and कारण cause.
उपादेय: उपादेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Acceptable, admissible, to be taken or received. 2 Excellent, admirable. E. उप and आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.
उपाधि: उपाधि m. (-धिः) 1 Virtuous reflection. 2 A discriminative or distinguishing property, an attribute. 3 Deception, disguise. (In the Vedānta this is especially applied to certain natural forms or properties, considered as disguises of the spirit.) 4 A title, a discriminative appellation, a nickname. 5 Careful or diligent for the support of a family, (always masculine, though with a feminine or neuter substantive.) 6 A purpose, an occasion, an object. 7 (In logic,) A special cause for a general effect. 3 (In rhetoric,) The natural character of species, quality, or action. E. उप and आङ् before धा to have, affix कि.
उपाध्याय: उपाध्याय m. (-यः) A spiritual preceptor. f. (-या) A female preceptor. (-यी or -यानी) The wife of a teacher. E. उप and अधि before इण to go, घञ् affix, for the fem. टाप् affix in the first instance, in the second ङीष् with or without आनुक inserted.
उपानह्: उपानह् f. (-नत्) A shoe. E. उप and आङ् before नह to bind, affix क्विप्.
उपान्त: उपान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Near. m. (-न्तः) The angle of the eye. E. उप near, अन्त end.
उपान्तिक: उपान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Near, proximate, neighbouring. E. उपान्त and ठञ् aff.
उपान्त्य: उपान्त्य m. (-न्त्यः) The corner of the eye. n. (-न्त्यं) Vicinity. E. उप and अन्त्य end.
उपाय: उपाय m. (-यः) 1 A means, an expedient, a way. 2 A means of success against an enemy; four are usually enumerated as, sowing dissension, chastisement, conciliation and gifts. 3 Approaching, approach. E. उप and आङ् before इण to go, affix घञ्.
उपायज्ञ: उपायज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Fertile in expedients, contriving, providing for. E. उपाय and ज्ञ who knows.
उपायन: उपायन n. (-नं) 1 A present, a complimentary or respectful gift. 2 Approaching, going near to. 3 Engaging in a religious observance. E. उप, अय to go, ल्युट् aff.
उपायिन्: उपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Expert in the use of means. E. उपाय and इनि aff.
उपाययोग: उपाययोग m. (-गः) Application of means, or combination of expedients. E. उपाय and योग union.
उपार्जन: उपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquiring property, earning. E. उप and अर्ज्जन gaining.
उपार्ज्जन: उपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquiring property, earning. E. उप and अर्ज्जन gaining.
उपार्जित: उपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained, acquired, earned. E. उप and अर्ज्जित gained.
उपार्ज्जित: उपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained, acquired, earned. E. उप and अर्ज्जित gained.
उपारत: उपारत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Engaged in, occupied by. 2 Frequenting, resorting to. E. उप and आङ् before रम to sport, क्त.
उपारम: उपारम m. (-मः) 1 Engaging in. 2 Going to or in. E. उप and आङ् before रम to sport, affix अच्.
उपालब्ध: उपालब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Reproached, reviled. E. उप and आङ् before लभि to hurt, affix क्त.
उपालम्भ: उपालम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Abuse, reviling. 2 Deferring, delaying. E. उप and आङ्, लभि to injure, अच् aff.
उपावर्तन: उपावर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning round, revolving. 2 Ceasing. 3 Turning back, returning. 4 Approaching. E. उप and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
उपावर्त्तन: उपावर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning round, revolving. 2 Ceasing. 3 Turning back, returning. 4 Approaching. E. उप and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
उपावृत्त: उपावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Rolling on the ground. 2 Ceased, ceasing, refraining. m. (-त्तः) A horse rolling himself on the ground. E. उप and आङ् before वृत to be, affix क्त.
उपाश्रय: उपाश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Asylum, support. 2 Reliance, dependance upon. E. उप and आङ् before श्री to serve, affix अच्.
उपाश्रित: उपाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Supporting, (literally or figuratively,) bearing, holding, protecting. 2 Relying or depending upon. E. उप near, and आश्रित giving support.
उपासक: उपासक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Worshipping, a worshipper. 2 Serving, a servant. 3 A Śūdra. E. उप before अस to be, वुन् aff.
उपासङ्ग: उपासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A quiver. E. उप and आङ् before षञ्ज to embrace, घञ् aff.
उपासन: उपासन n. (-नं) 1 Archery. 2 Service. 3 A seat. 4 Assembling. 5 Injuring, hurting. f. (-ना) 1 Service. 2 Worship, adoration. E. उप, आस to sit, or आङ् before उस to throw or send, affix युच् and fem. टाप्.
उपासित: उपासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Served, honoured, worshipped. 2 Serving, paying worship or service. E. उप inferiority, आस to sit or remain, affix क्त.
उपासितृ: उपासितृ m. (-ता) A worshipper. E. उप and आङ् before आस to sit, तृन् aff.
उपासीन: उपासीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Sitting with or near to. 2 Occupying. E. उप and आसीन seated.
उपास्ति: उपास्ति f. (-स्तिः) Service, especially of a deity, worship. E. उप and आस to sit, क्तिन् aff.
उपास्य: उपास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be worshipped or served. ind. 1 Having served or worshipped. 2 Having associated or called together. E. उप before आस to sit, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
उपास्यमान: उपास्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being served or worshipped, receiving homage. E. उप before आस to sit, शानच् aff.
उपाहित: उपाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Joined, annexed. 2 Deposited, placed. 3 Put on, worn. 4 Agreed upon, made or done mutually. (-तः) A fiery portent, a meteor, a comet. E. उप and आङ् before धा to have or hold, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
उपाहृत: उपाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Prepared. 2 Taken, seized. E. उप and आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
उपेक्षक: उपेक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining. 2 Patient, enduring. E. उप before ईक्ष to see, वुन् aff.
उपेक्षण: उपेक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Leaving, abandoning. 5 Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining. E. उप and ईक्षण seeing.
उपेक्षा: उपेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Trick, deceit, one of the minor expedients in war. 2 Abandoning, leaving. 3 Dissent. 4 Negligence, neglect. 5 Endurance, patience. 6 Contempt, disdain. E. उप, ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् affs.
उपेक्षित: उपेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disregarded, disesteemed, neglected, disdained. E. उप, and ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
उपेत: उपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Endowed with, possessed of, having, possessing. 2 Arrived at, come to, come near to. 3 Invested. E. उप and इत gone.
उपेतृ: उपेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Contriving, a contriver, one who employs expedients. 2 Approaching, going near to. E. उप before इण to go, तृच् aff.
उपेन्द्र: उपेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. उप after, इन्द्र INDRA: born subsequently to INDRA.
उपेन्द्रवज्रा: उपेन्द्रवज्रा f. (-ज्रा) A species of the Triṣṭubh metre.
उपेय: उपेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be sought, to be had recourse to. 2 To be gone to or approached. 3 To be effected by any means. E. उप before इण to go, यत् aff.
उपेयिवस्: उपेयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वत्) 1 Accompanied or followed by, associated with, united. 2 Obtained, got. E. उप near, इण to go, क्वसु aff.
उपेयुस्: उपेयुस् mfn. (-यूः-यूः-युः) Arrived at, gone to. E. उप before इण to go, उस् aff.
उपोढ: उपोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Married. 3 Arrayed, arranged. E. उप before, वह to bear, affix क्त.
उपोती: उपोती f. (-ती) A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.) E. उप much, उद water, deriv. irr.
उपोदिका: उपोदिका f. (-का) A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.) E. उप and उद water, कन् and टाप् affixes, and इ substituted for the pen. or ई being substituted उपोदीका.
उपोद्घात: उपोद्घात m. (-तः) 1 A beginning, a thing begun. 2 An introduction, a preface. 3 An example, an apposite argument or illustration. 4 Analysis, the ascertainment of the elements of which a thing consists. E. उप before हन to injure, affix घञ्.
उपोषण: उपोषण n. (-णं) A fast, fasting. E. उप, वस to abide, affix ल्युट्.
उपोषित: उपोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fasted, fasting. (-तं) Fast, fasting. E. उप before वस to abide, क्त aff.
उप्त: उप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Sown, (as seed.) E. वप to sow, affix क्त.
उप्तकृष्ट: उप्तकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ploughed after sowing. E. उप्त and कृष्ट ploughed.
उप्ति: उप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Sowing seeds. E. वप to sow, क्तिन् aff.
उप्तिविद्: उप्तिविद् m. (-वित् or -विद्) An agriculturist. E. उप्ति and विद who knows.
उप्तिम: उप्तिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Sown, cultivated. E. वप to sow, क्त्रि affix, and मम् added.
उब्ज: उब्ज r. 6th cl. (उब्जति) To be straight: with नि prefixed, (न्युब्जति) To be crooked: this root is also written उब्ज and उद्ज.
उभ: उभ r. 6th cl. (उभति) To fill; also उम्भ.
उभ pron. m. and dual only, (उभौ) Both.
उभय: उभय pron. (sing. and plu. only,) (-यः-ये) Both. E. उभ and य from या to obtain, affix ड.
उभयतस्: उभयतस् ind. On both sides. E. उभय both, and तसि aff.
उभयतोदत्: उभयतोदत् mf. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Having a double row of teeth, (man, animal, &c.) E. उभयतस् and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
उभयतोमुख: उभयतोमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking either way, two-faced. E. उमयतस् and मुख face.
उभयत्र: उभयत्र ind. In both places, on both sides. E. उभय and त्रल् aff.
उभयथा: उभयथा ind. In both ways. E. उभय and थाल् aff.
उभयद्युस्: उभयद्युस् ind. Both days, the day past and to come. E. उभय both, द्युस् affix; or with एद्युस् affix, उभयेद्युस्.
उभयभागहर: उभयभागहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Applicable to two purposes. 2 Taking two shares or parts. n. (-रं) A medicine that acts in two ways, as an emetic and a purge. E. उभय, भाग a part, and हर what takes.
उभयवेतन: उभयवेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Serving two masters, being in the pay of both. E. उभय and वेतन wages.
उभयसम्भव: उभयसम्भव m. (-वः) A dilemma. E. उभय both, (conclusions,) सम्भव production.
उभयानुमत: उभयानुमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Agreed to or accepted mutually, or on both sides. E. उभय and अनुमत assented to.
उभयार्थम्: उभयार्थम् ind. For a double object, (as for prosperity in earth and happiness in heaven.) E. उभय and अर्थ an object.
उम्: उम् ind. An interjection, 1 Of anger. 2 Interrogation. 3 Promise or assent; and 4 Of cordiality or pacification.
उम: उम m. (-मः) 1 A city, a town. 2 A wharf, a landing place, f. (-मा) 1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ or DURGĀ. 2 Light, splendor. 3 Fame, reputation. 4 Turmeric. 5 Flax, (Linum utilatissimum.) 6 Quiet, tranquillity. E. उ particle of calling, and मा prohibition: i. e. “Practise not austerities,” the exclamation addressed to DURGĀ by her mother: in the other senses it may be derived from मा to measure, or मा lustre.
उमाकट: उमाकट m. (-टः) The cluster of flax. E. उमा flax, कच् aff.
उमागुरु: उमागुरु m. (-रुः) The mountain Himālaya. E. उमा the goddess, and गुरु a spiritual teacher: in mythology the personified mountain is the father of UMĀ.
उमापति: उमापति m. (-तिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. उमा and पति master; the husband of UMĀ.
उमावन: उमावन n. (-नं) A name of Vanapura or Devī Koṭa, (Devi Cote.) E. उमा and वन a grove; the residence of UMĀ.
उमासुत: उमासुत m. (-तः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. उमा and सुत a son, the son of PĀRVATĪ.
उमेश: उमेश m. (-शः) A title of ŚIVA. E. उमा and ईश a lord: see उमापति.
उम्भ: उम्भ r. 6th cl. (प) (उम्भति) To fill; also उभ.
उम्य: उम्य n. (-म्यं) A field of linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.) E. उमा flax, and यत् affix; also औमीन.
उम्वर: उम्वर m. (-रः) The upper-timber of a door frame. E. उद् up, above, वृ to screen, अप् aff.
उम्वी: उम्वी f. (-म्वी) The stalks of wheat or barley friend over a fire of wet grass, considered as a tonic.
उरःक्षत: उरःक्षत n. (-तं) Injury of the lungs, breaking a blood vessel, consumption. E. उरस् and क्षत lesion.
उरःस्थल: उरःस्थल n. (-लं) The breast, the bosom. E. उरस् the breast, and स्थल place.
उरःसूत्रिका: उरःसूत्रिका f. (-का) A pearl necklace. E. उरस् the breast, सूत्र a thread, टच् aff.
उरग: उरग m. (-गः) A snake. E. उरस् the breast, and ग who goes, from गम to go, affix ड; also उरङ्ग and उरङ्गम.
