उरगस्थान: उरगस्थान n. (-नं) The infernal regions below the earth. E. उरग and स्थान a place or country; the abode of the Nāgas or serpents.
उरगारि: उरगारि m. (-रिः) 1 GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU. 2 A large crane. E. उरग a snake, and अरि the enemy.
उरगाशन: उरगाशन n. (-नं) 1 A name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU. 2 The gigantic crane. E. उरग and अशन food; whose food is of serpents.
उरगेन्द्र: उरगेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The king of snakes, ŚEṢA or VĀSUKI. E. उरग and इन्द्र chief.
उरङ्ग: उरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A snake, a serpent: see उरग, the affix being खच्; also उरङ्गम.
उरण: उरण m. (-णः) 1 A ram. 2 A cloud. f. (-णी) A ewe. E. ऋ to go, क्यु affix, leaving ण, and उ substituted for the antepenultimate.
उरणाक्ष: उरणाक्ष m. (-क्षः) Cassia, (Alata.) E. उरण ram, अक्ष an eye: the flower being so compared: क being added, also उरणाक्षक.
उरणाख्य: उरणाख्य m. (-ख्यः) Cassia: see the preceding. E. उरण and आख्या a name; named from the ram; also उरणाख्यक, क being added.
उरभ्र: उरभ्र m. (-भ्रः) A ram. E. उरु much, भ्रम to wander, ड affix, and the final of उरु dropped.
उररी: उररी ind. A particle implying, 1 Assent. 2 Expansion: (it chiefly occurs in composition.) E. वे to weave, ररीक aff.
उररीकार: उररीकार m. (-रः) A promise, an agreement. E. उररी, कार what makes.
उररीकृत: उररीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed. 2 Spread, diffused. E. उररी and कृत made.
उरश्छद: उरश्छद m. (-दः) Armour, mail. E. उरस् the breast, and छद a covering.
उरस्: उरस् mfn. (उराः-उराः-उरः) Best, excellent. n. (-रः) The breast, the bosom. E. ऋ to go, Uṇādi affix असुन्, the pen. changed to उ; also उर a Sautra root, to go, and असुन् as before.
उरसिज: उरसिज m. (-जः) The female breast. E. उरस् the breast, in the 7th case, ज produced.
उरसिरुह: उरसिरुह m. (-हः) The female breast. E. उरसि on the breast, and रुह what grows.
उरसिल: उरसिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Broad-chested, having a full or broad breast. E. उरस् and इलच् aff.
उरस्कट: उरस्कट m. (-टः) The sacrificial thread hung round the neck and upon the breast, as it is sometimes worn. E. उरस् the breast, कट to encompass, अल् aff.
उरस्तस्: उरस्तस् ind. From the breast. E. उरस् and तसि aff.
उरस्त्राण: उरस्त्राण n. (-णं) Mail, the breastplate or cuirass. E. उरस्, त्रै to preserve, affix ल्युट्.
उरस्य: उरस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) From the breast. mf. (-स्यः-स्या) A legitimate son or daughter, that is, one born from a married couple of the same tribe or cast. E. उरस the breast, and यत् aff.
उरस्वत्: उरस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Broad-chested, full-breasted, strong. E. उरस् and मतुप् poss. aff.
उराह: उराह m. (-हः) A horse of a pale colour, with dark legs.
उरी: उरी ind. A particle, implying, (especially in composition,) 1 Promise, assent. 2 Expansion; also उररी and ऊरी.
उरीकार: उरीकार m. (-रः) 1 Promise. 2 Extension. E. उरी, and कार what makes.
उरीकृत: उरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised. 2 Expanded, spread. E. उरी and कृत made; also उररीकृत and ऊरीकृत.
उरु: उरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-र्व्वी-रु) 1 Large, great. 2 Much, excessive. 3 Long. 4 Valuable, precious. E. ऊर्णु to cover, कु Uṇādi affix; ऊ is made short, and ण dropped by special rule.
उरुकाल: उरुकाल m. (-लः) A creeper, (Cucumis colocynthis.) E. उरु and काल time, of long growth; also with कन् added उरुकालकः.
उरुगाय: उरुगाय m. (-यः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. उरग a snake, इ to go, and अच् aff.
उरुतर: उरुतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Greater, larger. E. उरु and तरप् aff.
उरुतम: उरुतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Greatest. E. उरु and तमप्.
उरुताप: उरुताप m. (-पः) Great heat. उरु much, ताप heat.
उरुत्व: उरुत्व n. (-त्वं) Magnitude, vastness. E. उरु and त्व affix; also उरुता.
उरुमार्ग: उरुमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A long road. E. उरु and मार्गं a road.
उरुरी: उरुरी ind. A particle, of, 1 Assent. 2 Expansion: see उररी.
उरुवुक: उरुवुक m. (-कः) The castor-oil tree, (Palma christi or Ricinus communis). E. उरु great or much, (disease,) वै to wither or dry, affix उक deriv. irr. or with ऊक affix उरुवूक.
उरुव्यचस्: उरुव्यचस् m. (-चाः) A malignant sprite, an imp or goblin. E. उरु much, व्यच to deceive, असुन् Uṇādi aff.
उरुसत्त्व: उरुसत्त्व mfn. (-त्त्वः-त्त्वा-त्त्वं) Magnanimous, of a lofty nature. E. उरु and सत्त्व disposition.
उरुहार: उरुहार m. (-रः) A valuable necklace. E. उरु and हार a necklace.
उरोगामिन्: उरोगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Creeping, crawling, going on the belly as a reptile. E. उरस् and गामिन् who goes.
उरोग्रह: उरोग्रह m. (-हः) Pain of the chest, pleurisy. E. उरस and ग्रह what seizes.
उरोघात: उरोघात m. (-तः) 1 Striking or beating the breast. 2 Pain in the chest. E. उरस and घात a wound.
उरोज: उरोज m. (-जः) The female breast. E. उरस् the breast, and ज produced.
उर्जित: उर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, left. E. वर्ज्ज to abandon, क्त affix, and the vowel substituted.
उर्ज्जित: उर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, left. E. वर्ज्ज to abandon, क्त affix, and the vowel substituted.
उर्णनाभ: उर्णनाभ m. (-भः) A spider. E. उर्ण wool, नाभि a navel, affix ड.
उर्णा: उर्णा f. (-र्णा) 1 Wool, felt, the hair of camels, &c. 2 A circle of hair between the eye-brows. E. उर्णु to cover, ड affix; the word is properly ऊर्णा, q. v.
उर्द: उर्द r. 1st cl. (उर्दते) 1 To measure. 2 To play. 3 To be easy or cheerful.
उर्द्र: उर्द्र m. (-र्द्रः) An otter. E. उर्द to play, रन् aff.
उर्व: उर्व्व r. 1st cl. (ई,) उर्वी (उर्वति) To kill or hurt.
उर्व्व: उर्व्व r. 1st cl. (ई,) उर्वी (उर्वति) To kill or hurt.
उर्वट: उर्व्वट m. (-टः) A year. E. उरु much, and अट to go, अच् aff.
उर्व्वट: उर्व्वट m. (-टः) A year. E. उरु much, and अट to go, अच् aff.
उर्वरा: उर्व्वरा f. (-रा) 1 Fertile soil, yielding every kind of crop. 2 Land in general. E. उरू much, ऋ to go, अप् and टाप् affs.
उर्व्वरा: उर्व्वरा f. (-रा) 1 Fertile soil, yielding every kind of crop. 2 Land in general. E. उरू much, ऋ to go, अप् and टाप् affs.
उर्वशी: उर्व्वशी f. (-शी) The name of one of the courtezans of Svarga or INDRA'S heaven. E. उरु great, वश to tame, अच् and ङीष् affixes; also उर्व्वसी and ऊर्व्वसी.
उर्व्वशी: उर्व्वशी f. (-शी) The name of one of the courtezans of Svarga or INDRA'S heaven. E. उरु great, वश to tame, अच् and ङीष् affixes; also उर्व्वसी and ऊर्व्वसी.
उर्वशीरमण: उर्व्वशीरमण m. (-णः) The name of AILA or PURŪRAVAS, the second king of the line of the moon. E. उर्व्वशी, and रमण the gallant or husband of the Apsaras URVAŚĪ.
उर्व्वशीरमण: उर्व्वशीरमण m. (-णः) The name of AILA or PURŪRAVAS, the second king of the line of the moon. E. उर्व्वशी, and रमण the gallant or husband of the Apsaras URVAŚĪ.
उर्वशीवल्लभ: उर्व्वशीवल्लभ m. (-भः) A name of AILA: see the preceding. E. as before, वल्लभ a friend, a lover, &c.
उर्व्वशीवल्लभ: उर्व्वशीवल्लभ m. (-भः) A name of AILA: see the preceding. E. as before, वल्लभ a friend, a lover, &c.
उर्वारु: उर्व्वारु m. (-रुः) A kind of cucumber, (cucumis utilatissimus:) see इर्व्वारु.
उर्व्वारु: उर्व्वारु m. (-रुः) A kind of cucumber, (cucumis utilatissimus:) see इर्व्वारु.
उर्वी: उर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) The earth. E. उरु great, ङीष् aff.
उर्व्वी: उर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) The earth. E. उरु great, ङीष् aff.
उर्वीधर: उर्व्वीधर m. (-रः) 1 A mountain. 2 The serpent ŚEṢA. E. उर्व्वी the earth, and धर what holds.
उर्व्वीधर: उर्व्वीधर m. (-रः) 1 A mountain. 2 The serpent ŚEṢA. E. उर्व्वी the earth, and धर what holds.
उर्वीरुह: उर्व्वीरुह m. (-हः) A tree. E. उर्व्वी and रुह what grows on.
उर्व्वीरुह: उर्व्वीरुह m. (-हः) A tree. E. उर्व्वी and रुह what grows on.
उलप: उलप mn. (-पः-पं) 1 A creeping plant, a spreading creeper. m. (-पः) A kind of grass or reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. वल to be strong, अपच् affix; also उलुप्.
उलिन्द: उलिन्द m. (-न्दः) The name of a country. E. उल to burn, किन्दच् aff.
उलुप: उलुप mn. (-पः-पं) A spreading creeper. m. (-पः) A reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. वल to be strong, उपच् affix; also उलप and उलूप.
उलुपिन्: उलुपिन् m. (-पी) A porpoise, or fish resembling it. E. उ for उत् up, लुप to disturb, &c. णिनि affix; also उलूपिन्, ऊलुपिन्, उल्लुपिन्, &c.
उलूक: उलूक m. (-कः) 1 An owl. 2 A name of INDRA. 3 One of the heroes of the Mahābhārata. n. (-कं) A kind of reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. वल to be strong, ऊकः aff.
उलूखल: उलूखल n. (-लं) 1 A wooden mortar used for cleaning rice. 2 Bdellium, a gummy substance. E. उद्, up ख empty, and ल what takes: or उदू for उद्, and खल what goes; द is changed to लः see उदूखल.
उलूखलिक: उलूखलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Pounded in a mortar, cleansed. E. उलूखल and ठक् aff.
उलूखलक: उलूखलक m. (-लः) A name of Bdellium, a gummy substance, or the plant which produces it. E. कन् added to the preceding.
उलूत: उलूत m. (-तः) A large snake, the Boa. E. उद् much, लू to cut, and क्त aff.
उलूप: उलूप m. (-पः) A spreading creeper. n. (-पं) A sort of grass. f. (-पी) A nymph of Pātāla married to ARJUNA. E. see उलुप.
उलूपिन्: उलूपिन् m. (-पी) A porpoise, or fish resembling it: see उलुपिन्.
उल्का: उल्का f. (-ल्का) 1 A firebrand. 2 Fire falling from heaven, a meteor, &c. 3 Flame. 4 Fire. E. उष to burn, कक् Uṇādi affix, ल substituted for ष; or the root is a Sautra root, उल to burn.
उल्कामुख: उल्कामुख m. (-खः) A ghost or goblin, with a face of fire, who eats what is vomited, and who was a negligent Brahman in his lifetime. f. (-खी) A fox. E. उल्का a flame, मुख a mouth, ङीष् affix; the latter from the redness of his mouth.
उल्मुक: उल्मुक (-कः) 1 A firebrand, wood burning or burnt as charcoal. 2 The name of a prince. E. उष to burn, मुक Uṇādi affix, घ is changed to ल.
उल्लकसन: उल्लकसन n. (-नं) Horripilation, erection of the hair of the body. E. उद् up, लष to injure, ल्युट् affix, and क inserted.
उल्लग्न: उल्लग्न m. (-ग्नः) The Lagna of any particular place. E. उत् over, लग्न the entrance of the sun into a sign.
उल्लङ्घन: उल्लङ्घन n. (-नं) 1 Leaping or passing over or beyond. 2 Exceeding, transgression. E. उद् before लघि to go, ल्युट् aff.
उल्लङ्घित: उल्लङ्घित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Passed over or beyond, jumped across. 2 Exceeded, transgressed. E. उद् before लघि to go, क्त aff.
उल्लङ्घ्य: उल्लङ्घ्य mfn. (-ङ्घ्यः-ङ्घ्या-ङ्घ्यं) 1 To be crossed, to be passed over or beyond. 2 To be disregarded or neglected. E. उद् before लघि to go, and यत् aff.
उल्लङ्घितशासन: उल्लङ्घितशासन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Refractory, rebellious, disobedient. E. उल्लङ्घित and शासन order.
उल्लल: उल्लल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Shaking, trembling. E. उद् much, लल to tremble, अच् aff.
उल्ललत्: उल्ललत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Shaking, trembling. 2 Moving irregularly or convulsively. E. उद् before लल to tremble, affix शतृ.
उल्ललित: उल्ललित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling, agitated. E. उद् much, लल to tremble, affix क्त.
उल्लस: उल्लस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Bright, shining. 2 Sporting, merry, happy. 3 Going out, issuing. E. उद् before लस to shine, अच् aff.
उल्लसत्: उल्लसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Brilliant, shining. 2 Sporting, wantoning. E. उद् before लस to shine, शतृ aff.
उल्लसता: उल्लसता f. (-ता) 1 Splendor, brilliancy. 2 Mirth, happiness. 3 Going forth, issuing. E. उल्लस what shines, तल् aff.
उल्लसित: उल्लसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bright, splendid, shining. 2 Happy. 3 Ejected, brought to the top or surface. 4 Drawn up. E. उद् before लस to shine, क्त aff.
उल्लाघ: उल्लाघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) 1 Recovered from sickness, convalescent. 2 Dextrous, clever, intelligent. 3 Pure. 4 Happy, delighted. E. उद् much, लाघ to be able, अच् aff.
उल्लाप: उल्लाप m. (-पः) Change of voice in grief, sickness, &c. E. उद् implying alteration, लप to speak, घञ् aff.
उल्लास: उल्लास m. (-सः) 1 Joy, happiness. 2 Light, splendor. 3 Increase. 4 The division of a book, a chapter, a section. E. उद् much, लस to shine, &c. घञ् aff.
उल्लासित: उल्लासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, rejoicing. E. उद् before लस to shine, causal form, क्त aff.
उल्लिखत्: उल्लिखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्) 1 Painting, writing. 2 Making lines or streaks, above or on high. 3 Scratching, scraping. 4 Bearing, raising. E. उद् before लिख to write, शतृ aff.
उल्लिखित: उल्लिखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thrown up, tossed. 2 Pared, made thin. 3 Scraped, scratched. 4 Painted, delineated. 5 Written over or above. E. उद् and लिखित written.
उल्लिङ्गित: उल्लिङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Discriminated, distinguished, known. E. उद्, before लिगि to mark, and क्त aff.
उल्लुञ्चन: उल्लुञ्चन n. (-नं) 1 Plucking out hair. 2 Cutting the hair. E. उद् up, लिचि to cut, affix ल्युट्.
उल्लेख: उल्लेख m. (-खः) 1 Utterance, pronunciation. 2 Speaking. E. उद् before लिख to write, घञ् aff.
उल्लेखन: उल्लेखन n. (-नं) 1 Raising up, elevating. 2 Vomiting. 3 Digging. 4 Scraping, paring. 5 Uttering, utterance. 6 Writing, painting. E. उद्, लिखि to write, &c. ल्युट् aff.
उल्लोच: उल्लोच m. (-चः) An awning, a canopy. E. उद् above, लोच to see, अच् aff.
उल्लोल: उल्लोल m. (-लः) A surge, a large wave or billow. E. उद् up, लोड to be furious, अच् affix, and ड becomes ल.
उल्व: उल्व n. (-ल्वः) 1 The womb. 2 The embryo. 3 The membranes investing the foetus. 4 A cavity. E. उच to accumulate, कन् Uṇādi affix, and च becomes ल.
उल्वण: उल्वण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Apparent, evident. 2 Much, exceeding. n. (-णं) An excess of either of the humors of the body, bile, phlegm or wind. E. उद् up, ल्वी to join, deriv. irr.
उव्ज: उव्ज r. 6th cl. (उव्जति) To be straight: see उब्ज.
उशत्: उशत् mfn. (-शन्-शती-शत्) Inauspicious, (as discourse.) E. उव to burn, शतृ part. affix; also उषत्.
उशनस्: उशनस् m. (-नाः) A name of ŚUKRA, regent of the planet Venus. E. वस to wish, कनसि Uṇādi aff.
उशिज्: उशिज् m. (-शिक्) 1 Fire. 2 Ghee or boiled butter. E. वस to wish, Uṇādi affix इज्, and व changed to उ.
उशी: उशी f. (-शी) Wish, desire. E. वश to wish, ई Uṇādi aff.
उशीनर: उशीनर m. (-रः) 1 The name of a country, (Candahar.) 2 A king, the father of ŚIVA. E. उशी desire, नर a man.
उशीर: उशीर mn. (-रः-रं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum). f. (-री) A sort of grass, a small sort of Saccharum. E. वश to desire, ईरन् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added उशीरक.
उष: उष r. 1st cl. (ओषति) To burn. (उ,) उषु (ओषति). To kill or injure: with प्र prefixed, this root makes प्रोषति, &c.

उष m. (-षः) 1 Early morning, dawn, day-break. 2 A libidinous man. 3 Bdellium. 4 Saline earth. f. (-षा) 1 A cow. 2 Burning, scorching. 3 A proper name, the wife of ANIRUDDHA. 4 Night. 5 A pot; also उखा. ind. The end of night or day-break. E. उष to burn, क affix and fem. do. टाप्; the affix of the particle is का.
उषण: उषण n. (-णं) Black pepper. f. (-णा) 1 Long pepper. 2 Chai, (Piper chavya.) 3 Dried ginger. E. उष to burn, कनच् aff.
उषत्: उषत् mfn. (-षन्-षती-षत्) Inauspicious, (as discourse:) see उशत्.
उषप: उषप m. (-पः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. उप to burn, पच् aff.
उषर्बुध: उषर्बुध m. (-धः) Fire. E. उषस् dawn, बुध to know, क aff.
उषस्: उषस् n. (-षः) 1 The dawn, morning. f. (-सी) The end of the day. twilight. E. उष to burn, असि Uṇādi aff.
उषस्य: उषस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Belonging to the dawn. E. उषस् and य aff.
उषाकल: उषाकल m. (-लः) A cock. E. उषा dawn, कल to sound, अच् aff.
उषापति: उषापति m. (-तिः) A name of ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMADEVA. E. उषा and पति a lord, a master: the husband of UṢĀ.
उषारमण: उषारमण m. (-णः) ANIRUDDHA: see the preceding. E. उषा and रमण a husband, &c.
उषित: उषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stale. 2 Burnt. 3 Quick, expeditious. 4 Fixed, remaining in or on. 5 Inhabited, dwelt. E. उष to burn, or वस to abide, affix क्त.
उषितङ्गवीन: उषितङ्गवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Formerly inhabited by cattle. E. उषित inhabited, गवीन appertaining to cattle, from गो with खश् affix: see अशितङ्गवीन.
उषित्वा: उषित्वा ind. Having resided in. E. वस to abide, क्त्वा aff.
उषीर: उषीर mn. (-रः-रं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. वश to desire, ईरन affix, श becomes षः see उशीर.
उषेश: उषेश m. (-शः) A name of ANIRUDDHA. E. उषा and ईश lord, husband: see उषापति.
उष्य: उष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Fit to be dressed in a pot, or boiled, (meat, &c.) E. उषा a pot, यत् affix; also उख्य.
उष्ट्र: उष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) 1 A camel. 2 A cart, a vehicle of burthen. f. (-ष्ट्री or -ष्ट्रिका) An earthen vessel. 2 A she camel. E. उष to burn, and ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi affix, fem. ङीष्, or ठाप् with इक् inserted.
उष्ट्रकाण्डी: उष्ट्रकाण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A flower of a red colour.
उष्ट्रक्रोशिन्: उष्ट्रक्रोशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Making a noise like a camel. E. उष्ट्र and क्रुश to cry, णिनि aff.
उष्ट्रगोयुग: उष्ट्रगोयुग n. (-गं) A pair of camels. E. उष्ट्र and गोयुग a couple.
उष्ट्रग्रीव: उष्ट्रग्रीव m. (-वः) Hemorrhoids. E. उष्ट्र and ग्रीवा the neck.
उष्ट्रपादिका: उष्ट्रपादिका f. (-का) Arabian jasmin. E. उष्ट्र and पाद a foot: from the shape of its flowers.
उष्ट्रयान: उष्ट्रयान n. (-नं) A camel litter, a vehicle drawn or borne by camels. E. उष्ट्र and यान a carriage.
उष्ट्रशिरोधर: उष्ट्रशिरोधर m. (-रः) Piles, hemorrhoids, bleeding piles. E. उष्ट्र a camel, शिरस् head, and धर what has.
उष्ण: उष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) 1 Hot, warm. 2 Pungent, acrid. 3 Sharp, active. 4 Impetuous, warm, passionate. m. (-ष्णः) 1 The hot season, (June and July.) 2 Heat, warmth. 3 Sunshine. 4 An onion. 5 A sigh. f. (-ष्णा) 1 Consumption. 2 Bile. E. उष to burn, णक् aff.
उष्णक: उष्णक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Sharp, smart, active. 2 Suffering pain. 3 Bent, inclining, stooping. 4 Warming, heating. m. (-कः) 1 The hot season, two months about June and July. 2 Revolving, turning round. E. वुन् added to the preceding.
उष्णता: उष्णता f. (-ता) Heat, warmth. E. तल् added to उष्ण; also with त्व, उष्णत्व.
उष्णनदी: उष्णनदी f. (-दी) The river of hell. E. उष्ण hot, नदी a river.
उष्णरश्मि: उष्णरश्मि m. (-श्मिः) The sun. E. उष्ण and रश्मि a ray.
उष्णवारण: उष्णवारण mn. (-णः-णं) An umbrella or parasol, a Catta. E. उष्ण heat, and वृ to screen, affix ल्युट्.
उष्णवाष्प: उष्णवाष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 Hot vapour, steam. 2 Tears. E. उष्ण and वाष्प vapour.
उष्णवीर्य: उष्णवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 The gangetic porpoise. 2 Any hot or pungent substance. E. उष्ण heat, वीर्य्य power, strength.
उष्णवीर्य्य: उष्णवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 The gangetic porpoise. 2 Any hot or pungent substance. E. उष्ण heat, वीर्य्य power, strength.
उष्णांशु: उष्णांशु m. (-शुः) The sun. E. उष्ण and अंशु a ray.
उष्णागम: उष्णागम m. (-मः) The hot season, consisting of two months, about June and July. E. उष्ण heat, and आगम arrival.
उष्णाभिगम: उष्णाभिगम m. (-मः) The hot season, as above. E. उष्ण and अभिगम approach.
उष्णालु: उष्णालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Suffering from heat. E. उष्ण and आलु aff.
उष्णासह: उष्णासह m. (-हः) The cold season. E. उष्ण warmth, असह intolerant.
उष्णिका: उष्णिका f. (-का) Rice gruel. E. उष्ण warm (rice,) वुन् aff.
उष्णिह्: उष्णिह् f. (-ष्णिक्) A verse of four lines, each line being of seven syllables: it is used chiefly in the Vedas. E. उत् prefixed to ष्णिह to be unctuous or bland, क्विन् aff.
उष्णीष: उष्णीष mn. (-षः-षं) 1 A turban. 2 A diadem. 3 A distinguishing cognate mark. 4 The curly hair with which a Buddha is born, and which indicates his future sanctity. E. उष्ण heat, ईष to oppose or injure, क aff.
उष्णीषधारिन्: उष्णीषधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Turbaned. E. उष्णीष and धारिन् who wears.
उष्णोदक: उष्णोदक n. (-कं) Warm or hot water. E. उष्ण and उदक water.
उष्णोपगम: उष्णोपगम m. (-मः) The hot season, summer. E. उष्ण, उपगम arrival.
उष्म: उष्म m. (-ष्मः) 1 The hot season, (June and July.) 2 Spring, (April and May.) 3 Heat. 4 Anger, warmth of temper. 5 Ardor, eagerness. E. उष to burn, मक् affix; also with कन् affix उष्मक, also उष्ण and उष्णक.
उष्मन्: उष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) 1 The hot season. 2 Heat. E. उष to burn, and मनिन् aff.
उष्मपा: उष्मपा m. (-पाः) A heavenly spirit of an inferior order.
उष्मभास्: उष्मभास् m. (-भाः) The sun. E. उष्म and भास् what shines.
उष्मस्वेद: उष्मस्वेद m. (-दः) A vapour bath. E. उष्ण and स्वेद sweat.
उष्मागम: उष्मागम m. (-मः) The hot season: see उष्णागम.
उस्र: उस्र m. (-स्रः) 1 A bull. 2 A ray of light. f. (-स्रा) 1 A cow. 2 A plant, (Anthericum tuberosum, Rox.) E. वस to dwell, रक् Uṇādi aff.
उह: उह r. 1st cl. (इर) उहिर् (ओहति) or (इ) उहि (उंहति) 1 To hurt or give pain. 2 To kill, to destroy. With वि and अप pre, to destroy, to remove.
उहान: उहान m. (-नः) The name of a country. ऊ
